source.original_text: The aspect from the 7th house is the only one that should be declared as most effective in all cases — not so, the rest.

interpretation.detailed: The standard Parashari view on aspects is that the 7th house aspect (full opposition aspect, applying to all planets) is the strongest and most effective in all cases. The partial aspects (3rd, 4th, 5th, 8th, 9th, 10th aspects and the various special aspects of Saturn, Jupiter, and Mars) are less efficacious by comparison. This is the baseline view; see pd-ch04-032 for the competing view presented in the same sloka. 7th house aspect is most effective in all cases; other aspects are less so
interpretation.summary: Standard doctrine: the full 7th house (opposition) aspect is the most effective of all aspects in all cases.

condition.description: 7th house aspect from any planet

source.original_text: But there are others who opine that the special aspect (of Saturn, Jupiter and Mars) is in no way less efficacious in producing full effect in all Yogas and the like.

interpretation.detailed: Some astrologers (referred to as 'others' in the text) hold that the special aspects of Saturn (3rd and 10th house aspects), Jupiter (5th and 9th house aspects), and Mars (4th and 8th house aspects) are in no way inferior to the 7th house aspect when it comes to producing full effects in yogas and similar configurations. This competing view acknowledges the special aspects as full-strength aspects for yoga evaluation. The text presents both views without resolving the debate — this rule captures the alternative view. Special aspects of Saturn/Jupiter/Mars are equally efficacious as 7th aspect for full yoga effects
interpretation.summary: Alternative view: the special aspects of Saturn (3rd/10th), Jupiter (5th/9th), and Mars (4th/8th) are equally efficacious as the 7th aspect for producing full effects in yogas.

condition.description: Special aspects of Saturn (3rd/10th), Jupiter (5th/9th), Mars (4th/8th) in yoga evaluation

source.original_text: Natural enmity or friendship between two planets is more fully effective than and preferable to their corresponding temporal ones as the latter is only a variable quantity and not a permanent one.

interpretation.detailed: Vedic astrology uses two systems of inter-planetary relationships: natural (Naisargika) friendship/enmity — which is fixed and permanent based on the planets' inherent natures — and temporal (Tatkalika) friendship/enmity — which varies based on the relative positions of planets in the current chart. When the two systems give conflicting assessments, natural friendship/enmity takes precedence because it is permanent, while temporal friendship is a variable quantity. For most predictive purposes, natural relationships are the primary reference. Natural friendship/enmity is more effective and preferable to temporal
interpretation.summary: Natural (permanent) friendship and enmity between planets is more effective and reliable than temporal (chart-based) friendship, which is variable and impermanent.

condition.description: Conflict between natural and temporal friendship/enmity between planets

source.original_text: In completely warding off evil and in promoting prosperity, Jupiter is the most powerful of all the planets.

interpretation.detailed: Jupiter is designated as the supreme benefic in terms of two critical functions: (1) completely warding off evil — Jupiter's placement, aspect, or association can neutralize malefic influences more effectively than any other planet; (2) promoting prosperity — Jupiter most powerfully advances wealth, abundance, growth, and auspicious outcomes. This establishes Jupiter as the primary anti-malefic force in chart interpretation. Jupiter is most powerful for warding off evil and promoting prosperity
interpretation.summary: Among all seven planets, Jupiter is the most powerful for completely removing evil influences and promoting prosperity.

condition.description: Jupiter's relative benefic power vs all other planets

source.original_text: Mercury and Venus have ¾ and ½ respectively of that power.

interpretation.detailed: Relative to Jupiter's full benefic anti-evil power (100%), Mercury has ¾ (75%) of that power, and Venus has ½ (50%). This establishes a benefic hierarchy for anti-malefic purposes: Jupiter > Mercury > Venus. This grading applies specifically to the capacity to ward off evil and promote prosperity, not to all benefic functions equally. Mercury = ¾ of Jupiter's benefic anti-evil power; Venus = ½
interpretation.summary: Mercury has ¾ of Jupiter's anti-evil/prosperity-promoting power; Venus has ½ of Jupiter's power.

condition.description: Relative anti-evil benefic power of Mercury and Venus vs Jupiter

source.original_text: The Moon's strength serves as a basis as it were for the strength of all the planets.

interpretation.detailed: The Moon occupies a unique role in the Shadbala system: its strength serves as the base or foundation for evaluating the strength of all other planets. A strong Moon amplifies and supports the ability of all planets to deliver their results; a weak Moon undermines the overall chart's strength. This is why Pakshabala (the Moon's fortnightly strength component) is given special primacy in assessments (see pd-ch04-040). Moon's strength is the basis for all planetary strengths
interpretation.summary: The Moon's strength functions as the foundational basis upon which the strength of all other planets rests.

condition.description: Moon's strength as foundation for all planetary strengths

source.original_text: Find what portion of the asterism occupied by the Moon has elapsed at birth. Reduce the same to Vighatikas. Divide this result by (1) 60 (2) 300 and (3) 100. The three resulting quotients are termed (1) Chandrakriya (2) Chandravastha and (3) Chandravela respectively.

interpretation.detailed: The Chandrakriya system is a Moon-based predictive tool. At birth, determine what portion of the Moon's current Nakshatra has elapsed and express it in Vighatikas (1 Vighati = 24 seconds; total Nakshatra duration varies). Then: (1) divide by 60 to get the Chandrakriya quotient (the remainder gives the specific 1-of-60 activity state); (2) divide by 300 to get the Chandravastha quotient (1 of 12 states); (3) divide by 100 to get the Chandravela quotient (1 of 36 time-moment states). The effects for each state are described in slokas 13-19 and tabulated in Summary.md. Elapsed Nakshatra portion (Vighatikas) ÷ 60 = Chandrakriya; ÷ 300 = Chandravastha; ÷ 100 = Chandravela
interpretation.summary: Method: Take Moon's elapsed Nakshatra portion at birth in Vighatikas. Divide by 60 = Chandrakriya (1 of 60); divide by 300 = Chandravastha (1 of 12); divide by 100 = Chandravela (1 of 36).

condition.description: Calculation of Chandrakriya, Chandravastha, Chandravela from Moon's Nakshatra elapsed portion

source.original_text: The Chandrakriya and others, described above will be found to be useful and productive of effect in the case of a birth, a Muhurta (celebration of an auspicious event) and a query. One ought therefore to particularly examine them and then set about predicting.

interpretation.detailed: Sloka 20 explicitly extends the application of the Chandrakriya/Vastha/Vela systems beyond natal astrology to two additional branches: Muhurta (electional astrology — choosing auspicious times for events) and Prasna (horary astrology — answering questions from the chart cast at the moment of the question). The instruction to 'particularly examine them and then set about predicting' makes these a mandatory pre-prediction check in all three contexts. Applicable to birth charts, Muhurta, and Prasna
interpretation.summary: The Chandrakriya, Chandravastha, and Chandravela systems are applicable and should be consulted for: natal birth charts, Muhurta (election timing), and Prasna (horary queries).

condition.description: Scope of Chandrakriya/Vastha/Vela application

source.original_text: Pakshabala is of special importance to the Moon, while the Bala arising from Sthana is important for the other planets. This when added to the other kinds of strength of the several planets will become very great.

interpretation.detailed: Within the six Shadbala components, different components carry different weights for different planets: for the Moon, Pakshabala (based on lunar phase — how full or empty the Moon is) is the most critical strength factor; for all other planets (Sun, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn), Sthana Bala (positional strength from varga dignities and house positions) is the most important factor. When these primary strengths are supplemented by the other Shadbala components, the total becomes very great. Pakshabala = primary strength for Moon; Sthana bala = primary for all others
interpretation.summary: For the Moon, Pakshabala (fortnightly/phase strength) is the most important strength component. For all other planets, Sthana bala (positional strength) is the most important.

condition.description: Primary strength component by planet type

source.original_text: The Sun is declared strong when his strength is 6½ Rupas.

interpretation.detailed: The minimum Shadbala required for the Sun to be considered strong (Purnabala — full strength) is 6½ Rupas. If the Sun's total Shadbala score across all six components falls below 6½ Rupas, the Sun is classified as weak and its significations (authority, government, father, vitality, soul) are correspondingly diminished in predictive output. Sun with 6½+ Rupas total Shadbala = strong; below 6½ = weak
interpretation.summary: The Sun is considered strong (Purnabala) when its total Shadbala reaches 6½ Rupas. Below this = weak.

source.original_text: In the case of the Moon, it is 6 Rupas. Five Rupas are assigned to Mars and 7 to Mercury. Jupiter's Purnabala is similar to that of the Sun, that is, 6½ Rupas. Venus is strong when he gets 5½ Rupas.

interpretation.detailed: The minimum Shadbala thresholds for strength (Purnabala) for five planets: Moon = 6 Rupas; Mars = 5 Rupas; Mercury = 7 Rupas (the highest threshold of all planets, reflecting Mercury's need for strong cognitive/communicative function); Jupiter = 6½ Rupas (same as Sun); Venus = 5½ Rupas. If a planet's total Shadbala falls below its threshold, it is classified as weak. Moon ≥ 6; Mars ≥ 5; Mercury ≥ 7; Jupiter ≥ 6½; Venus ≥ 5½ Rupas = strong
interpretation.summary: Minimum Shadbala (Purnabala): Moon=6 Rupas, Mars=5, Mercury=7, Jupiter=6½, Venus=5½. Below these = weak.

source.original_text: Saturn should have 5 Rupas. These are the figures representing the total Shadbala for the several planets. If the respective figures be otherwise, i.e., less than the above, the planets should be considered as weak.

interpretation.detailed: Saturn's minimum Shadbala threshold for full strength (Purnabala) is 5 Rupas. Sloka 23 also states the general rule: if any planet's total Shadbala is less than its specified minimum (Sun=6½, Moon=6, Mars=5, Mercury=7, Jupiter=6½, Venus=5½, Saturn=5), that planet is to be considered weak. The sloka concludes with an important methodological instruction: 'It is only after a minute examination of the several kinds of strength (the Shadbalas) of the several planets that one ought to declare their effects.' This is a mandatory engine-spec pre-condition for all predictions. Saturn ≥ 5 Rupas = strong; below = weak. Examine Shadbalas before declaring effects.
interpretation.summary: Saturn minimum Shadbala = 5 Rupas. Any planet with total Shadbala below its threshold is declared weak. Examine Shadbalas minutely before declaring effects.

source.original_text: It is only after a minute examination of the several kinds of strength (the Shadbalas) of the several planets, one ought to declare their effects.

interpretation.detailed: Sloka 23 concludes with an explicit methodological mandate: no planetary effects should be declared until the astrologer has minutely examined the full Shadbala of each planet. This instruction applies to all predictions throughout the book. It establishes Shadbala as a non-optional pre-condition for interpretation — not merely a supplementary tool. In the engine context: all rule evaluations should be weighted by each planet's Shadbala strength before output. Examine all Shadbalas minutely before declaring any effects
interpretation.summary: A mandatory engine-spec instruction: all planetary effects must be declared only after minutely examining the Shadbalas of all planets. Shadbala examination is a prerequisite for any prediction.

condition.description: Shadbala examination mandatory before declaring any planetary effects

source.original_text: One ought to declare the acquisition of wealth by any person with reference to the predominance of the Lagna or the Moon as the case may be in his horoscope. The source of such an acquisition will be the father, mother, a foe, a friend, a brother, a wife or a servant, according as the Sun or any of the other planets taken in order occupies the 10th place from the Lagna or the Moon whichever is stronger.

interpretation.detailed: To declare the acquisition of wealth, determine whether the Lagna or the Moon is stronger (predominant) in the horoscope. Then identify which planet occupies the 10th place from that stronger point. The source of wealth acquisition is determined by the occupying planet in order: Sun → father; Moon → mother; Mars → a foe; Mercury → a friend; Jupiter → a brother; Venus → a wife; Saturn → a servant. The planet order follows the standard planetary sequence (Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn).
interpretation.summary: The source of a person's wealth is identified by which planet occupies the 10th house from whichever is stronger (Lagna or Moon). Sun → father; Moon → mother; Mars → foe; Mercury → friend; Jupiter → brother; Venus → wife; Saturn → servant.

condition.description: Planet in 10th from stronger of Lagna/Moon → source of wealth by planet identity lookup.

source.original_text: His profession will be that prescribed for the lord of the Navamsa occupied by the planet owning the 10th place from the Lagna, from the Moon and from the Sun (severally) whichever is strongest.

interpretation.detailed: The profession of a person is determined by a 3-step process: (1) Find the lord of the 10th house from the Lagna, from the Moon, and from the Sun separately. (2) Determine which of these three 10th lords is the strongest. (3) Find the Navamsa (D9) sign occupied by that strongest 10th lord. The planet that owns that Navamsa sign determines the profession category (see Rules 003-009 for each planet's profession list). Profession determined by Navamsa lord of strongest 10th lord — see planet-specific rules 003-009
interpretation.summary: Profession is determined by the planet that rules the Navamsa occupied by the 10th lord. Evaluate the 10th lord from Lagna, Moon, and Sun separately — use the strongest. Then find the Navamsa ruler of that 10th lord's position.

condition.description: Step 1: Find 10th lord from Lagna/Moon/Sun. Step 2: Take the strongest. Step 3: Find that lord's Navamsa sign ruler. Apply profession rules for that planet.

source.original_text: If the lord of the 10th house be posited in the Sun's Navamsa, the person born will earn his livelihood through fruit-trees, by the repetitions of Mantras, by fraud, by gambling, by uttering falsehood, through wool, medicine and the like, by working on metals or through service under a king or some respectable person.

interpretation.detailed: If the lord of the 10th house is posited in a Navamsa owned by the Sun (a Leo Navamsa), the person will earn their livelihood through: fruit trees, repetition of Mantras, fraud, gambling, uttering falsehood, wool, medicine and allied fields, working on metals, or service under a king or a respectable person. Livelihood through: fruit-trees, Mantra repetition, fraud, gambling, falsehood, wool, medicine, metals, or royal/respectable service
interpretation.summary: When the 10th lord occupies a Navamsa owned by the Sun (Leo Navamsa), the native earns through fruit-trees, Mantra repetition, fraud/gambling/falsehood, wool, medicine, metals, or royal service.

condition.description: 10th lord in Sun's Navamsa (Leo Navamsa sign).

source.original_text: If the Navamsa occupied by the lord of the 10th house be that of the Moon, the income of the person concerned will be through trade in water-products (pearls, corals, etc.), through agriculture and cattle-farming, pilgrimage to holy shrines, service under a damsel or trading in clothes.

interpretation.detailed: If the Navamsa occupied by the lord of the 10th house is a Moon's Navamsa (Cancer Navamsa sign), the income will come through: trade in water products (pearls, corals, etc.), agriculture, cattle-farming, pilgrimage to holy shrines, service under a woman (damsel), or trading in clothes. Livelihood through: water products (pearls/corals), agriculture, cattle-farming, pilgrimage, service to woman, or cloth trading
interpretation.summary: When the 10th lord occupies a Moon's Navamsa (Cancer Navamsa), the native earns through water products (pearls, corals), agriculture, cattle, pilgrimage, service to a woman, or cloth trading.

condition.description: 10th lord in Moon's Navamsa (Cancer Navamsa sign).

source.original_text: If the Navamsa in question be that of Mars, the sources of income may be through metals, fighting in battles, cooking, lands, gold, inflicting trouble to others, weapons, acts of adventure, association with wicked men, spying or through theft.

interpretation.detailed: If the Navamsa occupied by the 10th lord is owned by Mars (Aries or Scorpio Navamsa), the sources of income include: metals, fighting in battles, cooking, lands, gold, inflicting trouble to others, weapons, acts of adventure, association with wicked men, spying, or theft. Livelihood through: metals, battle, cooking, lands, gold, weapons, adventure, wicked associates, spying, or theft
interpretation.summary: When the 10th lord is in Mars' Navamsa (Aries/Scorpio Navamsa), income comes through metals, battles, cooking, lands, gold, weapons, adventure, wicked associations, spying, or theft.

condition.description: 10th lord in Mars' Navamsa (Aries or Scorpio Navamsa sign).

source.original_text: In the case of a person born with the lord of the 10th posited in a Navamsa owned by Mercury, the earning will be through composing poems, the study of sacred scriptures, by being a scribe or through some clerical work, or some trick, through a knowledge of astrology, through the study of the Vedas on other's behalf, by repetition of Mantras, or by playing the role of a priest or by some pretext.

interpretation.detailed: When the lord of the 10th house is posited in a Navamsa owned by Mercury (Gemini or Virgo Navamsa), the earning comes through: composing poems, study of sacred scriptures, scribing or clerical work, tricks, knowledge of astrology, study of the Vedas on others' behalf, repetition of Mantras, playing the role of a priest, or some other pretext. Livelihood through: composing poems, scriptural study, scribing, astrology, Vedic recitation, Mantra repetition, or priestly roles
interpretation.summary: When the 10th lord occupies Mercury's Navamsa (Gemini/Virgo Navamsa), income comes through poetry, scriptural study, scribing, clerical work, astrology, Vedic recitation, Mantra repetition, or priestly roles.

condition.description: 10th lord in Mercury's Navamsa (Gemini or Virgo Navamsa sign).

source.original_text: If the planet concerned be in a Navamsa of Jupiter, the person born maintains himself through the help of Brahmins, Gods or through royal favor, by reciting Puranas, by the study of Sastras, by the preaching of morality, by religious instructions or by lending money (profession of usury).

interpretation.detailed: If the planet concerned (10th lord) is in a Navamsa owned by Jupiter (Sagittarius or Pisces Navamsa), the person maintains themselves through: help of Brahmins, service to Gods (temple), royal favor, reciting Puranas, studying Sastras, preaching morality, giving religious instruction, or lending money (usury/banking profession). Livelihood through: Brahmin/temple service, royal favor, Puranas, Sastras, moral preaching, religious instruction, or money lending
interpretation.summary: When the 10th lord is in Jupiter's Navamsa (Sagittarius/Pisces Navamsa), income comes through Brahmin community, temple/God service, royal favor, Puranas, Sastras, moral preaching, religious instruction, or money lending.

condition.description: 10th lord in Jupiter's Navamsa (Sagittarius or Pisces Navamsa sign).

source.original_text: The earnings of a person with the lord of the 10th house posited in a Navamsa owned by Venus will be through a woman, cows, buffaloes, elephants, horses, through triple symphony (i.e., dancing in accompaniment to vocal and instrumental music), through silver, scents, milk, ornaments and silken fineries, by virtue of being a companion (Aide-de-camp) to a king, or by his poetic talents.

interpretation.detailed: When the lord of the 10th house is in a Navamsa owned by Venus (Taurus or Libra Navamsa), earnings come through: women, cows, buffaloes, elephants, horses, triple symphony (dance with vocal and instrumental music), silver, scents, milk, ornaments, silken fineries, being a companion/aide-de-camp to a king, or through poetic talents. Livelihood through: women, cattle/elephants/horses, music/dance, silver, scents, ornaments, silk, royal companionship, or poetry
interpretation.summary: When the 10th lord is in Venus' Navamsa (Taurus/Libra Navamsa), income comes through women, cattle/elephants/horses, music and dance, silver, scents, milk, ornaments, silk, royal companionship, or poetry.

condition.description: 10th lord in Venus' Navamsa (Taurus or Libra Navamsa sign).

source.original_text: The person in whose nativity the lord of the 10th house is sheltered in Saturn's Navamsa lives by dealing in roots and fruits, by physical exertion (sweating labour), through servants, rogues and through the earnings of men of low morality, through bad grains, by carrying burden, by resorting to base avocations, through sculpture, wooden materials and by functioning as an executioner or a butcher.

interpretation.detailed: When the lord of the 10th house is in a Navamsa owned by Saturn (Capricorn or Aquarius Navamsa), the person lives by: dealing in roots and fruits, physical exertion (sweating/manual labor), working through servants, rogues, earnings of men of low morality, dealing in bad grains, carrying burdens, resorting to base avocations, sculpture, dealing in wooden materials, or functioning as an executioner or butcher. Livelihood through: roots/fruits dealing, physical labor, servants, rogues, bad grains, carrying burdens, base avocations, sculpture, wood, execution, or butchering
interpretation.summary: When the 10th lord is in Saturn's Navamsa (Capricorn/Aquarius Navamsa), income comes through roots/fruits dealing, physical/sweating labor, servants, rogues, low-morality work, bad grains, carrying burdens, sculpture, wood, execution, or butchering.

condition.description: 10th lord in Saturn's Navamsa (Capricorn or Aquarius Navamsa sign).

source.original_text: When the planet owning the Navamsa is strong, there will be acquisition of wealth without any exertion. If it should be weak, very little wealth accrues.

interpretation.detailed: When the planet that owns the Navamsa occupied by the 10th lord (the profession-determining planet from Rules 003-009) is strong (in own sign, exaltation, friendly sign, or high Shadbala), the native will acquire wealth without any exertion. If that Navamsa-ruling planet is weak (in debilitation, enemy sign, combust, or low Shadbala), very little wealth will accrue.
interpretation.summary: If the planet ruling the relevant Navamsa (the profession-determining planet) is strong, the native acquires wealth without effort. If that planet is weak, very little wealth is obtained.

condition.description: Strength of the Navamsa-ruling planet (from Rules 003-009) → wealth effort level.

source.original_text: The country of acquisition will be that signified by the sign representing the 10th house or the Navamsa occupied by the lord of the 10th house. But if this sign be occupied or aspected by its lord, he will earn in his own country. The same will be the result if the Navamsa occupied by the lord of the 10th house be an immoveable Rasi. And if the said sign be occupied or aspected by planets other than its lord, the native will earn in a place other than his own native country.

interpretation.detailed: The country of earnings is determined from: (a) The sign representing the 10th house, OR (b) The Navamsa occupied by the 10th lord. Application: (1) If that sign is occupied OR aspected by its OWN lord → native earns in his own country. (2) If the Navamsa occupied by the 10th lord is an immoveable (fixed) Rasi (Taurus, Leo, Scorpio, Aquarius) → earns in own country. (3) If that sign is occupied or aspected by planets OTHER THAN its own lord → native earns in a place other than his native country (foreign earnings).
interpretation.summary: The country where the native earns is indicated by the 10th house sign or Navamsa of 10th lord. If own lord occupies/aspects that sign → own country. If immoveable Rasi Navamsa → own country. If other planets occupy/aspect → abroad.

condition.description: 10th house sign or Navamsa of 10th lord + lord interaction: own lord → own country; immoveable Navamsa → own country; other planets → foreign.

source.original_text: The person born in the Ruchaka Yoga will have a long face, will acquire wealth by doing many daring deeds, will be brave, will overcome his enemies, will be powerful and will be arrogant. He will become renowned for his merits, will be a leader of an army and will emerge victorious in all his attempts.

interpretation.detailed: Ruchaka Yoga is one of the five Pancha Mahapurusha Yogas. It is formed when Mars occupies a Kendra house (1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th) that is simultaneously its own sign (Mesha or Vrischika) or its exaltation sign (Makara). The yoga also arises when counted from the Moon's position. Effects: long face; acquires wealth by many daring deeds; brave; overcomes enemies; powerful; arrogant; renowned for merits; leader of an army; victorious in all attempts. Brave, wealthy by daring deeds, overcomes enemies, army leader, victorious in all attempts.
interpretation.summary: When Mars occupies a Kendra (1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th house) that is simultaneously its own sign or exaltation sign, Ruchaka Yoga forms. Native is brave, wealthy by daring deeds, army leader, victorious.

source.original_text: The man born in the Bhadra Yoga will be gifted with long life and keen intellect, will be clean, praised by the learned, will lead men, will be very rich and clever in addressing an assembly.

interpretation.detailed: Bhadra Yoga is one of the five Pancha Mahapurusha Yogas. It is formed when Mercury occupies a Kendra house (1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th) that is simultaneously its own sign (Mithuna or Kanya) or its exaltation sign (Kanya at 15 degrees). Also arises when counted from the Moon. Effects: gifted with long life; keen intellect; clean; praised by the learned; leads men; very rich; clever in addressing an assembly. Long life, keen intellect, praised by learned, leads men, very rich, clever speaker.
interpretation.summary: When Mercury occupies a Kendra that is its own sign (Mithuna or Kanya) or exaltation (Kanya), Bhadra Yoga forms. Native is long-lived, keen intellect, rich, praised by learned.

source.original_text: The person born in the Hamsa yoga will be a king extolled by the good. He will have in his legs and hands marks of Sankha, Padma, Matsya and Ankusa Rekhas. He will possess a beautiful body, will eat sumptuous food and will be of a righteous disposition.

interpretation.detailed: Hamsa Yoga is one of the five Pancha Mahapurusha Yogas. It is formed when Jupiter occupies a Kendra house (1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th) that is simultaneously its own sign (Dhanus or Meena) or its exaltation sign (Karkataka at 5 degrees). Also arises when counted from the Moon. Effects: king extolled by the good; has auspicious marks of Sankha (conch), Padma (lotus), Matsya (fish), and Ankusa (goad) on legs and hands; possesses a beautiful body; eats sumptuous food; righteous disposition. King extolled by the good; righteous disposition; beautiful body; sumptuous food.
interpretation.summary: When Jupiter occupies a Kendra in its own sign (Dhanus or Meena) or exaltation (Karkataka), Hamsa Yoga forms. Native is a king, righteous, beautiful body, auspicious bodily marks.

source.original_text: The man born in the Malavya Yoga will have strong limbs, will be resolute, wealthy, endowed with wife, children and good fortune, will be prosperous, will eat good meals, enjoy pleasures, command good vehicles, and will become famous and learned. He will possess unperturbed senses.

interpretation.detailed: Malavya Yoga is one of the five Pancha Mahapurusha Yogas. It is formed when Venus occupies a Kendra house (1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th) that is simultaneously its own sign (Vrishabha or Tula) or its exaltation sign (Meena at 27 degrees). Also arises when counted from the Moon. Effects: strong limbs; resolute; wealthy; endowed with wife, children, and good fortune; prosperous; eats good meals; enjoys pleasures; commands good vehicles; famous and learned; possesses unperturbed senses. Strong limbs, resolute, wealthy, endowed with wife/children, prosperous, good vehicles, famous and learned.
interpretation.summary: When Venus occupies a Kendra in its own sign (Vrishabha or Tula) or exaltation (Meena), Malavya Yoga forms. Native has strong limbs, is resolute, wealthy, famous and learned.

source.original_text: The person, born in the Sasa Yoga will be extolled by all, will have good servants, will be strong, will be the headman of a village or a King, will be wicked in disposition, will have intrigues with women not his own, will usurp others' wealth and be happy.

interpretation.detailed: Sasa Yoga is one of the five Pancha Mahapurusha Yogas. It is formed when Saturn occupies a Kendra house (1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th) that is simultaneously its own sign (Makara or Kumbha) or its exaltation sign (Tula at 20 degrees). Also arises when counted from the Moon. Effects are mixed: extolled by all; good servants; strong; headman of a village or king. However also: wicked in disposition; intrigues with women not his own; usurps others' wealth; but is happy. This yoga reflects Saturn's ambivalent nature — worldly power combined with moral transgressions. Extolled by all, strong, headman or king, happy.
interpretation.summary: When Saturn occupies a Kendra in its own sign (Makara or Kumbha) or exaltation (Tula), Sasa Yoga forms. Native is strong, extolled, headman or king — but wicked, prone to intrigues, usurps others' wealth.

source.original_text: The person who happens to have one, two, three, four or all the five Yogas will respectively be a (1) fortunate man (2) one equal to a King (3) a King, (4) an Emperor, and (5) one superior to No 4.

interpretation.detailed: When multiple Pancha Mahapurusha Yogas are present simultaneously in a nativity, the outcomes are cumulative and escalate: 1 yoga = fortunate man; 2 yogas = one equal to a king; 3 yogas = a king; 4 yogas = an emperor; all 5 yogas = superior even to an emperor. This rule applies whether the yogas are counted from the Lagna or from the Moon. 1 yoga=fortunate; 2=equal to king; 3=king; 4=emperor; 5=superior to emperor.
interpretation.summary: The number of Pancha Mahapurusha Yogas present in a chart determines the native's status: 1=fortunate, 2=equal to king, 3=king, 4=emperor, 5=superior to emperor.

condition.description: Count of Pancha Mahapurusha Yogas present from Lagna or Moon

source.original_text: The person who has had his birth in the Sunapha Yoga will be a king or his equal, with self-acquired property, and renowned for his wisdom and wealth.

interpretation.detailed: Sunapha Yoga is formed when any planet other than the Sun occupies the 2nd house counted from the Moon's position. Effects: will be a king or his equal; possesses self-acquired property (wealth earned independently, not inherited); renowned for wisdom and wealth. King or equal; self-acquired property; renowned for wisdom and wealth.
interpretation.summary: When any planet except the Sun occupies the 2nd house from the Moon, Sunapha Yoga forms. Native is king or equal, self-acquired property, renowned for wisdom and wealth.

condition.description: Any planet except Sun in 2nd house from Moon

source.original_text: The man born under the Anapha Yoga will be powerful, healthy, with amiable manners, known to fame, blessed with material comforts, well-dressed, contented and happy.

interpretation.detailed: Anapha Yoga is formed when any planet other than the Sun occupies the 12th house counted from the Moon's position. Effects: powerful; healthy; amiable manners; known to fame; blessed with material comforts; well-dressed; contented; happy. Powerful, healthy, amiable, famous, material comforts, well-dressed, contented, happy.
interpretation.summary: When any planet except the Sun occupies the 12th house from the Moon, Anapha Yoga forms. Native is powerful, healthy, amiable, famous, material comforts, well-dressed, contented.

condition.description: Any planet except Sun in 12th house from Moon

source.original_text: Taking freely to the joys of life as they crop up and blessed with abundance of wealth and vehicles, the person born under the Durudhura Yoga is bountiful and waited upon by faithful attendants.

interpretation.detailed: Durudhura Yoga is formed when planets other than the Sun occupy both the 2nd and the 12th houses from the Moon's position simultaneously. Effects: takes freely to the joys of life; blessed with abundance of wealth and vehicles; bountiful; waited upon by faithful attendants. Abundance of wealth and vehicles; freely enjoys joys of life; bountiful; faithful attendants.
interpretation.summary: When planets (excluding Sun) occupy both the 2nd and 12th from Moon, Durudhura Yoga forms. Native freely enjoys joys of life, abundant wealth, vehicles, bountiful, waited upon by faithful attendants.

condition.description: Planets (not Sun) in both 2nd and 12th from Moon

source.original_text: But those born under the Kemadruma Yoga, though they may be of a princely race, become obscure, miserable, given to base ways, penurious, drudging as menials and wickedly-inclined.

interpretation.detailed: Kemadruma Yoga is the absence yoga — it forms when no planet other than the Sun occupies either the 2nd or the 12th house from the Moon. This yoga is subject to cancellation (see pd-ch06-011). If uncancelled: though the native may be of princely/royal race, he becomes obscure; miserable; given to base ways; penurious; drudges as a menial; wickedly-inclined. Obscure, miserable, base ways, penurious, drudges as a menial, wickedly-inclined — even if born in a royal family.
interpretation.summary: When no planet except the Sun occupies the 2nd or 12th from Moon, Kemadruma Yoga forms. Even if of royal birth, native becomes obscure, miserable, base, penurious, and works as a menial.

condition.description: No planet (other than Sun) in 2nd or 12th from Moon

source.original_text: There are some who declare that there is no Kemadruma where a Kendra or the Moon is associated with a planet, or where planets occupy a Kendra house reckoned from the Moon.

interpretation.detailed: Kemadruma Yoga (pd-ch06-010) is cancelled (does not operate) if any of the following three conditions is met: (1) The Moon is associated (in conjunction) with any other planet; (2) A planet occupies a Kendra house (1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th) counted from the Lagna; (3) A planet occupies a Kendra house counted from the Moon. This cancellation rule is attributed to 'some' scholars — it is presented as an opinion, not an absolute statement. Kemadruma Yoga is cancelled; its negative effects do not apply.
interpretation.summary: Kemadruma Yoga is cancelled if: (1) the Moon is associated with any planet, (2) a planet occupies a Kendra from the Lagna, or (3) a planet occupies a Kendra from the Moon.

condition.description: Moon conjunct a planet, OR planet in Kendra from Lagna, OR planet in Kendra from Moon

source.original_text: The person born in a Suvesi Yoga will be very handsome, happy, a store of merit, brave, a King and virtuous.

interpretation.detailed: Subhavesi Yoga is formed when benefic planets (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury, waxing Moon) occupy the 2nd house counted from the Sun's position. Effects: very handsome; happy; a store of merit; brave; a king; virtuous. Very handsome, happy, meritorious, brave, king, virtuous.
interpretation.summary: When benefic planets occupy the 2nd house from the Sun, Subhavesi Yoga forms. Native is very handsome, happy, meritorious, brave, king, virtuous.

condition.description: Benefic planet(s) in 2nd from Sun

source.original_text: He who is born in a Suvasi Yoga will become famous, will be liked by all, will be exceedingly prosperous, liberal and the favourite of the sovereign.

interpretation.detailed: Subhavasi Yoga is formed when benefic planets occupy the 12th house counted from the Sun's position. Effects: famous; liked by all; exceedingly prosperous; liberal; the favourite of the sovereign. Famous, liked by all, exceedingly prosperous, liberal, favourite of sovereign.
interpretation.summary: When benefic planets occupy the 12th from the Sun, Subhavasi Yoga forms. Native is famous, liked by all, exceedingly prosperous, liberal, and favourite of the sovereign.

condition.description: Benefic planet(s) in 12th from Sun

source.original_text: The man who has his birth in the Subhayachari Yoga will have beautiful limbs, will be affable in address, will delight the world, will be eloquent in his speech, renowned and wealthy.

interpretation.detailed: Subhobhayachari Yoga is formed when benefic planets occupy both the 2nd and the 12th house from the Sun's position simultaneously. Effects: beautiful limbs; affable in address; delights the world; eloquent in speech; renowned; wealthy. Beautiful limbs, affable in address, delights the world, eloquent, renowned, wealthy.
interpretation.summary: When benefic planets occupy both the 2nd and 12th from the Sun, Subhobhayachari Yoga forms. Native has beautiful limbs, is affable, eloquent, renowned, wealthy.

condition.description: Benefic planets in both 2nd and 12th from Sun

source.original_text: The person born in the Asubhavesi Yoga will unjustly vilify others; lose his splendour (beauty), will associate with the low and will be wicked.

interpretation.detailed: Papavesi Yoga (also called Asubhavesi) is formed when malefic planets (Saturn, Mars, Rahu, Ketu, waning Moon, afflicted Mercury) occupy the 2nd house from the Sun. Effects: unjustly vilifies others; loses splendour and beauty; associates with the low; wicked in character. Unjustly vilifies others; loses beauty; associates with the low; wicked.
interpretation.summary: When malefic planets occupy the 2nd from the Sun, Papavesi (Asubhavesi) Yoga forms. Native unjustly vilifies others, loses beauty, associates with the low, is wicked.

condition.description: Malefic planet(s) in 2nd from Sun

source.original_text: One who is born in an Asubhavasi Yoga will be deceitful, will abuse others, and will befriend the wicked. He will be of unrighteous conduct, but will quote Sastras and Scriptures.

interpretation.detailed: Papavasi Yoga (Asubhavasi) is formed when malefic planets occupy the 12th house from the Sun's position. Effects: deceitful; abuses others; befriends the wicked; unrighteous conduct — but ironically quotes Shastras and scriptures. The last detail suggests hypocrisy. Deceitful, abuses others, befriends wicked, unrighteous conduct; quotes scriptures hypocritically.
interpretation.summary: When malefic planets occupy the 12th from the Sun, Papavasi (Asubhavasi) Yoga forms. Native is deceitful, abuses others, befriends wicked, unrighteous but quotes scriptures.

condition.description: Malefic planet(s) in 12th from Sun

source.original_text: The man with an Asubhobhayachari Yoga will be mentally much afflicted owing to public dishonour. He will be bereft of learning, wealth and luck.

interpretation.detailed: Papobhayachari Yoga (Asubhobhayachari) is formed when malefic planets occupy both the 2nd and the 12th house from the Sun simultaneously. Effects: mentally much afflicted owing to public dishonour; bereft of learning; bereft of wealth; bereft of luck. Mentally afflicted by public dishonour; bereft of learning, wealth, and luck.
interpretation.summary: When malefics are in both the 2nd and 12th from the Sun, Papobhayachari Yoga forms. Native is mentally afflicted by public dishonour, bereft of learning, wealth, and luck.

condition.description: Malefic planets in both 2nd and 12th from Sun

source.original_text: The person who has his birth in a Subhakartari Yoga will be long-lived, fearless, free from disease, without enemies, happy and rich.

interpretation.detailed: Subhakartari Yoga is formed when benefic planets occupy both the 2nd and the 12th houses from the Lagna, effectively flanking the Lagna with benefic influence. Effects: long-lived; fearless; free from disease; without enemies; happy; rich. Long-lived, fearless, free from disease, without enemies, happy, rich.
interpretation.summary: When benefic planets occupy the 2nd and 12th from the Lagna (flanking the Lagna), Subhakartari Yoga forms. Native is long-lived, fearless, disease-free, without enemies, happy, rich.

condition.description: Benefic planets in 2nd and 12th from Lagna

source.original_text: He who is born in a Papakartari Yoga will be poor, impure, unhappy, bereft of wife and children, deprived of some limb and short-lived.

interpretation.detailed: Papakartari Yoga is formed when malefic planets occupy both the 2nd and the 12th houses from the Lagna, creating a malefic scissors around the Lagna. Effects: poor; impure; unhappy; bereft of wife and children; deprived of some limb (physical disability); short-lived. Poor, impure, unhappy, bereft of wife and children, deprived of a limb, short-lived.
interpretation.summary: When malefic planets flank the Lagna (in 2nd and 12th from Lagna), Papakartari Yoga forms. Native is poor, impure, unhappy, no wife or children, deprived of a limb, short-lived.

condition.description: Malefic planets in 2nd and 12th from Lagna

source.original_text: If benefics unaspected by malefics, occupy the 2nd house from the Lagna, the Yoga is termed Susubha.

interpretation.detailed: Susubha Yoga is formed when benefic planets that are NOT aspected by any malefic occupy the 2nd house from the Lagna. The purity condition (unaspected by malefics) is essential to this yoga's formation. Effects are equated by Sloka 13 to those of Sunapha and related auspicious yogas: king or equal, self-acquired wealth, renowned for wisdom and prosperity. King or equal; self-acquired property; renowned for wisdom and wealth. (Per Sloka 13 equivalence.)
interpretation.summary: When benefic planets unaspected by any malefic occupy the 2nd from the Lagna, Susubha Yoga forms. Effects equated to Sunapha-type positive results.

condition.description: Benefic planets unaspected by malefics in 2nd from Lagna

source.original_text: The person born in the Amala Yoga will be virtuous, pious, kindly disposed, fortunate, amiable, highly revered by his sovereign, gentle, affable in his speech and wealthy.

interpretation.detailed: Amala Yoga is formed when a benefic planet (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury, waxing Moon) occupies the 10th house counted from the Lagna or the Moon's position. Formation source: Sloka 19 definition confirmed by Sloka 12 effects. Effects: virtuous; pious; kindly disposed; fortunate; amiable; highly revered by the sovereign; gentle; affable in speech; wealthy. Virtuous, pious, kindly disposed, fortunate, amiable, highly revered by sovereign, gentle, wealthy.
interpretation.summary: When a benefic planet occupies the 10th house from the Lagna or the Moon, Amala Yoga forms. Native is virtuous, pious, kind, fortunate, amiable, revered by sovereign, wealthy.

source.original_text: In the case of Susubha, Subhakartari, Subhavesi and other Yogas the effects given for Sunapha and other Yogas caused by benefics should be adopted. In the case of Asubha, Papakartari, Papavesi and other Yogas caused by malefics, the effects will be just the contrary.

interpretation.detailed: This rule provides a general equivalence principle: (1) Susubha, Subhakartari, Subhavesi, and all other auspicious yogas caused by benefics — their effects are equivalent to those stated for Sunapha and its kindred benefic yogas (i.e., positive, royal-type outcomes). (2) Asubha, Papakartari, Papavesi, and all other inauspicious yogas caused by malefics — their effects are the contrary of the benefic yoga effects. This is a meta-rule for the engine: when a specific effect is not stated, apply the Sunapha-equivalent or its contrary. Benefic-type yogas produce Sunapha-equivalent effects; malefic-type yogas produce contrary (negative) effects.
interpretation.summary: Susubha/Subhakartari/Subhavesi and similar benefic yogas produce effects equivalent to Sunapha and related yogas. Papakartari/Papavesi/Asubha and similar malefic yogas produce contrary (negative) effects.

condition.description: Benefic yoga without specific effect stated → use Sunapha equivalent; malefic yoga → contrary

source.original_text: If at a day-birth in the case of a male, the Sun, the Moon and the Lagna are in odd signs, the Mahabhagya Yoga is formed.

interpretation.detailed: Mahabhagya Yoga for male natives requires: (1) day-time birth; (2) the Sun, the Moon, and the Lagna are all positioned in odd signs (Mesha, Mithuna, Simha, Tula, Dhanus, Kumbha). Effects: causes immense pleasure to all people by his mere appearance; very liberal in gifts; famous; ruler of earth; lives for 80 years; spotless character. Immense pleasure to all by his appearance; very liberal in gifts; famous; ruler of earth; lives 80 years; spotless character.
interpretation.summary: For a male native: day birth AND Sun, Moon, and Lagna all in odd signs (Mesha/Mithuna/Simha/Tula/Dhanus/Kumbha) = Mahabhagya Yoga. Native is famously liberal, a ruler, lives 80 years.

source.original_text: The same Yoga in the case of females will arise when the birth is at night and the Sun, the Moon and the Lagna are posited in even signs.

interpretation.detailed: Mahabhagya Yoga for female natives requires: (1) night-time birth; (2) the Sun, the Moon, and the Lagna are all positioned in even signs (Vrishabha, Karkataka, Kanya, Vrischika, Makara, Meena). Effects: endowed with wealth; long-lived husband; sons and grandsons; exceedingly lucky; well-behaved. Endowed with wealth; long-lived husband; sons and grandsons; exceedingly lucky; well-behaved.
interpretation.summary: For a female native: night birth AND Sun, Moon, and Lagna all in even signs = Mahabhagya Yoga. Native is endowed with wealth, long-lived husband, sons, grandsons, lucky, well-behaved.

source.original_text: The person born in the Kesari Yoga will destroy, like a lion, all his enemies. He will speak loftily or nobly in an assembly. He will be passionate and emotional in his behaviour. He will be long-lived, highly renowned and exceedingly intelligent. He will conquer everything by his own valour.

interpretation.detailed: Kesari Yoga is formed when the Moon occupies a Kendra house (1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th) counted from Jupiter's position. Effects: destroys all enemies like a lion; speaks loftily in assembly; passionate and emotional in behaviour; long-lived; highly renowned; exceedingly intelligent; conquers everything by own valour. Destroys enemies like a lion; long-lived; highly renowned; exceedingly intelligent; conquers by own valour.
interpretation.summary: When the Moon is in a Kendra house (1st, 4th, 7th, 10th) counted from Jupiter's position, Kesari Yoga forms. Native destroys enemies like a lion, is long-lived, renowned, intelligent, valorous.

condition.description: Moon in Kendra from Jupiter

source.original_text: The person born in the Sakata Yoga will often become unfortunate (lose his luck), and may again regain what he once lost. He will be a very ordinary and insignificant man in the world. He will attain much mental grief that is inevitable and will be exceedingly unhappy.

interpretation.detailed: Sakata Yoga is formed when the Moon occupies the 6th, 8th, or 12th house counted from Jupiter's position. The yoga is cancelled (does not operate) if the Moon is in a Kendra from the Lagna (see pd-ch06-027). Effects: often becomes unfortunate and loses luck, but may regain what was lost; very ordinary and insignificant; much inevitable mental grief; exceedingly unhappy. Fluctuates between fortune and misfortune; ordinary and insignificant; mental grief; exceedingly unhappy.
interpretation.summary: When the Moon is in the 6th, 8th, or 12th from Jupiter (and not in Kendra from Lagna), Sakata Yoga forms. Native fluctuates between fortune and misfortune, remains ordinary, suffers mental grief.

condition.description: Moon in 6th, 8th, or 12th from Jupiter AND Moon NOT in Kendra from Lagna

source.original_text: But if the Moon be in a Kendra house from the Lagna, there is no Sakata.

interpretation.detailed: Sakata Yoga (pd-ch06-026) is cancelled and does not produce its negative effects if the Moon occupies a Kendra house (1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th) from the Lagna. This cancellation applies even if the Moon is in the 6th, 8th, or 12th from Jupiter. Sakata Yoga is cancelled; its negative effects do not apply.
interpretation.summary: Sakata Yoga is cancelled if the Moon is in a Kendra house (1st, 4th, 7th, 10th) counted from the Lagna, regardless of its position relative to Jupiter.

source.original_text: According as the Yoga at birth is Kashta or Adhama, Madhyama or Sama, or Vara or Varishtha, the wealth, vehicles, fame, happiness, knowledge, intellectual precision, modesty, ability, learning, liberality and enjoyment of the person born will be at the lowest, middling or highest respectively.

interpretation.detailed: Adhama Yoga (Kashta) is formed when the Moon occupies a Kendra house (1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th) from the Sun's position. Effects: the native's wealth, vehicles, fame, happiness, knowledge, intellectual precision, modesty, ability, learning, liberality, and enjoyment are all at the lowest possible level. Lowest level in wealth, vehicles, fame, happiness, knowledge, modesty, ability, learning, liberality, and enjoyment.
interpretation.summary: When the Moon is in a Kendra from the Sun, Adhama Yoga (also called Kashta) forms. Native's wealth, vehicles, fame, happiness, knowledge, modesty, ability, learning, liberality, and enjoyment are all at the lowest.

condition.description: Moon in Kendra from Sun

source.original_text: According as the Yoga at birth is Kashta or Adhama, Madhyama or Sama, or Vara or Varishtha, the wealth, vehicles, fame, happiness, knowledge, intellectual precision, modesty, ability, learning, liberality and enjoyment of the person born will be at the lowest, middling or highest respectively.

interpretation.detailed: Sama Yoga (also called Madhyama) is formed when the Moon occupies a Panaphara house (2nd, 5th, 8th, or 11th) from the Sun's position. Effects: the native's wealth, vehicles, fame, happiness, knowledge, intellectual precision, modesty, ability, learning, liberality, and enjoyment are all at a middling (moderate, average) level. Middling level in wealth, vehicles, fame, happiness, knowledge, modesty, ability, learning, liberality, and enjoyment.
interpretation.summary: When the Moon is in a Panaphara house from the Sun, Sama (Madhyama) Yoga forms. Native's wealth, fame, happiness, knowledge, learning, etc. are all at a middling level.

condition.description: Moon in Panaphara from Sun

source.original_text: According as the Yoga at birth is Kashta or Adhama, Madhyama or Sama, or Vara or Varishtha, the wealth, vehicles, fame, happiness, knowledge, intellectual precision, modesty, ability, learning, liberality and enjoyment of the person born will be at the lowest, middling or highest respectively.

interpretation.detailed: Varishtha Yoga (also called Vara) is formed when the Moon occupies an Apoklima house (3rd, 6th, 9th, or 12th) from the Sun's position. Effects: the native's wealth, vehicles, fame, happiness, knowledge, intellectual precision, modesty, ability, learning, liberality, and enjoyment are all at the highest possible level. Highest level in wealth, vehicles, fame, happiness, knowledge, modesty, ability, learning, liberality, and enjoyment.
interpretation.summary: When the Moon is in an Apoklima house from the Sun, Varishtha (Vara) Yoga forms. Native's wealth, fame, happiness, knowledge, learning, etc. are all at the highest level.

condition.description: Moon in Apoklima from Sun

source.original_text: If all the benefic planets occupy Upachaya houses whether reckoned from the Lagna or the Moon, the resulting Yoga is termed Vasumati. The person born in the Vasumati Yoga will always keep to his house, and will command plenty of money.

interpretation.detailed: Vasumati Yoga is formed when all benefic planets (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury, Moon) occupy Upachaya houses (3rd, 6th, 10th, or 11th) counted from the Lagna or from the Moon's position. Effects: always keeps to his house; commands plenty of money. Always stays home; commands plenty of money.
interpretation.summary: When all benefic planets occupy Upachaya houses (3rd, 6th, 10th, 11th) from the Lagna or Moon, Vasumati Yoga forms. Native stays home, commands plenty of money.

condition.description: All benefics in Upachaya houses (3/6/10/11) from Lagna or Moon

source.original_text: If the lord of the Rasi occupied by the Moon is in conjunction with the lord of the Lagna and be posited in a Kendra or in the house of a very friendly planet and if at the same time a benefic planet possessing strength aspects the Lagna, the resulting Yoga is called Pushkala.

interpretation.detailed: Pushkala Yoga requires: (1) The lord of the sign occupied by the Moon is in conjunction with the lord of the Lagna; (2) this conjunction is positioned in a Kendra house or in the sign of a very friendly planet; (3) simultaneously, a strong benefic planet aspects the Lagna. Effects: wealthy; honoured by kings; famous; decorated with beautiful ornaments and clothes; sweet-tongued; supremely good; a lord. Wealthy, honoured by kings, famous, decorated, sweet-tongued, supremely good, a lord.
interpretation.summary: Pushkala Yoga: Moon's dispositor conjunct Lagna lord in Kendra or very friendly sign, AND a strong benefic aspects the Lagna. Native is wealthy, honoured by kings, famous, sweet-tongued.

condition.description: Moon's sign lord conjunct Lagna lord in Kendra or friendly sign, AND strong benefic aspects Lagna

source.original_text: The person born in a Sumala Yoga will be a governor (or director), will be extolled by Kings and will be devoted to enjoyment. He will be liberal in gifts, helpful to others in getting their work done, and will love his relations. He will be blessed with a good wife and sons and will be courageous.

interpretation.detailed: Subhamala Yoga is formed when benefic planets occupy the 5th, 6th, and 7th houses in that regular sequential order. Effects: governor or director; extolled by kings; devoted to enjoyment; liberal in gifts; helpful to others in getting their work done; loves his relations; blessed with good wife and sons; courageous. Governor; extolled by kings; devoted to enjoyment; liberal; helpful; good wife and sons; courageous.
interpretation.summary: When benefic planets occupy the 5th, 6th, and 7th houses in regular order, Subhamala Yoga forms. Native is a governor, extolled by kings, devoted to enjoyment, liberal, courageous.

condition.description: Benefic planets in 5th, 6th, and 7th houses in sequential order

source.original_text: He who is born in an Asubhamalika Yoga will resort to bad ways, will be unhappy, will tease or kill others, will be ungrateful, will be timid, will have no reverence for Brahmins, will be cursed by the public and will be fond of (promoting) quarrels.

interpretation.detailed: Asubhamala Yoga is formed when malefic planets occupy the 8th, 6th, and 12th houses. Effects: resorts to bad ways; unhappy; teases or kills others; ungrateful; timid; no reverence for Brahmins; cursed by the public; fond of promoting quarrels. Bad ways, unhappy, teases/kills others, ungrateful, timid, promotes quarrels, cursed by public.
interpretation.summary: When malefics occupy the 8th, 6th, and 12th houses, Asubhamala Yoga forms. Native resorts to bad ways, unhappy, teases/kills others, ungrateful, timid, promotes quarrels.

condition.description: Malefics in 8th, 6th, and 12th houses

source.original_text: The person born in a Lakshmi Yoga will ever be sporting with a damsel of a very amiable disposition. He will be free from disease, wealthy and brilliant. He will protect all his people. He will be the best of Kings pleasing all his subjects and liberal in his gifts.

interpretation.detailed: Lakshmi Yoga is formed when the lord of the 9th house and Venus are both posited in their own or exaltation signs, AND those signs simultaneously constitute a Trikona (5th or 9th) or Kendra (1st, 4th, 7th, 10th) house. Effects: ever sporting with an amiable damsel; free from disease; wealthy and brilliant; protects all his people; recipient of Goddess Lakshmi's blessings; travels in beautiful palanquins/horseback/elephant; best of kings; pleases all subjects; liberal in gifts. Best of kings; disease-free; wealthy and brilliant; protects people; liberal in gifts.
interpretation.summary: When the 9th lord and Venus are both in own or exaltation sign AND that sign is a Trikona or Kendra, Lakshmi Yoga forms. Native is the best of kings, disease-free, wealthy, brilliant.

condition.description: 9th lord and Venus in own/exaltation sign that is a Trikona or Kendra

source.original_text: The person born in the Gouri Yoga will have a beautiful body, will come of an illustrious family, and will be a friend of the sovereign. His sons will be of a very good character. He will have a lotus-like face, and his success (over his opponents) will be praised by one and all.

interpretation.detailed: Gauri Yoga is formed when the Moon is positioned in its own sign (Karkataka) or exaltation sign (Vrishabha at 3 degrees), AND that sign constitutes a Trikona or Kendra house, AND the Moon is aspected by Jupiter. Effects: beautiful body; comes of an illustrious family; friend of the sovereign; sons of very good character; lotus-like face; success over opponents praised by all. Beautiful body, illustrious family, friend of sovereign, sons of good character, lotus face, praised for success.
interpretation.summary: When the Moon is in its own/exaltation sign in a Trikona or Kendra AND aspected by Jupiter, Gauri Yoga forms. Native has beautiful body, illustrious family, friend of sovereign, lotus-face.

condition.description: Moon in own/exaltation in Trikona or Kendra, aspected by Jupiter

source.original_text: The person who has his birth in the Saraswati Yoga is highly intelligent, clever in dramaturgy, in prose composition, versifying, accounts and poetics. He is skilled in poetry, in narrative composition and in the exposition of sacred texts. His fame has spread over the three worlds. He is exceedingly wealthy, and is endowed with wife and children. He is fortunate, and commands respect from the best of kings.

interpretation.detailed: Saraswati Yoga requires: (1) Venus, Jupiter, AND Mercury each occupy a Kendra (1/4/7/10), a Trikona (5/9), or the 2nd house; (2) Jupiter is additionally in its exaltation (Karkataka), own sign (Dhanus or Meena), or a friendly sign AND possesses strength. Effects: highly intelligent; skilled in dramaturgy, prose composition, versifying, accounts, poetics, narratives, and exposition of sacred texts; fame spread over the three worlds; exceedingly wealthy; endowed with wife and children; fortunate; commands respect from the best of kings. Highly intelligent; skilled in all literary arts; famous in three worlds; exceedingly wealthy; wife/children; respected by kings.
interpretation.summary: When Venus, Jupiter, and Mercury all occupy Kendra, Trikona, or 2nd house, AND Jupiter is additionally in exaltation/own/friendly with strength, Saraswati Yoga forms. Native is highly intelligent, literary, famous in three worlds, wealthy.

condition.description: All three in Kendra/Trikona/2nd; Jupiter additionally in exaltation/own/friendly with strength

source.original_text: The person born in the Srikantha Yoga will be decked with Rudraksha rosaries, with his body made white by the besmearing of the sacred ashes. He will be magnanimous, and will be always meditating at heart on God Siva. He will rigidly observe prescribed rites and will be consecrated to the worship of God Siva.

interpretation.detailed: Srikantha Yoga is formed when the lord of the Lagna, the Sun, and the Moon are all three positioned in a Kendra (1/4/7/10) or Trikona (5/9) house AND each occupies its exaltation, own, or friendly sign. Effects: decked with Rudraksha rosaries; body besmeared with sacred ashes; magnanimous; always meditating on God Siva; rigidly observes prescribed Shaivite rites; consecrated to Siva worship; helps the virtuous; free from malice toward other creeds; powerful; heart delighted by Siva worship. Devoted Shaivite; magnanimous; powerful; helps the virtuous; free from malice.
interpretation.summary: When the Lagna lord, Sun, and Moon are all three in Kendra or Trikona houses AND in exaltation/own/friendly signs, Srikantha Yoga forms. Native is a devoted Shaivite, magnanimous, powerful.

condition.description: All three in Kendra or Trikona in exaltation/own/friendly sign

source.original_text: The person born in the Srinatha Yoga will be wealthy, resplendant and clever in speaking agreeably and in a humorous vein. He will have marks of God Narayana on body. He will be always reciting the name of that God. He will be endowed with a good wife and sons.

interpretation.detailed: Srinatha Yoga is formed when Venus, the lord of the 9th house, and Mercury are all three positioned in a Kendra or Trikona house AND each occupies its exaltation, own, or friendly sign. Effects: wealthy; resplendent; clever in agreeable and humorous speech; has marks of God Narayana (Sankha, Chakra etc.) on body; always reciting Narayana's name with the virtuous; happy in reverencing Narayana's devotees; endowed with good wife and sons; loved by all; exceedingly amiable. Devoted Vaishnava; wealthy; resplendent; clever humorous speaker; good wife and sons; loved by all.
interpretation.summary: When Venus, the 9th lord, and Mercury are all three in Kendra or Trikona in exaltation/own/friendly signs, Srinatha Yoga forms. Native is a devoted Vaishnava, wealthy, resplendent, good wife/sons.

condition.description: All three in Kendra or Trikona in exaltation/own/friendly sign

source.original_text: The person born in the Virinchi Yoga will be fully absorbed in the knowledge of Brahma. He will be highly intelligent and will assign a predominant position to the Vedas over other sacred writings. He will be endowed with all good qualities and will be always glad at heart. He will have a good number of distinguished disciples.

interpretation.detailed: Virinchi Yoga is formed when Jupiter, the lord of the 5th house, and Saturn are all three positioned in a Kendra or Trikona house AND each occupies its exaltation, own, or friendly sign. Effects: fully absorbed in knowledge of Brahma; highly intelligent; assigns predominance to the Vedas; endowed with all good qualities; always glad at heart; does not swerve from Vedic conduct; has good number of distinguished disciples; gentle in speech; wealthy, good wife and sons; long life; senses under control; saluted by kings. Absorbed in Brahma knowledge; learned in Vedas; distinguished disciples; long life; wealthy; saluted by kings.
interpretation.summary: When Jupiter, the 5th lord, and Saturn are all three in Kendra or Trikona in exaltation/own/friendly signs, Virinchi Yoga forms. Native is absorbed in Brahma knowledge, learned in Vedas, has distinguished disciples.

condition.description: All three in Kendra or Trikona in exaltation/own/friendly sign

source.original_text: The man born in a Dainya Yoga will be a fool, will be reviling others and commit sinful actions. He will always be tormented by his enemies, will speak woundingly and will be unsteady in mind. Interruptions will arise to all his undertakings.

interpretation.detailed: Dainya Yoga arises from Parivartana (mutual sign exchange between two planets each owning a Bhava) when one of the participating lords is the lord of the 6th, 8th, or 12th house. There are 30 such combinations: 11 involving the 12th lord, 10 involving the 6th lord, 9 involving the 8th lord. Effects: fool; reviles others; commits sinful actions; always tormented by enemies; speaks woundingly; unsteady mind; interruptions to all undertakings. Fool, sinful actions, tormented by enemies, wounding speech, unsteady mind, interrupted undertakings.
interpretation.summary: When a mutual sign exchange (Parivartana) involves the lord of the 6th, 8th, or 12th house, Dainya Yoga forms (30 possible combinations). Native is a fool, sinful, tormented by enemies, mentally unsteady, undertakings interrupted.

condition.description: Mutual sign exchange where one lord is 6th/8th/12th lord (30 combinations)

source.original_text: The man born in the Khala Yoga will at one time go astray, while at another time gentle in speech. Sometimes he will regain all kinds of prosperity, while at other times he will have to endure much distress, poverty, misery and the like.

interpretation.detailed: Khala Yoga arises from Parivartana where one of the participating lords is the 3rd house lord (but none of the 6th, 8th, or 12th lords). There are 8 such combinations: the 3rd lord in exchange with any of the 1st, 2nd, 4th, 5th, 7th, 9th, 10th, or 11th. Effects: at one time goes astray, at another time gentle in speech; sometimes regains all kinds of prosperity, other times endures much distress, poverty, and misery. This yoga indicates an unstable, fluctuating life pattern. Alternates between going astray and gentleness; alternates between prosperity and distress/poverty/misery.
interpretation.summary: When a mutual sign exchange involves the 3rd lord (but not 6th/8th/12th lords), Khala Yoga forms (8 combinations). Native alternates between going astray and gentleness; between prosperity and distress.

condition.description: Mutual sign exchange where one lord is 3rd lord (not 6th/8th/12th) — 8 combinations

source.original_text: The person born in a Maha Yoga will be the repository of the blessings of the Goddess Sri and will be a lord and wealthy. He will wear clothes of variegated colour and bedeck himself with gold ornaments. He will receive rich presents from his sovereign and certain powers (authority) also will be conferred on him. He will command vehicles, wealth and children.

interpretation.detailed: Maha Yoga arises from Parivartana among the lords of good houses (1st, 2nd, 4th, 5th, 7th, 9th, 10th, or 11th) — none of the 3rd, 6th, 8th, or 12th lords involved. There are 28 such combinations. Effects: repository of blessings of Goddess Sri (Lakshmi); lord and wealthy; wears variegated-coloured clothes; bedecked with gold ornaments; receives rich presents and authority from sovereign; commands vehicles, wealth, and children. Blessed by Goddess Sri; lord and wealthy; receives gifts and authority from sovereign; vehicles, wealth, children.
interpretation.summary: When mutual sign exchange is among the lords of good houses (not 3rd/6th/8th/12th), Maha Yoga forms (28 combinations). Native is wealthy, blessed by Goddess Sri, receives gifts from sovereign, commands vehicles.

condition.description: Mutual sign exchange among lords of good houses (1/2/4/5/7/9/10/11) — 28 combinations

source.original_text: There are 66 such interchanges caused by the several pairs of Bhava-lords beginning from the Lagna and ending with the 12th. Out of these, 30 are caused by the lords of the 6th, 8th and 12th and are termed Dainya Yogas and 8 are caused by the lord of the 3rd; these 8 are called Khala Yogas. The remaining 28 are termed Maha Yogas.

interpretation.detailed: There are 66 total Parivartana (mutual sign exchange) combinations across all pairs of Bhava lords from 1st through 12th. Classification: 30 are Dainya Yogas (when the 6th, 8th, or 12th lord is involved); 8 are Khala Yogas (when the 3rd lord is involved but not 6th/8th/12th); 28 are Maha Yogas (all remaining exchanges among good house lords). Total: 30 + 8 + 28 = 66. 66 total Parivartanas: 30 Dainya + 8 Khala + 28 Maha.
interpretation.summary: Engine-specification: Total Parivartana combinations = 66. Dainya (involving 6th/8th/12th lord) = 30. Khala (involving 3rd lord) = 8. Maha (remaining good house exchanges) = 28.

condition.description: Classification of 66 Parivartana combinations

source.original_text: He who is born in the Kahala Yoga will thrive well, will be noble, benevolent, kind and propitious. He will be respected by other men.

interpretation.detailed: Kahala Yoga requires a 3-step positional chain: (1) Find what sign the Lagna lord occupies; (2) Find the lord of that sign; (3) Find what sign THAT lord occupies; (4) If the lord of THAT third sign is in its exaltation or own sign AND that sign is a Trikona (5th/9th) or Kendra (1st/4th/7th/10th), Kahala Yoga is formed. Effects: thrives well; noble; benevolent; kind; propitious; respected by other men. Thrives well, noble, benevolent, kind, propitious, respected by other men.
interpretation.summary: 3-step chain: Lagna lord's position → lord of that sign → lord of that sign's position → if in exaltation/own in Trikona/Kendra, Kahala Yoga. Native thrives, is noble, benevolent, respected.

condition.description: 3-step chain from Lagna lord — third lord in chain in exaltation/own in Trikona or Kendra

source.original_text: The person who is born in the Parvata Yoga will have everlasting wealth and happiness. He will do acts causing eternal benefit. He will become the lord of the Earth.

interpretation.detailed: Parvata Yoga requires a 2-step positional chain: (1) Find what sign the Lagna lord occupies; (2) Find the lord of that sign; (3) If THAT lord (second in chain) is in its exaltation or own sign AND that sign is a Trikona (5th/9th) or Kendra (1st/4th/7th/10th), Parvata Yoga is formed. Effects: everlasting wealth and happiness; does acts causing eternal benefit; becomes lord of the Earth. Everlasting wealth and happiness; does acts causing eternal benefit; lord of the Earth.
interpretation.summary: 2-step chain: Lagna lord's position → lord of that sign — if in exaltation/own in Trikona/Kendra, Parvata Yoga. Native has everlasting wealth and happiness, lord of the earth.

condition.description: 2-step chain from Lagna lord — dispositor of Lagna lord in exaltation/own in Trikona or Kendra

source.original_text: The person who has his birth in a Raja Yoga will be a King who (when he set out) will be accompanied by elephants, horses, litters, palanquins and the like, the roaring of kettle drums and the sounds of the conch shell, with a circular umbrella made of soft woven cloth held over him, praised by bards and minstrels and solicited by eminent men with various kinds of presents in their hands.

interpretation.detailed: Raja Yoga (this specific variant) is formed when the lords of the 9th house and the 10th house are in conjunction (together in the same house) in an auspicious Bhava — i.e., not in the 6th, 8th, or 12th house. Effects: becomes a king; accompanied by elephants, horses, litters, and palanquins; roaring of kettle drums and conch shells; circular umbrella of soft woven cloth held over him; praised by bards and minstrels; solicited by eminent men bearing presents. King; accompanied by royal pomp — elephants, horses, palanquins, drums, umbrella; praised by bards; solicited by eminent men.
interpretation.summary: When the lords of the 9th and 10th houses are in conjunction in a good (non-Dusthana) house, Raja Yoga forms. Native is a king accompanied by royal pomp and ceremony.

source.original_text: The person born in Sankha Yoga will enjoy all comforts in the company of many beautiful damsels.

interpretation.detailed: Sankha Yoga is formed when the lord of a Kendra house (1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th) and the lord of a Kona house (5th or 9th) are in conjunction in an auspicious Bhava (non-Dusthana house). Effects: enjoys all comforts in the company of many beautiful damsels. Enjoys all comforts in the company of many beautiful damsels.
interpretation.summary: When the lord of a Kendra and the lord of a Kona are in conjunction in a good house, Sankha Yoga forms. Native enjoys all comforts in the company of many beautiful damsels.

source.original_text: The person born in the Veena Yoga will be fond of dancing and music and will be wealthy.

interpretation.detailed: Veena Yoga (also called Vallaki) is the highest of seven Sankhya Yogas, formed when the seven planets occupy seven different signs (all seven Rasis are occupied — each planet in a distinct sign). These Sankhya Yogas are reckoned only when the previously described yogas (Pancha Mahapurusha, lunar yogas, etc.) are absent. Effects: fond of dancing and music; wealthy. Fond of dancing and music; wealthy.
interpretation.summary: When all seven planets are distributed across seven different signs, Veena (Vallaki) Yoga forms. Native is fond of dancing and music, and wealthy. Applies when other major yogas are absent.

condition.description: Seven planets occupy seven different signs (all 7 signs occupied, each uniquely)

source.original_text: The man born in the Dama Yoga will be very liberal, a King and a benefactor.

interpretation.detailed: Dama Yoga is formed when the seven planets collectively occupy six different signs (one sign has two planets). Effects: very liberal; a king; a benefactor. Very liberal; a king; a benefactor.
interpretation.summary: When all seven planets occupy only six different signs, Dama Yoga forms. Native is very liberal, a king, and a benefactor.

condition.description: Seven planets occupy six different signs

source.original_text: The person whose birth takes place in the Pasa Yoga will be opulent, devoted to enjoyment, and have good conduct and relatives.

interpretation.detailed: Pasa Yoga is formed when the seven planets collectively occupy five different signs. Effects: opulent; devoted to enjoyment; good conduct; good relatives. Opulent; devoted to enjoyment; good conduct; good relatives.
interpretation.summary: When all seven planets occupy only five different signs, Pasa Yoga forms. Native is opulent, devoted to enjoyment, and has good conduct and relatives.

condition.description: Seven planets occupy five different signs

source.original_text: The man who has the Kedara Yoga in his nativity will be endowed with wealth and agricultural lands.

interpretation.detailed: Kedara Yoga is formed when the seven planets collectively occupy four different signs. Effects: endowed with wealth and agricultural lands. Endowed with wealth and agricultural lands.
interpretation.summary: When all seven planets occupy only four different signs, Kedara Yoga forms. Native is endowed with wealth and agricultural lands.

condition.description: Seven planets occupy four different signs

source.original_text: The person born in the Sula Yoga will be cruel, of an angry temperament, and indigent.

interpretation.detailed: Sula Yoga is formed when the seven planets collectively occupy three different signs. Effects: cruel; angry temperament; indigent (poor). Cruel; angry temperament; indigent (poor).
interpretation.summary: When all seven planets occupy only three different signs, Sula Yoga forms. Native is cruel, angry, indigent.

condition.description: Seven planets occupy three different signs

source.original_text: The man whose birth is in the Yuga Yoga will be heretical and without wealth.

interpretation.detailed: Yuga Yoga is formed when the seven planets collectively occupy only two different signs. Effects: heretical (disbeliever in orthodox religion); without wealth. Heretical; without wealth.
interpretation.summary: When all seven planets occupy only two different signs, Yuga Yoga forms. Native is heretical and without wealth.

condition.description: Seven planets occupy two different signs

source.original_text: He who is born in the Gola Yoga will be without wealth, will commit sinful deeds, and associate with low people. He will be a bad artisan, indolent and short-lived.

interpretation.detailed: Gola Yoga is the lowest of seven Sankhya Yogas, formed when all seven planets collectively occupy one single sign. Effects: without wealth; commits sinful deeds; associates with low people; bad artisan; indolent; short-lived. Without wealth; sinful deeds; associates with low people; bad artisan; indolent; short-lived.
interpretation.summary: When all seven planets are in a single sign, Gola Yoga forms. Native is without wealth, sinful, associates with low people, bad artisan, indolent, short-lived.

condition.description: All seven planets in one single sign

source.original_text: When benefic planets occupy the 7th, the 6th and the 8th places reckoned from the Moon or the Lagna, there results what is called the Adhiyoga wherein takes place the birth of a Commander, a minister or a ruler respectively. He who is born in the Adhiyoga becomes famous, prosperous, wealthy, long-lived and high-souled.

interpretation.detailed: Adhiyoga is formed when benefic planets occupy the 7th, 6th, and 8th houses counted from the Moon or the Lagna. The specific house determines the native's role: benefics in the 7th → Commander (Police Superintendent or head); benefics in the 6th → Minister; benefics in the 8th → Ruler (of a District or Province). General effects for all Adhiyoga forms: becomes the lord of men; everlasting wealth; feeds many relations; overthrows enemies; long life; widely renowned; famous; prosperous; high-souled. Commander (7th) / Minister (6th) / Ruler (8th); famous, prosperous, wealthy, long-lived, high-souled.
interpretation.summary: Benefics in 7th from Moon/Lagna → Commander. Benefics in 6th → Minister. Benefics in 8th → Ruler (District/Province). All forms: famous, prosperous, wealthy, long-lived.

source.original_text: The person born in the Chamara yoga will every day be growing in importance like the waxing Moon and will be of a virtuous disposition. He will become famous, a leader of men, long-lived and a store-house of prosperity.

interpretation.detailed: Chamara Yoga is the auspicious 1st-house Bhava yoga, formed when the 1st house (Lagna) is occupied or aspected by benefics AND the Lagna lord is in a good (non-Dusthana) house, brilliant, or in exaltation/own sign. Effects: every day grows in importance like the waxing Moon; virtuous disposition; famous; leader of men; long-lived; store-house of prosperity. Grows daily in importance; famous; leader of men; long-lived; store-house of prosperity.
