The specific piles disease association is notable as it reflects Saturn's classical body-part assignation. Unclean; no wealth; suffers from piles; cruel-minded; pinched with hunger; despised by friends
interpretation.summary: Saturn in the 8th house produces a wretched existence: uncleanliness, poverty, the disease of piles, cruelty of mind, chronic hunger, and rejection by friends.

source.original_text: If Saturn be in the 9th house, the person will be bereft of fortune, wealth, children, father, and religious merit, and will be wicked.

interpretation.detailed: Saturn placed in the 9th house (Dharma Bhava — house of fortune, father, religion, and merit) produces a comprehensive destruction of all 9th house significations. Fortune is absent. Wealth is gone. Children are absent. The father is lost or estranged. Religious merit (punya) is lacking. Wickedness characterizes the moral disposition. The 9th house governs dharma, luck, and the father's wellbeing — Saturn in the house of fortune systematically destroys each of its traditional significations while imposing its characteristic heaviness, deprivation, and moral inversion. This is one of Saturn's most adverse house placements in Chapter 8. Bereft of fortune, wealth, children, father, and religious merit; wicked
interpretation.summary: Saturn in the 9th house produces total deprivation of the 9th house's significations — fortune, wealth, children, father, and merit — alongside wickedness.

source.original_text: If Saturn be in the 10th house, the person will be a King or a minister, will be devoted to agriculture, will be brave, rich, and renowned.

interpretation.detailed: Saturn placed in the 10th house (Karma Bhava — house of career, action, and authority) produces excellent outcomes, as Saturn gains directional strength (dig bala) in the 7th house, not the 10th — but the 10th is still a highly auspicious placement for career outcomes. The native is a king or minister — the highest political and administrative positions. Devoted to agriculture — Saturn's association with land, labor, and the earth expressed through the 10th house of career produces a strong agricultural orientation (including management of agricultural estates or practical earthwork). Brave. Rich. Renowned. Saturn in the 10th is one of the most consistently cited positive Saturn placements in classical Jyotish, reflecting the principle that Saturn's qualities of persistence, discipline, and hard work produce maximum results in the house of karma and public life. King or minister; devoted to agriculture; brave; rich; renowned
interpretation.summary: Saturn in the 10th house produces kingly or ministerial authority, agricultural devotion, bravery, wealth, and renown.

source.original_text: If Saturn be in the 11th house, the person will have a long span of life, lasting wealth, good income, will be brave, disease-free, and moneyed.

interpretation.detailed: Saturn placed in the 11th house (Labha Bhava — house of gains) produces excellent outcomes, fully consistent with the classical principle that Saturn thrives in upachaya (growing) houses. The 11th is Saturn's strongest upachaya house. Long span of life — Saturn's natural longevity-granting quality expressed in the house of gains produces exceptional lifespan. Lasting wealth — not just wealth but enduring, permanent wealth. Good income. Brave. Disease-free — a notable quality given Saturn's usual disease associations. Moneyed. The 11th house channels Saturn's endurance, patience, and discipline into sustained material accumulation and long life. This is Saturn's single best house placement in Chapter 8. Long span of life; lasting wealth; good income; brave; disease-free; moneyed
interpretation.summary: Saturn in the 11th house — an upachaya house — grants exceptional long life, enduring wealth, good income, bravery, and freedom from disease.

source.original_text: If Saturn be in the 12th house, the person will be impudent, indigent, will have no children, will have a defective limb, will be stupid, and will be driven out by enemies.

interpretation.detailed: Saturn placed in the 12th house (Vyaya Bhava — house of loss, confinement, and dissolution) produces comprehensive adversity. Impudence (shamelessness, lack of social decorum). Indigent (extreme poverty). No children. A defective or injured limb — Saturn's chronic and structural quality in the house of bodily loss. Stupidity or dullness of intellect. Driven out by enemies — forced to flee from one's place by the power of opponents. The 12th house amplifies Saturn's negative qualities (isolation, deprivation, confinement, loss) rather than providing any upachaya benefit. Saturn in the 12th produces the most severe adverse outcomes in Saturn's house series alongside the 8th and 9th. Impudent; indigent; no children; defective limb; stupid; driven out by enemies
interpretation.summary: Saturn in the 12th house produces shamelessness, poverty, childlessness, physical defect, stupidity, and exile by enemies.

source.original_text: If Rahu be in the Lagna (1st house), the person will have a short life, wealth, strength, and will suffer from diseases in the higher limbs (head and face).

interpretation.detailed: Rahu placed in the 1st house (Lagna) produces a mixed outcome. Short life — Rahu's malefic quality reducing longevity when placed in the house of self and body. Wealth — a notable positive outcome (Rahu in the Lagna can produce material gains through unconventional means). Strength — physical power. Diseases in the higher limbs, specifically the head and face — Rahu's association with unusual or mysterious diseases, and its affliction of the Lagna producing health issues in the head region (the Lagna governs the head in the natural kalapurusha). The combination of short life with wealth and strength suggests the native lives powerfully but briefly. Rahu and Ketu are included in Chapter 8's house analysis — a comprehensive treatment covering all nine grahas including the shadow planets. Short life; wealth; strength; diseases in higher limbs (head and face)
interpretation.summary: Rahu in the Lagna produces short life but wealth and strength, with diseases specifically affecting the head and face.

source.original_text: If Rahu be in the 2nd house, the person will have dubious or insincere speech, will suffer from disease in the mouth and face, will be tender-hearted, will acquire wealth through the sovereign, will be wrathful, and happy.

interpretation.detailed: Rahu placed in the 2nd house (Dhana Bhava — house of speech, wealth, and face) produces a complex multi-quality profile. Speech is dubious or insincere — Rahu's deceptive quality expressed through the house of speech. Disease in the mouth and face. Tender-hearted — an unexpectedly gentle quality for Rahu, suggesting emotional softness beneath the harsh exterior. Wealth is acquired through the sovereign or government — Rahu's ambition and cleverness in the house of wealth gains through royal or governmental patronage. Wrathful — anger as a characteristic quality. Happy — a broadly positive emotional baseline despite the other negative qualities. The breadth and contradictory nature of the outcome description reflects Rahu's inherently paradoxical and unpredictable nature. Dubious or insincere speech; disease in mouth/face; tender-hearted; wealth through sovereign; wrathful; happy
interpretation.summary: Rahu in the 2nd house produces dubious speech, oral diseases, tenderness of heart, royal wealth, anger, and happiness — a complex mixed profile.

source.original_text: If Rahu be in the 3rd house, the person will be proud, hostile to brothers, strong-willed, long-lived, and wealthy.

interpretation.detailed: Rahu placed in the 3rd house (Sahaja Bhava — house of siblings, courage, and effort) produces a mixed profile with strong positive outcomes. Proud — self-assertion and ego in the house of courage. Hostile to brothers — the sibling relationship is adversarial; Rahu's malefic quality in the 3rd house strains relations with co-born. Strong-willed — firm, determined, and difficult to dissuade. Long-lived — a notable positive outcome for a malefic. Wealthy — material gains. The combination of willpower, wealth, and longevity alongside pride and sibling hostility reflects Rahu's characteristic pattern of material success accompanied by social friction. Proud; hostile to brothers; strong-willed; long-lived; wealthy
interpretation.summary: Rahu in the 3rd house produces pride, hostility toward siblings, strong willpower, long life, and wealth.

source.original_text: If Rahu be in the 4th house, the person will be a fool, will cause sorrow, will have friends, will be short-lived, and happy at times.

interpretation.detailed: Rahu placed in the 4th house (Sukha Bhava — house of mother, home, and happiness) produces mostly adverse outcomes. Foolishness — intellectual dullness or poor judgment in domestic matters. The native causes sorrow to others — an unusual description suggesting the native's actions or personality create distress in those around them. Friends are present — one of the few positive notes. Short-lived — reduced lifespan. Happy at times — only occasional happiness rather than sustained contentment. Rahu in the 4th disrupts the house of domestic happiness and emotional security, producing a native whose own foolishness and sorrowful influence prevent sustained domestic contentment. Fool; causes sorrow; has friends; short-lived; happy at times
interpretation.summary: Rahu in the 4th house produces foolishness, causing sorrow to others, some friends, short life, and only occasional happiness.

source.original_text: If Rahu be in the 5th house, the person will talk through the nose, will be childless, will be hard-hearted, and will suffer from belly-ache.

interpretation.detailed: Rahu placed in the 5th house (Putra Bhava — house of children, intelligence, and speech style) produces adverse outcomes. Nasal speech — the native speaks through the nose, an unusual physical speech characteristic associated with Rahu's position in the house governing communication style and personality expression. Childlessness — Rahu in the 5th destroys the house's primary signification of progeny. Hard-hearted — emotional coldness and lack of compassion, a Rahu quality in the trikona of merit inverting its positive emotional significations. Belly-ache or abdominal disease — a specific health affliction. The nasal speech quality is unique to Rahu's 5th house placement and not found in other planets' descriptions. Talks through nose; childless; hard-hearted; suffers belly-ache
interpretation.summary: Rahu in the 5th house produces nasal speech patterns, childlessness, hard-heartedness, and abdominal ailments.

source.original_text: If Rahu be in the 6th house, the person will be troubled by enemies and malefic planets, will suffer from disease in the anus, will be wealthy, and long-lived.

interpretation.detailed: Rahu placed in the 6th house (Ripu Bhava — house of enemies and disease) produces a mixed outcome. Troubled by enemies and by malefic planets — the native faces opposition from both human foes and from planetary afflictions in the chart. Disease in the anus — a specific body-part disease association for Rahu in the 6th, reflecting Rahu's classical body-part associations and the 6th house's disease signification. Wealthy — an upachaya benefit. Long-lived — a notable longevity grant for a shadow planet in the upachaya. The anus-disease specificity is unique to Rahu's 6th house placement and constitutes one of the most specific disease-location predictions in Chapter 8. Troubled by enemies and malefic planets; disease in anus; wealthy; long-lived
interpretation.summary: Rahu in the 6th house produces enemy trouble, affliction by malefics, anal disease, but also wealth and long life.

source.original_text: If Rahu be in the 7th house, the person will lose wealth through women, will be separated from his beloved, will lose his manhood, will be self-willed, and silly.

interpretation.detailed: Rahu placed in the 7th house (Kalatra Bhava — house of spouse, partnerships, and desire) produces adverse outcomes across all its significations. Wealth is lost through women — Rahu's deceptive quality in the house of partnerships leads to financial exploitation or ruin through female associations. Separation from the beloved — loss of the romantic or marital partner through Rahu's separating, isolating quality. Loss of manhood — sexual power or virility diminished. Self-willed — obstinate, refusing guidance or counsel. Silly — foolish behavior and poor judgment in partnerships. Rahu in the 7th is a classic indicator of romantic and marital disruption, and the 'loss of wealth through women' pattern specifically appears in multiple classical texts for this placement. Loses wealth through women; separated from beloved; loses manhood; self-willed; silly
interpretation.summary: Rahu in the 7th house causes financial loss through women, separation from loved ones, loss of virility, self-willedness, and foolish behavior.

source.original_text: If Rahu be in the 8th house, the person will be short-lived, will do impure acts, will have defective limbs, will suffer from wind-disease, and will have limited issue.

interpretation.detailed: Rahu placed in the 8th house (Ayu Bhava) produces severe adverse outcomes. Short-lived — Rahu's malefic quality in the house of longevity directly reduces lifespan. Impure acts — morally corrupt conduct. Defective limbs — physical deformity or injury. Wind-disease (vata dosha disorder) — Rahu is classically associated with vata (wind/air) constitution disturbances, and placed in the house of chronic illness produces wind-type diseases (joint pain, neurological disorders, anxiety, etc.). Limited issue (few children). Rahu in the 8th combines the shadow planet's naturally inauspicious quality with the house of obstacles and death, producing one of the more straightforwardly adverse outcomes in Rahu's house series. Short-lived; impure acts; defective limb; wind-disease; limited issue
interpretation.summary: Rahu in the 8th house produces short life, moral impurity, physical defects, vata (wind) disease, and few children.

source.original_text: If Rahu be in the 9th house, the person will speak opposingly, will be head of his clan, village, or city, and will commit unrighteous deeds.

interpretation.detailed: Rahu placed in the 9th house (Dharma Bhava — house of righteousness, father, and fortune) produces a paradoxical profile. Speaks opposingly — the native takes contrary positions in speech and argument, going against the prevailing view. Head of clan, village, or city — a leadership position over communities, suggesting material authority and social prominence. Commits unrighteous deeds — adharmic conduct despite or alongside the social authority. Rahu in the 9th house of dharma inverts the dharmic signification while preserving social leadership. The 'speaking opposingly' quality reflects Rahu's disruptive, unconventional quality in the house of orthodox wisdom and dharmic speech. Speaks opposingly; head of clan/village/city; commits unrighteous deeds
interpretation.summary: Rahu in the 9th house produces a contradictory speaker who leads communities but engages in adharmic conduct.

source.original_text: If Rahu be in the 10th house, the person will be famous, will have limited issue, will engage in others' business, will do no good acts, and will be fearless.

interpretation.detailed: Rahu placed in the 10th house (Karma Bhava — house of career and public life) produces a fame-oriented but morally compromised career. The native is famous — wide public recognition. Limited issue (few children). Engages in others' business — the native meddles in or profits from others' affairs (possibly as a broker, agent, or intermediary). Does no good acts — ethical quality of the career is poor. Fearless — a strong, uninhibited quality. Rahu in the 10th produces Rahu's characteristic pattern: public prominence and worldly visibility without the ethical foundation that classical Jyotish associates with a truly auspicious career. The fame is real but morally hollow. Famous; limited issue; engages in others' business; no good acts; fearless
interpretation.summary: Rahu in the 10th house produces fame, fearlessness, and public presence, but also few children, interference in others' affairs, and absence of virtuous deeds.

source.original_text: If Rahu be in the 11th house, the person will be prosperous, will not have many children, will be long-lived, and will suffer from ear disease.

interpretation.detailed: Rahu placed in the 11th house (Labha Bhava — house of gains) produces a mostly positive material outcome with two limitations. Prosperous — financial success and material wellbeing. Not many children — progeny is limited. Long-lived — extended lifespan, notable for a malefic shadow planet. Ear disease — a specific health affliction. Rahu's classical body-part association includes the ears, and placed in the 11th (which in the natural kalapurusha is associated with the left ear), Rahu produces an ear-related disease. The prosperity and longevity in the upachaya 11th house reflect the classical principle that malefics, including shadow planets, perform well in upachaya positions. Prosperous; not many children; long-lived; suffers ear disease
interpretation.summary: Rahu in the 11th house produces prosperity and long life, but few children and a specific ear disease.

source.original_text: If Rahu be in the 12th house, the person will do sinful acts secretly, will spend much, and will suffer from water-disease.

interpretation.detailed: Rahu placed in the 12th house (Vyaya Bhava — house of loss, hidden acts, and confinement) produces outcomes that fit the 12th house's signification of secrecy and concealment. Sinful acts are done secretly — the 12th house's hidden nature combined with Rahu's deceptive quality produces covert moral transgression. Heavy spending — the 12th house is the house of expenditure, and Rahu amplifies the loss of resources. Water-disease — a specific health affliction related to water-element imbalances (edema, kidney disease, water retention, etc.). Rahu's association with unusual diseases and the 12th house's connection to isolation and confinement together produce a health vulnerability through water-element disorders. Sinful acts secretly; spends much; suffers from water-disease
interpretation.summary: Rahu in the 12th house produces secretive sinful conduct, excessive expenditure, and a water-related disease.

source.original_text: If Ketu be in the Lagna (1st house), the person will be ungrateful, unhappy, a tale-bearer, an outcast, will have fallen from his position, will have a deformed body, and will associate with the wicked.

interpretation.detailed: Ketu placed in the 1st house (Lagna) produces entirely adverse outcomes across all significations of the self and body. Ungrateful — lacks appreciation for what is received. Unhappy — sustained emotional misery. Tale-bearer (slanderer) — spreads rumors and gossip. Outcast — socially expelled or marginalized. Fallen from position — degraded from whatever social station was occupied. Deformed body — physical abnormality in the person's body. Associates with the wicked — the social circle consists of morally corrupt individuals. Ketu in the Lagna applies the shadow planet's qualities of dissolution, severance, and spiritual detachment to the house of self and personality, producing a native whose personal identity is characterized by separation, downfall, and social rejection. This is one of the more comprehensive negative Lagna descriptions in Chapter 8. Ungrateful; unhappy; tale-bearer; outcast; fallen from position; deformed body; associates with wicked
interpretation.summary: Ketu in the Lagna produces a comprehensive negative profile: ingratitude, unhappiness, slander, social outcasting, degraded position, physical deformity, and wicked associations.

source.original_text: If Ketu be in the 2nd house, the person will have no learning or riches, will have vile speech, a sinister look, and will eat at others' tables.

interpretation.detailed: Ketu placed in the 2nd house (Dhana Bhava — house of wealth, speech, and face) destroys all the 2nd house's positive significations. No learning — ignorance prevails despite the 2nd house's classical association with learning through family tradition and Guru. No riches — financial deprivation. Vile speech — morally degraded and offensive communication. Sinister look — the face or eyes have a threatening, ominous quality that unsettles others. Eats at others' tables — dependent on charity or others' generosity for food, the most basic form of destitution. Ketu's quality of dissolution and severance in the 2nd house produces the complete negation of accumulated wealth, eloquent speech, and personal dignity. No learning or riches; vile speech; sinister look; eats at others' tables
interpretation.summary: Ketu in the 2nd house produces ignorance, poverty, vile speech, threatening appearance, and dependency on others for food.

source.original_text: If Ketu be in the 3rd house, the person will be long-lived, endowed with strength, wealth, and fame, will be happy with his wife, will have good food, but will lose a brother.

interpretation.detailed: Ketu placed in the 3rd house (Sahaja Bhava — house of siblings, courage, and effort) produces predominantly positive outcomes with one notable loss. Long-lived — extended lifespan. Strength — physical and personal power. Wealth — material prosperity. Fame — public recognition. Happy with wife — marital contentment. Good food — fine eating and material comfort. Loses a brother — the 3rd house's sibling signification is damaged by Ketu, and specifically the loss (death or separation) of a brother is noted. The positive outcomes follow the classical pattern that Ketu in the 3rd (an upachaya house where malefics can perform well) produces material benefits while damaging the house's specific karaka signification (siblings). Long-lived; strength; wealth; fame; happy with wife; good food; but loses brother
interpretation.summary: Ketu in the 3rd house produces long life, strength, wealth, fame, marital happiness, and fine food — but the native loses a sibling.

source.original_text: If Ketu be in the 4th house, the person will lose his lands, vehicles, mother, and happiness, will leave his native country, will live in a foreign place, and will live at the bounty of another.

interpretation.detailed: Ketu placed in the 4th house (Sukha Bhava — house of mother, home, lands, and happiness) produces comprehensive deprivation of all 4th house significations. Lands are lost. Vehicles are lost. The mother is lost (separated from or deceased). Happiness is denied. The native leaves their native country (homeland) and lives in a foreign place — Ketu's quality of displacement and transcendence of boundaries expressed through the 4th house of homeland roots. In the foreign land, the native lives at the bounty of another — dependent on others' charity rather than self-sufficient. Ketu severs the native from all domestic roots, producing a life of foreign dependence. Loses lands, vehicles, mother, and happiness; leaves native country; lives in foreign place at another's bounty
interpretation.summary: Ketu in the 4th house causes loss of all 4th house significations — lands, vehicles, mother, happiness — and exile to a foreign land where the native depends on others.

source.original_text: If Ketu be in the 5th house, the person will have loss of children, will suffer from stomach disease, will be troubled by goblins, will be evil-minded, and wicked.

interpretation.detailed: Ketu placed in the 5th house (Putra Bhava — house of children, intelligence, and merit) produces adverse outcomes. Loss of children — through death, childlessness, or severance. Stomach disease — abdominal or digestive ailment. Trouble from goblins (Bhutas/Pretas) — Ketu's association with the spirit world and paranormal entities produces affliction from supernatural beings or obsession by spirits, a classical Jyotish category of malefic affliction. Evil-minded — corrupted mental disposition. Wicked character. Ketu in the 5th, the trikona of merit and intelligence, inverts the house's positive significations into their dark counterparts: children become losses, intelligence becomes evil-mindedness, and merit becomes wickedness. Loss of children; stomach disease; trouble from goblins; evil-minded; wicked
interpretation.summary: Ketu in the 5th house causes loss of children, abdominal disease, spiritual affliction by evil spirits, and an evil-minded disposition.

source.original_text: If Ketu be in the 6th house, the person will be magnanimous, will have the best qualities, will acquire everlasting fame, firmness, and high authority, will destroy his enemies, and will realise all his wishes.

interpretation.detailed: Ketu placed in the 6th house (Ripu Bhava — house of enemies and competition) produces one of the most comprehensively positive outcomes in Chapter 8 — a striking reversal for a shadow planet. Magnanimous — great-souled and generous. Best qualities — excellence of character across all dimensions. Everlasting fame — permanent, lasting renown that persists beyond a lifetime. Firmness — steadfast and resolute. High authority — a position of significant power. Destroys enemies — complete conquest of opponents. Realises all wishes — every desire is fulfilled. This is the culmination of the classical principle that malefics in the 6th house thrive magnificently. Ketu's spiritually piercing quality, placed in the house of obstacles, converts obstacles into victories and produces the most elevated expression of upachaya house benefit in the entire chapter. Magnanimous; best qualities; everlasting fame; firmness; high authority; destroys enemies; realises all wishes
interpretation.summary: Ketu in the 6th house produces an outstanding profile: great-souled generosity, excellence of character, eternal fame, steadfastness, high authority, victory over enemies, and fulfillment of all desires.

source.original_text: If Ketu be in the 7th house, the person will suffer disrespect, will be in the company of bad women, will suffer from bowel disease, will lose his wife and vital power.

interpretation.detailed: Ketu placed in the 7th house (Kalatra Bhava — house of spouse and partnerships) produces adverse outcomes. Disrespect from others. Company of bad women — association with immoral or disreputable female company. Bowel disease — a specific abdominal/intestinal health affliction. Loss of wife — the spouse is lost through death, separation, or abandonment. Loss of vital power — diminished life-force, sexual vitality, or physical energy. Ketu's severing quality in the 7th house (the house of partnerships and shared resources) severs the native from their partner and vital energy, while producing the social and moral degradation characteristic of Ketu placements in houses of relationship. Disrespect; bad women's company; bowel disease; loss of wife and vital power
interpretation.summary: Ketu in the 7th house produces disrespect, immoral associations, bowel disease, spousal loss, and loss of vitality.

source.original_text: If Ketu be in the 8th house, the person will be short-lived, will be separated from dear friends, will be involved in quarrels, will suffer injury from a weapon, and will be disappointed in all undertakings.

interpretation.detailed: Ketu placed in the 8th house (Ayu Bhava — house of longevity, death, and obstacles) produces severe adverse outcomes. Short-lived — Ketu's severing quality in the house of life itself reduces lifespan dramatically. Separated from dear friends — the native loses close companions through Ketu's isolating, severing quality. Involved in quarrels — frequent conflicts and disputes. Injury from a weapon — physical harm through a weapon, reflecting Ketu's association with sharp instruments and the 8th house's association with violence and sudden harm. Disappointment in all undertakings — a sweeping failure across all endeavors. Ketu in the 8th is one of the most uniformly negative placements in Chapter 8, combining a shadow planet with the most difficult house. Short-lived; separated from dear friends; quarrels; injury from weapon; disappointed in all undertakings
interpretation.summary: Ketu in the 8th house produces shortened life, loss of dear friendships, constant quarrels, physical injury from weapons, and failure across all endeavors.

source.original_text: If Ketu be in the 9th house, the person will follow a sinful course, will do unrighteous acts, will be deprived of his father, will be unlucky and indigent, and will slander the good.

interpretation.detailed: Ketu placed in the 9th house (Dharma Bhava — house of righteousness, father, and fortune) inverts all the house's positive significations. Follows a sinful course — adharmic life path. Does unrighteous acts — immoral conduct. Deprived of father — paternal loss or estrangement. Unlucky — fortune consistently runs against the native. Indigent — poverty prevails. Slanders the good — the native speaks ill of virtuous and righteous people, a profound inversion of the 9th house's reverential relationship with the Guru and the pious. Ketu in the 9th house of dharma produces the complete negation of dharmic life: the native lives sinfully, lacks fortune, loses the father, and attacks the very goodness that the 9th house is meant to cultivate. Sinful course; unrighteous acts; deprived of father; unlucky; indigent; slanders the good
interpretation.summary: Ketu in the 9th house produces sinful and adharmic conduct, paternal deprivation, unluckiness, poverty, and the habit of slandering virtuous people.

source.original_text: If Ketu be in the 10th house, the person will have obstacles to good acts, will be impure, will do vile acts; but will be energetic, bold, and widely renowned.

interpretation.detailed: Ketu placed in the 10th house (Karma Bhava — house of career and action) produces a split outcome. Obstacles to good acts — the native's attempts at virtuous action are consistently blocked. Impure — moral impurity in conduct. Vile acts — base and contemptible behavior. However, the native is energetic — high personal drive and activity. Bold — fearless and direct in action. Widely renowned — famous on a large scale. The contradiction — vile acts alongside wide renown — reflects Ketu's capacity to produce public visibility that is divorced from moral quality. The native achieves fame through energy and boldness despite (or perhaps because of) the impure and vile conduct. This is a complex characterization of public life in the 10th house under Ketu. Obstacles to good acts; impure; vile acts; but energetic; bold; widely renowned
interpretation.summary: Ketu in the 10th house produces moral impurity and obstacles to virtue, but also remarkable energy, boldness, and wide renown.

source.original_text: If Ketu be in the 11th house, the person will hoard money, will have good qualities, will enjoy well, will command good materials, and will be successful in all his requirements.

interpretation.detailed: Ketu placed in the 11th house (Labha Bhava — house of gains) produces excellent outcomes, consistent with the principle that even shadow planets perform well in upachaya houses. The native hoards money — accumulates and retains wealth with intensity. Good qualities — positive character traits. Enjoys well — fine enjoyment of life's pleasures. Commands good materials — access to quality goods and resources. Successful in all requirements — needs and wishes are fulfilled. Ketu in the 11th is one of the planet's strongest placements, channeling its intense and karmic energy into material accumulation and fulfillment of needs. The 'hoarding' quality is specifically Ketu's — the planet of detachment paradoxically producing intense material accumulation when placed in the house of gains. Hoards money; good qualities; enjoys well; commands good materials; successful in all requirements
interpretation.summary: Ketu in the 11th house produces wealth accumulation, good character, fine enjoyment, access to quality materials, and success in all needs.

source.original_text: If Ketu be in the 12th house, the person will do sinful acts secretly, will spend on vile things, will destroy his wealth, will indulge in forbidden conduct, and will suffer from eye-diseases.

interpretation.detailed: Ketu placed in the 12th house (Vyaya Bhava — house of loss, secret acts, and confinement) produces comprehensive adverse outcomes aligned with the house's hidden and dissolving nature. Sinful acts done secretly — covert moral transgressions. Spends on vile things — expenditure directed toward base and immoral purposes. Destroys wealth — accumulated material resources are squandered or lost. Indulges in forbidden conduct — transgression of moral and social prohibitions. Eye-diseases — a specific health affliction. Ketu governs the eyes in some classical traditions (specifically vision and the spiritual eye), and placed in the 12th house (associated with vision loss in the natural kalapurusha) produces eye-related disease. The 12th house amplifies all of Ketu's qualities of dissolution, concealment, and forbidden transgression. Sinful acts secretly; spends on vile things; destroys wealth; forbidden conduct; eye-diseases
interpretation.summary: Ketu in the 12th house produces secretive sinful acts, expenditure on base things, wealth destruction, morally forbidden conduct, and eye diseases.

source.original_text: TBA — Sloka 34 truncated in PDF. Partial text: 'A planet produces the full effect of the Bhava in which it is when its distance (in Navamsas,' — text ends mid-sentence at end of PDF.

interpretation.detailed: TBA — Sloka 34 is truncated at the end of the source PDF (08_Adhyaya_VIII_Planets_in_Bhavas.pdf, page 14). The visible partial text reads: 'A planet produces the full effect of the Bhava in which it is when its distance (in Navamsas,' — then the PDF ends mid-sentence. Based on classical Jyotish principles, this sloka encodes the Bhava Madhya / Bhava Sandhi rule: a planet placed at the midpoint (Madhya) of a bhava produces the full effects described in the house-placement rules (such as those in this chapter); a planet placed near the junction (Sandhi) of two bhavas (the transition point between houses) produces diminished or no effect of that bhava. This rule governs the strength scalar applied to all 110 preceding rules. Recovery path: locate a complete edition of the Phaladeepika PDF or translation and extract the full sloka. The Santhanam or Raman translations likely contain this rule in full. Engine note: this rule, when recovered, should be implemented as a bhava_strength_scalar function that takes the planet's position in Navamsas within its bhava and returns a strength multiplier (0.0 to 1.0) applied to all bhava-based house-effect rules. TBA — Sloka 34 truncated. Expected: planet at Bhava Madhya = full house effect; planet at Bhava Sandhi = diminished effect. Magnitude determined by Navamsa distance from Madhya.
interpretation.summary: Sloka 34 contains a meta-rule about how the magnitude of a planet's effect in a bhava varies by its distance in Navamsas from the bhava's midpoint (Bhava Madhya). Planet at Bhava Madhya = full effect; planet near Bhava Sandhi = diminished effect. Text is truncated in the source PDF.

source.original_text: The person at whose birth the sign Mesha happens to be the Lagna will have round eyes, will have weak knees, will be fierce in his temperament, will be afraid of water, will eat sparingly, will long for the company of women, will always be on his legs, will be fickle in his disposition, will speak falsehoods, and will have bruised limbs.

interpretation.detailed: When Mesha (Aries) is the rising sign at birth, the native will have round eyes and weak knees. The disposition is fierce and the person is afraid of water. He eats sparingly and longs for the company of women. He is always on his legs (restless) and fickle in disposition. He speaks falsehoods and has bruised or marked limbs. Fierce, fickle, restless native with round eyes, weak knees, fear of water, sparse diet, attraction to women, tendency to speak falsehoods, bruised limbs
interpretation.summary: Mesha Lagna produces a native with round eyes, weak knees, fierce temperament, fear of water, sparse eating habits, attraction to women, restless gait, fickle character, tendency to speak falsehoods, and physically bruised or marked limbs.

source.original_text: When Vrishabha is the rising sign, the native will have plump thighs and a big face, will be engaged in agriculture, will be happy in the middle and concluding portions of his life, will be fond of young women, will be liberal in his gifts, will have a forgiving disposition, will endure hardships, will possess cattle, and will have marks or moles on his back, face and sides.

interpretation.detailed: When Vrishabha (Taurus) is the rising sign at birth, the native will have plump thighs and a big face. He will be engaged in agriculture and will be happy in the middle and concluding portions of his life. He will be fond of young women and liberal in his gifts, with a forgiving disposition. He endures hardships and possesses cattle. He will have marks or moles on his back, face, and sides. Liberal, forgiving, prosperous in middle and later life; engaged in agriculture; fond of young women; plump thighs and big face; marks on back/face/sides
interpretation.summary: Vrishabha Lagna produces a native with plump thighs and big face, engaged in agriculture, happy in middle and later life, fond of young women, liberal, forgiving, enduring, cattle-owning, with marks or moles on back, face, and sides.

source.original_text: When Mithuna is the rising sign, the native will have black eyes and curled hair, will be intent on sporting with women, will be skilled in interpreting others' thoughts, will have an elevated nose, will have a liking for music and dancing, and will always be home-keeping.

interpretation.detailed: When Mithuna (Gemini) is the rising sign at birth, the native will have black eyes and curled hair. He will be intent on sporting with women and will be skilled in interpreting the thoughts of others. He will have an elevated nose and will have a liking for music and dancing. He will always be home-keeping. Skilled interpreter of others' thoughts; fond of music, dancing, and women; black eyes and curled hair; elevated nose; home-keeping nature
interpretation.summary: Mithuna Lagna produces a native with black eyes, curled hair, an elevated nose, fond of women, skilled at reading others' minds, drawn to music and dancing, and home-oriented by nature.

source.original_text: When Karkataka is the rising sign, the native will be henpecked, will have a fleshy neck, will be surrounded by friends, will have many houses, will have elevated buttocks, will be rich, will be short in stature, will be crooked in his views, will be fast in walking, will be intelligent, will be fond of water, and will have very few sons.

interpretation.detailed: When Karkataka (Cancer) is the rising sign at birth, the native will be henpecked. He will have a fleshy neck and will be surrounded by friends. He will possess many houses and have elevated buttocks. He will be rich but short in stature, crooked in his views, and fast in walking. He will be intelligent and fond of water, but will have very few sons. Rich, intelligent, many friends and houses, fond of water; but henpecked, short, crooked in views, very few sons
interpretation.summary: Karkataka Lagna produces a native who is henpecked, fleshy-necked, surrounded by friends, possesses many houses, is rich but short, fast-walking, intelligent, fond of water, and has very few sons.

source.original_text: When Simha is the rising sign, the native will have reddish eyes, a large chin, and a broad face. He will be arrogant and powerful, will be angry at trifles, will like forests and hills, will be obedient to his mother, and will be firm-minded.

interpretation.detailed: When Simha (Leo) is the rising sign at birth, the native will have reddish eyes, a large chin, and a broad face. He will be arrogant and powerful, and will become angry at trifles. He likes forests and hills, is obedient to his mother, and is firm-minded. Arrogant, powerful, firm-minded, obedient to mother, fond of forests; reddish eyes, large chin, broad face; prone to anger at trifles
interpretation.summary: Simha Lagna produces a native with reddish eyes, large chin, and broad face. The native is arrogant and powerful, quick to anger, fond of forests and hills, obedient to mother, and firm-minded.

source.original_text: When Kanya is the rising sign, the native will have drooping shoulders and arms, will be respectable through others' houses and wealth, will be truthful, will speak kindly, will have a faint look due to modesty, will be fond of sexual enjoyment, will know the interpretation of the Shastras, and will have very limited children.

interpretation.detailed: When Kanya (Virgo) is the rising sign at birth, the native will have drooping shoulders and arms. He will be respected through others' houses and wealth rather than his own. He will be truthful and will speak kindly. He will have a faint look due to modesty and will be fond of sexual enjoyment. He will know the interpretation of the Shastras and will have very limited children. Truthful, kind-spoken, modest, learned in Shastras; drooping shoulders and arms; dependent on others' wealth; fond of sexual enjoyment; very limited children
interpretation.summary: Kanya Lagna produces a native with drooping shoulders and arms, truthful and kind in speech, modest in bearing, fond of sexual enjoyment, knowledgeable in Shastras, but dependent on others' wealth and having very limited children.

source.original_text: When Tula is the rising sign, the native will have a lean and feeble body, will have limited children, will be intent on worshipping Gods and Brahmins, will be wandering, will have two names, will be tall in stature, will be clever in trading, will be brave, will be merciless, and will be impartial in argument.

interpretation.detailed: When Tula (Libra) is the rising sign at birth, the native will have a lean and feeble body. He will have limited children and will be intent on worshipping Gods and Brahmins. He will be wandering in nature and will have two names. He will be tall in stature and clever in trading. He will be brave, merciless, and impartial in argument. Tall, lean, brave, clever in trade, impartial in argument, devout; but lean and feeble body, wandering, limited children, merciless, has two names
interpretation.summary: Tula Lagna produces a native with a lean and feeble body, tall, with limited children, devoted to worship, wandering in nature, having two names, clever in trade, brave, merciless in dealings, and impartial in argument.

source.original_text: When Vrischika is the rising sign, the native will have round thighs and knees, will have broad and expansive eyes and chest, will suffer from diseases at a very early age, will be separated from his parents and preceptors, will do cruel acts, will be honoured by the sovereign, and will have his hands and feet marked with the signs of the lotus (Padmarekha).

interpretation.detailed: When Vrischika (Scorpio) is the rising sign at birth, the native will have round thighs and knees and broad, expansive eyes and chest. He will suffer from diseases at a very early age and will be separated from his parents and preceptors. He will do cruel acts but will be honoured by the sovereign. His hands and feet will be marked with the signs of the lotus (Padmarekha), indicating auspicious marks. Round thighs and knees, broad eyes and chest, lotus marks on hands and feet; but diseases at early age, separated from parents and preceptors, cruel acts; honoured by sovereign
interpretation.summary: Vrischika Lagna produces a native with round thighs and knees, broad expansive eyes and chest, lotus marks (Padmarekha) on hands and feet. The native suffers diseases early in life, is separated from parents and preceptors, does cruel acts, but is honored by the sovereign.

source.original_text: When Dhanus is the rising sign, the native will have a very long face and neck, will have big ears and a big nose, will be intent on business, will be dwarfish in stature, will be the favourite of the King, will be eloquent, will be liberal in his gifts, will destroy his enemies, will be won over only by kind treatment, and will be endowed with great strength.

interpretation.detailed: When Dhanus (Sagittarius) is the rising sign at birth, the native will have a very long face and neck, and big ears and nose. He will be intent on business and will be dwarfish in stature. He will be the favourite of the King and will be eloquent and liberal in his gifts. He will destroy his enemies and will be won over only by kind treatment. He will be endowed with great strength. Eloquent, liberal, great strength, favourite of King, destroys enemies; long face and neck, big ears and nose, dwarfish; won over only by kind treatment
interpretation.summary: Dhanus Lagna produces a native with a very long face and neck, big ears and nose, dwarfish stature, but great strength. The native is business-minded, a favourite of the King, eloquent, liberal, an enemy destroyer, and responsive only to kind treatment.

source.original_text: When Makara is the rising sign, the native will be weak in his lower limbs, will be exceedingly strong or courageous, will carry out any task he undertakes, will be indolent, will be attached to old women of prohibited class, will be a religious hypocrite, will be fortunate, will always be on his legs, will suffer from wind-disease, and will be devoid of all shame.

interpretation.detailed: When Makara (Capricorn) is the rising sign at birth, the native will be weak in his lower limbs but will be exceedingly strong or courageous. He will carry out any task he undertakes. He will be indolent and attached to old women of prohibited class. He will be a religious hypocrite but will be fortunate. He will always be on his legs, will suffer from wind-disease (Vayu roga), and will be devoid of all shame. Fortunate, strong, courageous, task-completing; but weak lower limbs, indolent, attached to old women of prohibited class, religious hypocrite, wind-disease, devoid of shame
interpretation.summary: Makara Lagna produces a native who is weak in the lower limbs but exceedingly strong and courageous, a task-completer but indolent, fortunate but a religious hypocrite, attached to old women of prohibited class, suffers wind-disease, and is devoid of shame.

source.original_text: When Kumbha is the rising sign, the native will secretly commit sinful deeds, will have a body similar to a water-pot, will be clever in hitting or killing others, will endure long marches on roads, will have very limited means, will be covetous, will freely utilise the wealth of others, will have pecuniary losses and gains, and will be fond of perfumes and flowers.

interpretation.detailed: When Kumbha (Aquarius) is the rising sign at birth, the native will secretly commit sinful deeds. His body will be similar to a water-pot in shape. He will be clever in hitting or killing others and will endure long marches on roads. He will have very limited means and will be covetous. He will freely utilise the wealth of others and will have pecuniary losses and gains. He will be fond of perfumes and flowers. Secretly sinful, clever at harming others, covetous, freely uses others' wealth, very limited means, financial fluctuations; water-pot body; fond of perfumes and flowers
interpretation.summary: Kumbha Lagna produces a native with a water-pot-shaped body who secretly commits sinful deeds, is clever at harming others, endures long road journeys, has very limited means, is covetous and uses others' wealth, has pecuniary fluctuations, and is fond of perfumes and flowers.

source.original_text: When Meena is the rising sign, the native will drink water excessively, will have a symmetrical and shining body, will be fond of his wife, will gain money by selling pearls and other produce of the ocean, will be learned, will be grateful for past favours, will overcome his enemies, will have very good eyes, and will be fortunate.

interpretation.detailed: When Meena (Pisces) is the rising sign at birth, the native will drink water excessively. He will have a symmetrical and shining body. He will be fond of his wife and will gain money by selling pearls and other produce of the ocean. He will be learned and grateful for past favours. He will overcome his enemies and will have very good eyes. He will be fortunate. Fortunate, learned, grateful, fond of wife, enemy-overcomer, very good eyes, symmetrical shining body; earns from ocean produce; drinks water excessively
interpretation.summary: Meena Lagna produces a native who drinks water excessively and has a symmetrical, shining body. The native is fond of wife, earns from ocean produce, is learned, grateful, an enemy-overcomer, blessed with good eyes, and fortunate.

source.original_text: After examining the nature, place, form, colour etc. of any particular Rasi, one ought to intelligently guess the effects thereof. Whatever have been declared as the effects arising out of a particular Rasi being the Lagna, the same should also be said to come to pass, if the sign happens to be occupied by the Moon.

interpretation.detailed: Whatever effects have been declared as arising from a particular Rasi being the Lagna, the same effects should also come to pass if that sign is occupied by the Moon. The engine must evaluate all 12 lagna_sign rules (pd-ch09-001 to pd-ch09-012) against BOTH the natal Lagna sign AND the natal Moon sign. When the Moon's sign matches a lagna_sign rule's condition, that rule's outcomes also apply to the native. All 12 lagna-sign rules activate for both the natal Ascendant sign AND the natal Moon sign. The engine must not restrict lagna_sign rule matching to the Lagna alone.
interpretation.summary: Engine specification: the 12 lagna_sign rules (pd-ch09-001 to pd-ch09-012) apply not only when a sign is the natal Ascendant (Lagna) but also when the Moon occupies that sign. The engine must evaluate lagna_sign rules against both the natal Lagna and the natal Moon sign.

source.original_text: The person born will be the ruler of the earth, will receive praises from Kings, will be the abode of valuable treasures, will be endowed with excellent virtues; he will shine like King Vikramaditya in all his policy, fame, valour, liberality, courage and cleverness — during the Dasha period of a planet in exaltation.

interpretation.detailed: During the Dasha period of a planet placed in its exaltation sign (Uccha), the native will be the ruler of the earth and will receive praises from Kings. He will be the abode of valuable treasures and will be endowed with excellent virtues. He will shine like King Vikramaditya in all his policy, fame, valour, liberality, courage, and cleverness. Ruler-like status, praised by kings, treasures, excellent virtues, shines in policy, fame, valour, liberality, courage, and cleverness — during the exalted planet's Dasha
interpretation.summary: During the Dasha period of a planet placed in its exaltation sign, the native will be like a ruler of the earth, praised by kings, wealthy with treasures, virtuous, and will shine in policy, fame, valour, liberality, courage, and cleverness.

source.original_text: The person concerned will during the Dasa period of the said planet attain power and strength through the help of a wealthy personage or may himself become a lord, will stick to his residence without moving anywhere, will acquire a new house as well as lands capable of yielding every kind of crop and will be honoured by his people. He may get back even lost articles.

interpretation.detailed: During the Dasha period of a planet placed in its own sign (Swakshetra), the native will attain power and strength through the help of a wealthy personage, or may himself become a lord. He will stick to his residence without moving anywhere. He will acquire a new house as well as lands capable of yielding every kind of crop. He will be honoured by his people. He may get back even lost articles. Power and strength through wealthy patron or lord status; stays in residence; acquires new house and land; honoured by people; may recover lost articles — during own-sign planet's Dasha
interpretation.summary: During the Dasha period of a planet in its own sign, the native attains power and strength through wealthy patrons or becomes a lord himself, stays in his residence, acquires new house and productive land, is honoured by his people, and may recover lost articles.

source.original_text: The owner thereof will gain success through his friends in all his attempts, cultivate new friendships, possess good sons, wife, wealth, corn and other fortunes and receive help from all people.

interpretation.detailed: During the Dasha period of a planet placed in a friendly sign (Mitrashetra), the native will gain success through his friends in all his attempts. He will cultivate new friendships. He will possess good sons, a good wife, wealth, corn, and other fortunes. He will receive help from all people. Success through friends in all attempts; new friendships; good sons, wife, wealth, corn, and fortune; help from all people — during friendly-sign planet's Dasha
interpretation.summary: During the Dasha period of a planet placed in a friend's sign, the native succeeds through friends in all attempts, cultivates new friendships, gains good sons, wife, wealth, corn, and general fortune, and receives help from all people.

source.original_text: The person concerned will have a base disposition of mind. He will live in others' houses eating their food. He will be utterly destitute and will be always teased by enemies. Even a person who was originally his friend will prove inimical to him in the Dasa of such a planet.

interpretation.detailed: During the Dasha period of a planet placed in an enemy's sign (Shatrushetra), the native will have a base disposition of mind. He will live in others' houses eating their food and will be utterly destitute. He will be always teased by enemies. Even a person who was originally his friend will prove inimical to him during this Dasha period. Base disposition, lives in others' houses, utterly destitute, teased by enemies, even friends turn inimical — during enemy-sign planet's Dasha
interpretation.summary: During the Dasha period of a planet placed in an enemy's sign, the native has a base disposition, lives in others' houses eating their food, is utterly destitute, teased by enemies, and even his original friends turn inimical.

source.original_text: During the planet's Dasa period, the native will fall from his position, will suffer humiliation, will do sinful deeds, will contract debts, will seek help from low people, will dwell in insanitary surroundings, will do menial work, will walk long distances and will commit useless acts.

interpretation.detailed: During the Dasha period of a planet placed in its debilitation sign (Neecha), the native will fall from his position and will suffer humiliation. He will do sinful deeds and will contract debts. He will seek help from low people and dwell in insanitary surroundings. He will do menial work, walk long distances, and commit useless acts. Fall from position, humiliation, sinful deeds, debts, seeks help from low people, insanitary surroundings, menial work, long walks, useless acts — during debilitated planet's Dasha
interpretation.summary: During the Dasha period of a debilitated planet, the native falls from position, suffers humiliation, does sinful deeds, contracts debts, seeks help from low people, dwells in insanitary surroundings, does menial work, walks long distances, and commits useless acts.

source.original_text: The person born will (during the said planet's Dasa period) meet with his end within a short time. His wife, children as well as his wealth will also be destroyed. He will unnecessarily be drawn into quarrels, will incur the odium of others and also suffer humiliation — when the planet is eclipsed by the rays of the Sun (combust).

interpretation.detailed: During the Dasha period of a planet that is combust (eclipsed or weakened by the rays of the Sun), the native will meet with his end within a short time. His wife, children, and wealth will also be destroyed. He will unnecessarily be drawn into quarrels and will incur the odium of others. He will also suffer humiliation. Meets with end within short time; wife, children, and wealth destroyed; unnecessary quarrels; incurs odium of others; humiliation — during combust planet's Dasha
interpretation.summary: During the Dasha period of a combust planet (eclipsed by the Sun's rays), the native faces end of life within a short time, destruction of wife, children, and wealth, unnecessary quarrels, incurring of others' odium, and humiliation.

source.original_text: A planet posited in a neutral's sign does not urge any marked effect, but will only leave the happiness or misery unaffected.

interpretation.detailed: When a planet is placed in a neutral sign (neither friend nor enemy), its Dasha period does not produce any marked effect. The happiness or misery already present in the native's life is left unaffected — neither improved nor worsened. The Dasha passes without significant change. No marked effect; existing happiness or misery left unaffected — during neutral-sign planet's Dasha
interpretation.summary: During the Dasha period of a planet placed in a neutral sign, there is no marked effect — the native's existing happiness or misery is left unaffected, neither notably improved nor worsened.

source.original_text: When a planet is retrograde in his motion, he will produce effects similar to those that arise from his occupying his exaltation sign, should be even though the planet is posited in an inimical or depression sign.

interpretation.detailed: When a planet is retrograde in its motion (vakra), it will produce effects during its Dasha period similar to those that arise from occupying its exaltation sign — even if the planet is actually posited in an inimical or depression sign. Retrogression thus upgrades the planet's Dasha output to the exaltation level, overriding the negative implications of enemy-sign or debilitation placement. Retrograde planet in Dasha produces results equal to exaltation — even if in enemy or debilitation sign. Refer to pd-ch09-014 for full exaltation Dasha outcome set.
interpretation.summary: A retrograde planet produces Dasha effects equivalent to an exalted planet — even if it is placed in an enemy or debilitation sign. Retrogression overrides the adverse dignity conditions of enemy or depression placement.

condition.note: Retrograde motion overrides enemy or depression placement; Dasha result = equivalent to exaltation

source.original_text: The effects produced by a planet situated in his Swakshetra (own house) should be ascribed to him similarly when he happens to occupy a Vargottamamsa.

interpretation.detailed: When a planet occupies a Vargottamamsa position — meaning it occupies the same sign in both the Rasi (D1) chart and the Navamsa (D9) chart — the effects produced during its Dasha period are the same as those produced when the planet is in its own sign (Swakshetra). The full outcome set of pd-ch09-015 applies to a Vargottama planet's Dasha. Vargottama planet in Dasha produces results equal to own-sign placement. Refer to pd-ch09-015 for full own-sign Dasha outcome set.
interpretation.summary: A planet in Vargottamamsa (same sign in both D1 Rasi and D9 Navamsa charts) produces Dasha effects equivalent to a planet in its own sign (Swakshetra). Vargottama status is functionally equal to own-sign dignity for Dasha purposes.

condition.note: Vargottama = same sign in D1 and D9; Dasha result = equivalent to own-sign placement

source.original_text: If the 5th and the 7th house reckoned either from the Lagna or the Moon be occupied or aspected by the lord of the 9th house, or by benefics or their own lords, then there is good for the two Bhavas; otherwise not.

interpretation.detailed: If the 5th and 7th house reckoned from Lagna OR from the Moon are occupied or aspected by: (a) the lord of the 9th house, (b) natural benefics, or (c) their own lords — then there is good for both Bhavas. If these conditions are absent, the Bhavas will not bear fruit. Note: the rule applies when the condition is satisfied from Lagna OR from Moon (either reference point suffices).
interpretation.summary: When the 5th and 7th Bhavas (from Lagna or Moon) are occupied or aspected by the 9th lord, natural benefics, or their own lords — both Bhavas prosper. If this condition is absent, neither Bhava bears fruit.

source.original_text: If malefic planets are posited in the 12th, 4th and 8th houses counted from Venus or if Venus be hemmed in between two malefics, or if Venus be aspected by or conjoined with malefics, there is loss of wife.

interpretation.detailed: Three Venus affliction conditions each indicate loss of wife: (1) Malefic planets posited in the 12th, 4th, and 8th houses counted from Venus (Venus paapakartari by 4th and 12th, plus 8th); (2) Venus hemmed in between two malefics (paapakartari yoga); (3) Venus aspected by or conjoined with malefic planets. Any one of these three conditions is sufficient to predict loss of wife. Loss of wife
interpretation.summary: Any of three Venus affliction conditions indicates loss of wife: (1) malefics in 12th, 4th, and 8th from Venus; (2) Venus hemmed between two malefics; (3) Venus aspected by or conjoined with malefics.

components.description: Malefics in 12th, 4th, and 8th from Venus
Venus hemmed between two malefics
Venus aspected by or conjoined with malefics

source.original_text: If the lord of the 7th house be in the 5th, the native will lose his wife or become sonless.

interpretation.detailed: If the lord of the 7th house occupies the 5th house, the native will lose his wife OR become sonless (childless). The two adversarial outcomes (loss of spouse, loss of children) are presented as alternatives — at least one will occur. The connection between the 7th lord and the 5th house links marriage and children adversely. Loss of wife OR childlessness (one or both)
interpretation.summary: When the 7th house lord occupies the 5th house, the native either loses his wife or becomes childless.

source.original_text: The loss of the wife is certain, if the lord of the 5th or the 8th house happens to be in the 7th.

interpretation.detailed: The loss of the wife is certain when the lord of the 5th house OR the lord of the 8th house occupies the 7th house. Either placement alone is sufficient. The 5th lord in 7th links children (5th) with spouse (7th) adversely; the 8th lord in 7th places the house of death/longevity as ruler of the spouse's house. Loss of wife — certain
interpretation.summary: When the lord of the 5th or 8th house occupies the 7th house, loss of wife is declared certain.

source.original_text: If the weak Moon be in the 5th and malefics should occupy the 12th, 7th and the 1st houses, the person will be bereft of wife and children.

interpretation.detailed: If the weak (waning/debilitated/afflicted) Moon is in the 5th house AND malefics occupy the 12th, 7th, and 1st houses simultaneously, the person will be bereft of wife and children. The triple-malefic configuration in the angular (1st, 7th) and 12th positions, combined with a weak Moon in the 5th, destroys both 5th and 7th Bhava significations. Bereft of wife and children
interpretation.summary: When the weak Moon occupies the 5th house and malefics occupy the 12th, 7th, and 1st houses, the native is bereft of both wife and children.

source.original_text: If the Sun and Rahu be in the 7th house, one ought to predict loss of wealth through the association of women.

interpretation.detailed: If the Sun and Rahu both occupy the 7th house, predict loss of wealth through the association of women. The Sun in 7th weakens the Bhava (Sun dislikes being in the 7th); Rahu's presence amplifies material loss through relationships. Loss of wealth through association with women
interpretation.summary: When both the Sun and Rahu occupy the 7th house, predict loss of wealth through associations with women.

source.original_text: When Venus occupies Vrischika identical with the 7th house, the wife of the person born will die.

interpretation.detailed: When Venus occupies Vrischika (Scorpio) and that sign is the 7th house (which occurs for Taurus Lagna natives), the wife of the person born will die. Venus in Scorpio is in the sign of its debilitation and is in the 7th house — the combined adversity of debilitation and the 7th house's sensitivity to Venus produces early loss of wife. Death of wife
interpretation.summary: When Venus occupies Scorpio and that sign is identical with the 7th house (i.e., Taurus Lagna), the native's wife will die.

source.original_text: The same will be the effect when Mercury is in Vrishabha identical with the 7th house.

interpretation.detailed: The same adversarial effect (death of wife) occurs when Mercury occupies Vrishabha (Taurus) and that sign is identical with the 7th house — which occurs for Scorpio Lagna natives. Mercury in Taurus is in a sign that does not favour Mercury's 7th house significations for this Lagna. Death of wife
interpretation.summary: When Mercury occupies Taurus and that sign is the 7th house (Scorpio Lagna), the native's wife will die.

source.original_text: When Jupiter occupies the 7th and is in depression, the wife of the person will die.

interpretation.detailed: When Jupiter occupies the 7th house and is in depression (Neecha — Capricorn/Makara), the native's wife will die. Jupiter debilitated in the 7th removes the protective benefic influence from the spouse's house. This occurs for Cancer Lagna natives (7th house = Capricorn). Death of wife
interpretation.summary: When Jupiter is debilitated (in Capricorn) and that is the 7th house, the native's wife will die.

source.original_text: Saturn or Mars is posited in Meena identical with the 7th house — same effect (wife dies).

interpretation.detailed: If Saturn OR Mars occupies Meena (Pisces) and that sign is identical with the 7th house (which occurs for Virgo Lagna natives), the wife of the person will die. Pisces = 7th for Virgo Lagna. Both Saturn and Mars are natural malefics; either one in the 7th in this sign configuration produces loss of wife. Death of wife
interpretation.summary: When Saturn or Mars occupies Pisces and that sign is the 7th house (Virgo Lagna), the native's wife will die.

source.original_text: If Saturn and Mars are in the 7th house identical with Karkataka, the wife of the person concerned will be chaste, fortunate and beautiful.

interpretation.detailed: If both Saturn AND Mars are posited in Karkataka (Cancer) identical with the 7th house — which occurs for Capricorn Lagna natives (7th = Cancer) — the wife of the person will be chaste, fortunate, and beautiful. This is a notable exception: two natural malefics in the 7th producing a positive outcome. Cancer is the exaltation sign of Jupiter and sign of Moon; the malefics' adverse energy is transformed in this nurturing sign into positive spousal qualities. Wife is chaste, fortunate, and beautiful
interpretation.summary: When both Saturn and Mars occupy Cancer and that is the 7th house (Capricorn Lagna), the native's wife will be chaste, fortunate, and beautiful — a positive outcome from two malefics.

source.original_text: If the 7th house or its lord be associated with, aspected by or posited betwixt malefics or be in depression or inimical sign, or eclipsed by the Sun's rays, loss of wife is certain.

interpretation.detailed: Loss of wife is certain when the 7th house OR its lord is afflicted by any of: (a) associated with malefics, (b) aspected by malefics, (c) hemmed between malefics (paapakartari), (d) in depression (Neecha), (e) in inimical sign, (f) eclipsed by the Sun's rays (combust). Any single condition applied to either the 7th house or the 7th lord is sufficient for predicting wife loss. Loss of wife — certain
interpretation.summary: When the 7th house or its lord is afflicted by malefics (conjunction, aspect, or paapakartari), or is in depression, inimical sign, or combust — loss of wife is certain.

source.original_text: Venus in conjunction with a malefic occupying the 7th, 5th or 9th house will make the native bereft of wife or have a crippled wife.

interpretation.detailed: When Venus is in conjunction with a malefic planet and that conjunction occupies the 7th, 5th, or 9th house, the native will be bereft of wife OR will have a crippled (physically impaired) wife. The contamination of Venus by a malefic in a Trikona or 7th position damages the quality of the spousal relationship. Bereft of wife OR wife is crippled/physically impaired
interpretation.summary: Venus conjunct a malefic planet in the 7th, 5th, or 9th house makes the native bereft of wife or gives him a physically impaired wife.

source.original_text: When Venus is in a (Varga) of Mars or Saturn or has the aspect of these planets, the person born will have liaison with other people's wives.

interpretation.detailed: When Venus occupies a Varga (any divisional chart position) owned by Mars or Saturn, OR when Venus receives the aspect of Mars or Saturn — the person born will have liaison with other people's wives. The martial/saturnine influence on Venus corrupts its signification of legitimate spousal relationship into illicit associations. Liaisons with other men's wives / illicit relationships
interpretation.summary: When Venus is in a Varga (divisional chart sign) owned by Mars or Saturn, or when Venus receives aspect from Mars or Saturn, the native will have illicit relationships with married women.

source.original_text: If Venus and the Moon are in opposition to Mars and Saturn in any nativity, the person concerned will be either wifeless or issueless.

interpretation.detailed: If Venus and the Moon are in opposition to (i.e., mutually in the 7th from) Mars and Saturn in any nativity, the person will be wifeless OR issueless (childless). The luminaries (Moon as mind/mother) and Venus (wife) are simultaneously opposed by the two chief malefics Mars and Saturn, disrupting both spousal and progeny significations. Wifeless OR issueless (one or both)
interpretation.summary: When Venus and the Moon are in opposition to Mars and Saturn (mutual 7th from each other), the native will be wifeless or childless.

source.original_text: When there is a hermaphrodite planet in the 7th house and the 11th house is occupied by two planets, the person will have two wives.

interpretation.detailed: When a hermaphrodite (napumsaka) planet — classified as Saturn or Mercury in classical Jyotish — occupies the 7th house AND the 11th house is occupied by two planets, the person will have two wives. The hermaphrodite planet in the 7th creates ambiguity in the marriage relationship, while two planets in the 11th (house of gains, also related to multiple relationships) confirm the second marriage. Two wives / second marriage
interpretation.summary: When a hermaphrodite planet (Saturn or Mercury) is in the 7th house and two planets occupy the 11th house, the native will have two wives.

source.original_text: If the lord of the 7th house and Venus be each posited in a dual Rasi or Amsa, the person will have two wives.

interpretation.detailed: If the lord of the 7th house AND Venus are each posited in a dual Rasi (Dvishvabhava sign — Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, Pisces) OR in a dual Navamsa (Amsa), the person will have two wives. Both indicators of marriage (7th lord and Venus) in dual signs confirm multiplicity in marriage. Two wives / second marriage
interpretation.summary: When both the 7th lord and Venus are each placed in a dual (Dvishvabhava) sign in the natal chart or Navamsa, the native will have two wives.

source.original_text: Generally one ought to predict the number of wives in such cases by the number of the planets in conjunction with the lord of the 7th and Venus.

interpretation.detailed: A general methodology for predicting the number of wives: count the number of planets in conjunction with the 7th lord AND in conjunction with Venus. That count indicates the number of wives. Engine: sum the planets conjunct 7th lord and those conjunct Venus (deduplicate if same planet conjuncts both). This is a counting methodology rule. Number of wives = count of planets conjunct 7th lord and Venus
interpretation.summary: The number of wives a native has corresponds to the number of planets in conjunction with both the 7th lord and Venus.

condition.description: Count planets conjunct 7th lord + planets conjunct Venus. That count = number of wives predicted.

source.original_text: It is through the number of planets in the 7th house that one ought to divine the number of women that a person may associate with.

interpretation.detailed: It is through the number of planets in the 7th house that one ought to divine the number of women that the person may associate with (as spouses, partners, or significant relationships). This is a counting methodology rule — the 7th house acts as the indicator of all spousal associations. Count of planets in 7th = number of women the native associates with
interpretation.summary: The number of women a native associates with corresponds to the number of planets occupying the 7th house.

condition.description: Count planets in 7th house. That count = number of women the native associates with.

source.original_text: Of these the number that will die at an early age will correspond to the number of malefic planets in the 7th house, while the number of benefics will denote the number that will survive.

interpretation.detailed: Following the count rule of Sloka 6 (pd-ch10-019): the number of malefic planets in the 7th house corresponds to the number of associated women who will die at an early age, while the number of benefic planets in the 7th denotes the number who will survive. Engine: for each planet in the 7th, classify as malefic or benefic; malefics predict early death of that corresponding woman.
interpretation.summary: Among the women a native associates with: the number of malefic planets in the 7th predicts how many will die early; the number of benefics predicts how many will survive.

condition.description: Count malefics in 7th = count of women who die early. Count benefics in 7th = count who survive.

source.original_text: If the lord of the 7th be benefic and possessed of strength, the native will have a good-natured woman as his partner and be endowed with good children.

interpretation.detailed: If the lord of the 7th house is a natural benefic (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury, waxing Moon) AND possessed of strength (Shadbala, good dignity), the native will have a good-natured woman as his partner and will be endowed with good children. Both spousal quality and children are positively indicated. Good-natured wife and good children
interpretation.summary: When the 7th lord is a natural benefic and is strong, the native will have a good-natured wife and be blessed with good children.

source.original_text: Even a malefic will do good to the wife, if he should be in the 7th owning that house.

interpretation.detailed: Even a natural malefic planet will produce good results for the wife if it occupies the 7th house AND is the lord of the 7th house (i.e., it is the 7th lord in its own sign/7th). The ownership of the house by the malefic transforms its adverse nature into a protective one — the planet's Swakshetra placement in the 7th overrides its malefic nature with respect to spousal results. Good results for wife despite malefic 7th lord — ownership overrides malefic nature
interpretation.summary: Even a natural malefic planet placed in the 7th house does good to the wife if it is the lord of the 7th house.

source.original_text: Benefics in the 7th will be productive of good unless they happen to be the lords of the 6th, 8th and 12th houses.

interpretation.detailed: Benefic planets in the 7th house are generally productive of good results for the spouse and marriage. EXCEPTION: if those benefics happen to be the lords of the 6th, 8th, or 12th houses (Dusstthana lords), they do NOT produce good in the 7th. The Dusstthana lordship overrides the benefic nature when the planet is in the 7th.
interpretation.summary: Benefic planets in the 7th house produce good results for the spouse — except when those benefics are lords of the 6th, 8th, or 12th houses.

source.original_text: When the 2nd and 7th houses are either occupied or aspected by malefics there will be loss of wife and the effect will invariably be untoward in the case of malefic aspects.

interpretation.detailed: When the 2nd AND 7th houses are occupied or aspected by malefics, there will be loss of wife. The effect is especially certain when malefics ASPECT (rather than merely occupy) these two houses — the aspect-based affliction is considered the more decisive indicator. The 2nd house (family continuation, Kutumba) and 7th house (spouse) are the two primary marriage Bhavas. Loss of wife
interpretation.summary: When both the 2nd and 7th houses are occupied or aspected by malefics, loss of wife is predicted. If the malefics aspect (rather than occupy) these houses, the adverse effect is invariable.

source.original_text: Similar predictions about husbands may be made from the wife's nativity when the 7th and 8th houses are likewise afflicted.

interpretation.detailed: Similar adverse predictions about the husband can be made from the wife's nativity when the 7th and 8th houses are likewise afflicted by malefics (occupied or aspected). The 7th house = husband (from female chart perspective); the 8th house in a female chart has special significance for longevity/mangalya (marital auspiciousness). This is a female-nativity-specific rule. Adverse results for husband — analogous to wife-loss prediction in male chart
interpretation.summary: In a female nativity, when the 7th and 8th houses are afflicted by malefics, similar adverse predictions about the husband can be made.

source.original_text: But if the concerned two houses be aspected or occupied by benefics, the couple will be lucky and enjoy all comforts.

interpretation.detailed: If the 2nd and 7th houses are aspected or occupied by benefic planets (as opposed to malefics per Rule 024), the couple will be lucky and enjoy all comforts. The benefic protection of both marriage-related Bhavas ensures a harmonious and prosperous marriage. Couple lucky and enjoys all comforts
interpretation.summary: When the two marriage Bhavas (2nd and 7th) are aspected or occupied by benefic planets, the couple will be fortunate and enjoy all comforts.

source.original_text: When the Moon along with Saturn occupies the 7th house in a woman's nativity, the woman concerned will be remarried.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon in conjunction with Saturn occupies the 7th house in a woman's nativity, the woman will be remarried — implying either death of or separation from the first husband.
