Saturn's restrictive influence combined with Moon's fluctuating nature in the 7th of a female chart disrupts the continuity of marriage. Woman remarries — first marriage ends
interpretation.summary: In a female nativity, when the Moon and Saturn together occupy the 7th house, the woman will be remarried (second marriage).

source.original_text: In the case of a male, Moon with Saturn in 7th: he will be either wifeless or childless.

interpretation.detailed: In a male nativity, when the Moon is in conjunction with Saturn in the 7th house, the man will be either wifeless (no wife) or childless (no children). The same planetary combination (Moon + Saturn in 7th) produces remarriage for a woman but wifelessness/childlessness for a man — a gender-dependent rule. Wifeless OR childless
interpretation.summary: In a male nativity, when the Moon and Saturn together occupy the 7th house, the man will be either wifeless or childless.

source.original_text: If malefics in their depression or inimical house be posited in the 7th, the 8th or the 2nd, the demise of the wife or the husband should be predicted as the case may be.

interpretation.detailed: If malefic planets that are additionally weakened — being in their depression sign (Neecha) or in an inimical sign — are posited in the 7th, 8th, or 2nd house, the demise of the wife (in a male chart) or husband (in a female chart) should be predicted. The double affliction (natural malefic + depression/inimical) in the marriage-critical houses intensifies the prediction to spousal death. Death of wife (male chart) or husband (female chart)
interpretation.summary: When malefic planets in their depression or inimical sign occupy the 7th, 8th, or 2nd house, predict death of the wife or husband accordingly.

source.original_text: When the 7th house is an even sign and if the lord of that house and Venus be also similarly situated (in an even sign) and if the lords of the 5th and 7th houses possessing strength are not overpowered by the Sun's rays, the person concerned will certainly be blessed with wife and children.

interpretation.detailed: When the 7th house is an even sign (Taurus, Cancer, Virgo, Scorpio, Capricorn, Pisces) AND the lord of the 7th house AND Venus are also in even signs AND the lords of the 5th and 7th houses are strong AND not combust (not eclipsed by the Sun's rays) — the person will certainly be blessed with a wife and children. All four conditions must be met. Certainly blessed with wife and children
interpretation.summary: When the 7th house is an even sign, both the 7th lord and Venus are in even signs, and the 5th and 7th lords are strong and not combust — the native is certainly blessed with a wife and children.

source.original_text: If the planets owning the 2nd, the 7th and the 12th houses be aspected by Jupiter and occupy Trikona or Kendra positions, or if benefics be posited in the 2nd, the 7th and the 11th houses reckoned from the planet owning the 7th house, the wife of the native will command all happiness and be endowed with children.

interpretation.detailed: Two conditions each independently produce a happy wife with children: (A) The lords of the 2nd, 7th, and 12th houses are aspected by Jupiter AND are in Trikona (1st/5th/9th) or Kendra (1st/4th/7th/10th) positions; OR (B) Benefic planets are posited in the 2nd, 7th, and 11th houses reckoned FROM the planet owning the 7th house. Either configuration promises the wife will command all happiness and be endowed with children. Wife commands all happiness and is endowed with children
interpretation.summary: Jupiter aspecting the 2nd, 7th, and 12th lords when those lords are in Trikona or Kendra positions — OR benefics in 2nd, 7th, and 11th from the 7th lord — gives the wife all happiness and children.

components.description: Lords of 2nd/7th/12th aspected by Jupiter AND in Trikona or Kendra
Benefics in 2nd/7th/11th from the 7th lord's position

source.original_text: Find the Rasi and Navamsa occupied by the lords of the 1st and the 7th houses in a person's nativity. The Janma Rasi of the wife will be a sign triangular to the aforesaid Rasi or Navamsa, or it may be the exaltation or depression Rasi of the lords of the 1st and the 7th; or it will be that Rasi which contains the largest number of benefic dots in the Moon's Ashtakavarga table of the husband.

interpretation.detailed: To determine the wife's Janma Rasi (birth sign), three methods are given: (1) Find the Rasi and Navamsa occupied by the lords of the 1st and 7th houses — the wife's Janma Rasi will be a sign in Trikona (1-5-9) to those positions; (2) The wife's Janma Rasi may be the exaltation or depression Rasi of the lords of the 1st and 7th; (3) The wife's Janma Rasi will be the sign containing the largest number of benefic dots in the husband's Moon Ashtakavarga table. Engine: requires Navamsa calculator and Ashtakavarga calculator (Moon's individual Ashtakavarga). Identifies probable Janma Rasi of the wife using three complementary methods
interpretation.summary: The wife's birth sign (Janma Rasi) can be found by three methods: (1) a sign Trikona to Rasi/Navamsa of 1st or 7th lord; (2) the exaltation or depression sign of 1st or 7th lord; (3) the sign with the most benefic dots in the husband's Moon Ashtakavarga.

condition.description: Three methods for wife's Janma Rasi: (1) Trikona to 1st/7th lord positions, (2) exaltation/depression of 1st/7th lords, (3) maximum Moon Ashtakavarga sign.

source.original_text: The direction of the country of the wife will be that signified by the Rasi owned by the strongest of the three planets: (1) occupying the 7th house, (2) owning the 7th house, and (3) Venus.

interpretation.detailed: The direction of the country where the wife comes from will be that signified by the Rasi (sign) owned by the strongest of these three planets: (1) the planet occupying the 7th house, (2) the lord of the 7th house, (3) Venus. Identify the strongest among these three; that planet's sign ownership indicates the cardinal direction of the wife's origin. Direction of wife's country of origin
interpretation.summary: To find the direction of the wife's home country, identify the strongest of three planets (7th house occupant, 7th lord, Venus) and use the direction signified by the sign that planet owns.

condition.description: Identify strongest of: (a) planet in 7th, (b) 7th lord, (c) Venus. Use that planet's Rasi ownership to determine cardinal direction.

source.original_text: The marriage may be expected to come off when Venus or the lord of the 7th house in his orbit passes through a sign which is triangular to the Rasi or Navamsa occupied by the Lord of the Lagna.

interpretation.detailed: The marriage may be expected to occur when Venus OR the lord of the 7th house, in its transiting orbit, passes through a sign that is triangular (Trikona — 1st, 5th, or 9th) to the Rasi OR Navamsa occupied by the Lord of the Lagna in the natal chart. Both the Rasi and Navamsa positions of the Lagna lord are valid reference points. Marriage event expected when transit condition is met
interpretation.summary: Marriage is expected when Venus or the 7th lord (in transit) passes through a sign in Trikona to the Rasi or Navamsa occupied by the Lagna lord.

condition.description: Transit trigger: Venus or 7th lord transiting sign Trikona to natal Lagna lord's Rasi or Navamsa position.

source.original_text: The acquisition of a wife may happen during the Dasa period of the planet posited in the 7th house, aspecting the 7th house, or owning the 7th house. The same may also happen when the lord of the Lagna in his orbit comes to the Rasi representing the 7th house.

interpretation.detailed: The acquisition of a wife may happen during the Dasha period of: (1) the planet posited in the 7th house, (2) the planet aspecting the 7th house, or (3) the planet owning the 7th house (the 7th lord). Any of these three Dasha periods can bring the wife. This is the Dasha-based marriage timing rule. Acquisition of wife during the Dasha of the identified planet
interpretation.summary: Acquisition of a wife typically occurs during the Dasha of the planet in the 7th house, aspecting the 7th, or owning the 7th house.

source.original_text: The same may also happen when the lord of the Lagna in his orbit comes to the Rasi representing the 7th house.

interpretation.detailed: The acquisition of a wife may also happen when the lord of the Lagna, in its transiting orbit, passes through the Rasi (sign) that represents the 7th house from the native's Lagna. This is a transit-based marriage timing trigger: Lagna lord transiting the 7th sign (the opposite sign from Lagna). Combined with pd-ch10-035 (Dasha triggers) and pd-ch10-034 (Trikona transit), this gives three marriage timing methods. Marriage may occur when Lagna lord transits 7th sign
interpretation.summary: Marriage may also occur when the Lagna lord in transit passes through the sign representing the 7th house.

condition.description: Transit trigger: Lagna lord transiting the sign representing the 7th house from natal Lagna.

source.original_text: Find which of the two is stronger: (1) the lords of the Rasi and Navamsa occupied by the lord of the 7th house; (2) Venus and the Moon. During the Dasa-period of that planet when Jupiter passes through a sign triangular to the Rasi or Navamsa occupied by the lord of the 7th, the marriage may be declared to take place.

interpretation.detailed: To time marriage precisely: (1) Find the lords of the Rasi and Navamsa occupied by the 7th lord. (2) Compare their strength with Venus and the Moon. (3) Determine which group is stronger. (4) During the Dasha period of the stronger group's planet, AND when Jupiter simultaneously transits through a sign Trikona to the Rasi or Navamsa occupied by the 7th lord — marriage can be declared to take place. This is the most compound marriage timing rule in Ch10, requiring both Dasha and transit activation. Source: Ch11 PDF page 1. Marriage occurs when Dasha of stronger group coincides with Jupiter Trikona transit to 7th lord's position
interpretation.summary: The most precise marriage timing rule: identify the stronger group between (lords of 7th lord's Rasi and Navamsa) and (Venus and Moon). During that group's Dasha — AND when Jupiter simultaneously transits Trikona to the 7th lord's Rasi or Navamsa — declare marriage.

components.description: Dasha of stronger group: lords of 7th lord's Rasi+Navamsa vs Venus+Moon
Jupiter transiting Trikona to 7th lord's Rasi or Navamsa

source.original_text: If the lord of the 7th house occupies an inimical or depression sign, or be eclipsed or be aspected by malefics and if the 7th house be associated with or aspected by malefics, there will be loss of wife; so say the wise.

interpretation.detailed: If the lord of the 7th house occupies an inimical or depression sign, OR is eclipsed (combust), OR is aspected by malefics — AND SIMULTANEOUSLY the 7th house itself is associated with or aspected by malefics — there will be loss of wife. The text attributes this to 'the wise' (classical authorities). This is a double-affliction rule: both the 7th lord AND the 7th house must be independently afflicted. This rule closes the chapter with the most thorough loss-of-wife confirmation. Source: Ch11 PDF page 1. Loss of wife — confirmed by classical authorities
interpretation.summary: When the 7th lord is in inimical/depression sign, eclipsed, or aspected by malefics — AND the 7th house is also associated/aspected by malefics — loss of wife is certain. This is the double-affliction confirmation rule.

source.original_text: Whatever effects are declared for men's horoscopes are entirely applicable to women too, or to their husband. Prosperity and happiness have to be deduced from the 8th place (from the Lagna or the Moon, whichever is stronger). Children should be declared through the 9th house. Matters relating to appearance should be determined from the Lagna. From the 7th place her welfare and the nature of the husband should be ascertained. Her association and chastity should be predicted from an examination of the 4th house. Benefics produce good results; malefics produce evil unless they own the houses.

interpretation.detailed: All effects declared for men's horoscopes are applicable to women and their husbands. The specific remapping for female charts: Prosperity and happiness → 8th house (from stronger of Lagna or Moon). Children → 9th house. Appearance and beauty → Lagna. Welfare and power to influence husband + nature of husband → 7th house. Association and chastity → 4th house. Benefics in these houses produce good results. Malefics in these houses produce evil UNLESS they own those houses, in which case the effect is good. Female chart analytical framework — house-to-domain mapping for all subsequent female chart evaluations
interpretation.summary: In female horoscopy, all male horoscope effects apply but with remapped house significations: 8th = prosperity, 9th = children, Lagna = beauty, 7th = husband/influence, 4th = chastity. Benefics in these houses = good; malefics = evil unless they own those houses.

condition.description: Female chart house remapping: 8th=prosperity, 9th=children, 1st=beauty, 7th=husband/influence, 4th=chastity. Benefics = good; malefics = evil unless house owners.

source.original_text: If both the Ascendant and the Moon are in even signs and be aspected by benefic planets, the woman born will bear good sons, possess an excellent husband and be well-ornamented. She will be very prosperous and possess excellent qualities.

interpretation.detailed: If both the Ascendant (Lagna) and the Moon are in even signs (Taurus, Cancer, Virgo, Scorpio, Capricorn, Pisces) AND are aspected by benefic planets, the woman born will: bear good sons, possess an excellent husband, be well-ornamented with jewels, be very prosperous, and possess excellent qualities and character. Good sons, excellent husband, well-ornamented, very prosperous, excellent qualities
interpretation.summary: When both the Lagna and Moon are in even signs and aspected by benefic planets, the woman will bear good sons, have an excellent husband, be well-ornamented, prosperous, and of excellent character.

source.original_text: If the Lagna and the Moon are in odd signs and be aspected by or associated with malefic planets, she will be masculine in her bearing, insincere, ungovernable to her husband; and cruel beyond measure, and poor.

interpretation.detailed: If the Lagna and the Moon are in odd signs (Aries, Gemini, Leo, Libra, Sagittarius, Aquarius) AND aspected by or associated with malefic planets, the woman will be masculine in her bearing and appearance, insincere in character, ungovernable and disobedient to her husband, cruel beyond measure, and poor. Masculine bearing, insincere, ungovernable to husband, cruel, poor
interpretation.summary: When the Lagna and Moon are in odd signs and aspected by or associated with malefics, the woman will be masculine in bearing, insincere, ungovernable to her husband, extremely cruel, and poor.

source.original_text: If the 7th house or setting Navamsa be a sign owned by a benefic, the husband of the woman will be bright in appearance, famous, learned and wealthy.

interpretation.detailed: If the 7th house sign OR the setting Navamsa (the Navamsa rising on the 7th house cusp) belongs to a benefic planet (Jupiter, Venus, or Mercury), the husband of the woman will be bright in appearance, famous, learned and wealthy. The 7th house sign lord and the Navamsa of the 7th cusp both serve as indicators of spousal quality. Husband is bright in appearance, famous, learned, and wealthy
interpretation.summary: When the 7th house or the setting Navamsa (Astamsha) belongs to a benefic planet, the woman's husband will be bright in appearance, famous, learned, and wealthy.

condition.description: 7th house sign OR setting Navamsa sign is owned by a natural benefic (Jupiter/Venus/Mercury).

source.original_text: If it be otherwise (not owned by benefic), the husband will be deformed, stupid or be a gambler and will have lost all his wealth, and the couple will not live together.

interpretation.detailed: If the 7th house or setting Navamsa is not owned by a benefic planet, the husband of the woman will be deformed or have physical defects, stupid or be a gambler (deceitful), will have lost all his wealth, and the couple will not live together (separation or discord in marriage). This is the adversarial counterpart to Rule 004. Husband deformed/stupid/gambler, impoverished, couple do not live together
interpretation.summary: When the 7th house or setting Navamsa is not owned by a benefic, the husband will be deformed, stupid or a gambler, impoverished, and the couple will not live together.

condition.description: 7th house sign AND setting Navamsa sign are both NOT owned by natural benefics.

source.original_text: If the Rasi and Amsa of the 7th house belong to Mars or if Mars occupies it (the 7th), the female born will become a widow.

interpretation.detailed: If the Rasi (sign) and Amsa (Navamsa sign) of the 7th house both belong to Mars — OR if Mars simply occupies the 7th house — the female born will become a widow (the husband will die during her lifetime). Mars's warlike and destructive energy in the 7th house or owning the 7th house leads to the spouse's death. Woman becomes a widow — husband dies
interpretation.summary: When Mars owns both the Rasi and Amsa (Navamsa) of the 7th house, or when Mars occupies the 7th house, the woman born will become a widow.

components.description: Mars owns both 7th Rasi and 7th Navamsa (Amsa)
Mars occupies the 7th house

source.original_text: If the planets in the 7th house be of a mixed sort, she will be remarried.

interpretation.detailed: If the planets in the 7th house are of a mixed sort — both benefics and malefics present — the woman will be remarried. The mixed planetary composition in the 7th produces an ambiguous spousal situation: the first marriage ends but a second follows. Woman remarries — second marriage after first ends
interpretation.summary: When the 7th house contains a mixture of benefic and malefic planets, the woman will be remarried (second marriage after the first ends).

condition.description: 7th house contains both natural benefic and natural malefic planets simultaneously.

source.original_text: If the 8th house be occupied by malefics, she will cause the destruction of her husband.

interpretation.detailed: If the 8th house is occupied by malefic planets in a female nativity, the woman will cause the destruction of her husband. The 8th house in a female chart is associated with marital longevity and husband's well-being (Mangalya). Malefics there create an adversarial energy that harms the husband. Woman causes destruction/ruin of her husband
interpretation.summary: In a female nativity, when malefic planets occupy the 8th house, the woman will cause the destruction (ruin or death) of her husband.

source.original_text: If benefics should occupy the 2nd house she would herself die.

interpretation.detailed: If benefic planets occupy the 2nd house in a female nativity, the woman herself will die. This is a counterintuitive rule: benefics in the 2nd of a female chart produce the native's death rather than good results. This applies the Dusstthana inversion principle (from Ch15 Rules 023/024) — in certain sensitive positions for female charts, benefics can produce adverse effects. The 2nd house in a female chart relates to family continuation; benefics there may indicate the woman sacrifices herself for family. Note: the classical interpretation often refers to premature/early death. Woman herself dies (premature death)
interpretation.summary: In a female nativity, when benefic planets occupy the 2nd house, the woman herself will die (early death predicted).

source.original_text: When the Moon is in Scorpio, Virgo, Taurus or Leo identical with the 5th Bhava, the woman concerned will have but a few children.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon is posited in Scorpio (Vrischika), Virgo (Kanya), Taurus (Vrishabha), or Leo (Simha) and that sign is simultaneously the 5th Bhava in the chart, the woman concerned will have only a few children. Each of these signs, when occupied by Moon as the 5th, weakens the 5th house's ability to produce many children. Few children
interpretation.summary: When the Moon occupies Scorpio, Virgo, Taurus, or Leo and that sign is the 5th Bhava, the woman will have very few children.

source.original_text: If the 7th house or the setting Navamsa belong to Saturn, Mars or the Sun, the woman will have a diseased womb.

interpretation.detailed: If the 7th house sign or the setting Navamsa (Navamsa of the 7th cusp) belongs to Saturn, Mars, or the Sun, the woman will have a diseased womb (uterine disease, reproductive health issues). These three planets — natural malefics in this context — afflict the reproductive aspect of the 7th/8th house domain in female charts. Diseased womb / reproductive health problems
interpretation.summary: When the 7th house or setting Navamsa belongs to Saturn, Mars, or the Sun, the woman will suffer from a diseased womb.

condition.description: 7th house sign OR setting Navamsa owned by Saturn, Mars, or Sun.

source.original_text: If malefic planets be in the 4th Bhava, the female born will become unchaste.

interpretation.detailed: If malefic planets are in the 4th Bhava in a female nativity, the female born will become unchaste. The 4th house in female charts governs chastity and association (per the framework of Rule 001). Malefics in the 4th destroy that Bhava's positive signification. Woman becomes unchaste
interpretation.summary: When malefic planets occupy the 4th house in a female nativity, the woman will be unchaste (sexually promiscuous).

source.original_text: Posited in the Rasi or Amsa of Mars or Saturn, she will be a concubine. If the Lagna, the Moon and Venus [text OCR corrupt — outcome not legible].

interpretation.detailed: When [subject — malefic planets or the Moon, per context] is posited in the Rasi or Amsa of Mars or Saturn, the woman will be a concubine. The final clause 'If the Lagna, the Moon and Venus' in the source PDF is truncated at the page break — the outcome text is not legible from the available OCR. The subject of the concubine rule (which planet 'posited in Mars/Saturn Rasi or Amsa') is also slightly unclear. Most probable reading: the Moon in a Mars/Saturn sign or Navamsa indicates concubinage. Final clause requires a clean source edition. Woman becomes a concubine
interpretation.summary: When [malefic planets or specific configurations] are posited in the Rasi or Amsa (Navamsa) of Mars or Saturn, the woman will be a concubine. Final clause of Sloka 4 involving Lagna, Moon, and Venus is OCR-corrupt.

condition.description: Subject (likely Moon or Lagna lord) in Rasi or Navamsa sign owned by Mars or Saturn. Final clause condition unknown due to OCR corruption.

source.original_text: If the 7th Bhava or setting Navamsa belongs to a benefic planet, the woman born will be possessed of handsome hips and very fortunate.

interpretation.detailed: If the 7th Bhava sign or the setting Navamsa belongs to a benefic planet (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury), the woman born will be possessed of handsome hips and be very fortunate in life. This is the positive physical and material indicator from the 7th house/Navamsa benefic placement. Handsome hips and very fortunate
interpretation.summary: When the 7th Bhava or setting Navamsa belongs to a benefic planet, the woman will be physically attractive (handsome hips) and very fortunate.

condition.description: 7th house sign OR setting Navamsa owned by natural benefic.

source.original_text: If the Moon, the Lagna and the 4th house be connected with benefics, the woman concerned will be chaste, and be endowed with very good qualities.

interpretation.detailed: If the Moon, the Lagna, and the 4th house are all connected with benefic planets (by occupation or aspect), the woman will be chaste in conduct and endowed with very good qualities and character. The triple benefic connection — Moon (mind), Lagna (self), and 4th (chastity domain) — creates a woman of excellent moral character. Chaste woman endowed with very good qualities
interpretation.summary: When the Moon, Lagna, and 4th house are all connected with benefic planets, the woman will be chaste and endowed with very good qualities.

source.original_text: If benefics are posited in Trikona houses, she will be happy, possessed of children, and wealth and be good-natured.

interpretation.detailed: If benefic planets are posited in Trikona houses (1st, 5th, and 9th) in a female chart, she will be happy, possessed of children, endowed with wealth, and good-natured in character. Benefics in the Trikona activate all three auspicious pillars: self (1st), children (5th), and fortune (9th). Happy, possessed of children and wealth, good-natured
interpretation.summary: When benefic planets occupy the Trikona houses (1st, 5th, 9th), the woman will be happy, have children, possess wealth, and be good-natured.

condition.description: Natural benefics in Trikona houses (1, 5, 9) in female chart.

source.original_text: If the said (Trikona) houses be occupied by weak malefics, the woman will become barren or her children will all die early.

interpretation.detailed: If the Trikona houses (1st, 5th, 9th) are occupied by weak malefic planets, the woman will become barren (unable to conceive) OR her children will all die at an early age. The strength condition is specified: weak malefics (in depression, inimical sign, or reduced Shadbala). Strong malefics in Trikona might not produce this extreme result. Barren OR all children die early
interpretation.summary: When weak malefic planets occupy the Trikona houses in a female chart, the woman will be barren or all her children will die early.

condition.description: Weak malefic planets in Trikona houses (1, 5, 9) in female chart.

source.original_text: When the Moon is in a Rasi belonging to Mars, the woman born will be (1) ill-behaved (2) a menial or slave, unchaste (3) virtuous, lofty-minded and prosperous (4) deceitful and (5) frail according as the Trimsamsa of the Moon belongs to (1) Mars (2) Saturn (3) Jupiter (4) Mercury and (5) Venus respectively. Moon in Vrishabha or Tula: (1) very frail (2) resort to second husband (3) highly respected (4) very intelligent (5) famous. Moon in Mercury sign: (1) dishonest (2) eunuch (3) chaste (4) endowed with all good qualities (5) repining.

interpretation.detailed: The character of a woman is determined by the Moon's sign and the Trimsamsa (one of five 30° divisions) the Moon occupies in that sign. Each Trimsamsa is owned by Mars, Saturn, Jupiter, Mercury, or Venus in order. Part 1 (Sloka 6): Moon in Mars sign (Aries/Scorpio): Mars Trimsamsa=ill-behaved; Saturn=menial/unchaste; Jupiter=virtuous/prosperous; Mercury=deceitful; Venus=frail. Moon in Venus sign (Taurus/Libra): Mars=very frail; Saturn=second husband; Jupiter=highly respected; Mercury=very intelligent; Venus=famous. Moon in Mercury sign (Gemini/Virgo): Mars=dishonest; Saturn=eunuch; Jupiter=chaste; Mercury=all good qualities; Venus=repining.
interpretation.summary: Character of a woman determined by Moon's sign and Trimsamsa (30° division). Mars signs, Venus signs (Taurus/Libra), and Mercury signs (Gemini/Virgo) each produce 5 character outcomes corresponding to the 5 Trimsamsa rulers (Mars/Saturn/Jupiter/Mercury/Venus).

condition.description: Lookup: Moon's sign group + Trimsamsa ruler → character trait. Moon in Mars signs / Venus signs / Mercury signs × 5 Trimsamsa rulers.

source.original_text: Moon in Karkataka Trimsamsas: (1) self-willed/uncontrolled (2) kills husband (3) many good qualities (4) skilled in Arts (5) virtuous. Moon in Jupiter sign: (1) many good qualities (2) low sexual activity (3) many good qualities (4) skilled in Arts (5) very chaste. Moon in Saturn sign: (1) maid servant (2) attached to another man (3) husband under control (4) unchaste (5) barren/indigent. Moon in Leo Trimsamsas: (1) wicked wife (2) despicable character (3) wife of king (4) masculine disposition (5) attached to another man.

interpretation.detailed: Trimsamsa character table Part 2 (Sloka 7): Moon in Cancer (Karkataka): Mars=self-willed/uncontrolled; Saturn=kills husband; Jupiter=many good qualities; Mercury=skilled in Arts; Venus=virtuous. Moon in Jupiter sign (Sagittarius/Pisces): Mars=many good qualities; Saturn=low sexual activity; Jupiter=many good qualities; Mercury=skilled in Arts; Venus=very chaste. Moon in Saturn sign (Capricorn/Aquarius): Mars=maid servant; Saturn=attached to another man; Jupiter=husband under control; Mercury=unchaste; Venus=barren and indigent. Moon in Leo (Simha): Mars=wicked wife; Saturn=despicable character; Jupiter=wife of a king; Mercury=masculine disposition; Venus=attached to another man.
interpretation.summary: Character of a woman by Moon sign and Trimsamsa — Part 2: Cancer, Jupiter signs (Sagittarius/Pisces), Saturn signs (Capricorn/Aquarius), and Leo each produce 5 character outcomes.

condition.description: Lookup: Moon's sign group + Trimsamsa ruler → character trait. Moon in Cancer / Jupiter signs / Saturn signs / Leo × 5 Trimsamsa rulers.

source.original_text: The effects described as due to the Trimsamsa are occupied by the Moon at birth or those mentioned for the Trimsamsa rising at the time will come to pass according as the one Trimsamsa or the other is stronger.

interpretation.detailed: The character effects from the Trimsamsa table (Rules 018-019) should be applied based on whichever of two reference Trimsamsas is stronger: (1) The Trimsamsa occupied by the Moon at birth, OR (2) The Trimsamsa rising at the time of birth (the Lagna's Trimsamsa). Determine which is stronger and apply its corresponding character effects. Effects of the stronger Trimsamsa (birth Moon or rising Lagna) prevail
interpretation.summary: When predicting female character from the Trimsamsa table, use either the Trimsamsa occupied by the Moon at birth or the Trimsamsa rising at birth — whichever is stronger determines the applicable effects.

condition.description: Compare strength of (a) birth Moon's Trimsamsa, (b) rising Trimsamsa at birth. Apply character effects from the stronger Trimsamsa.

source.original_text: Astrologers declare that the eldest brother, the mother, the father, the youngest brother respectively of a person will die soon after the marriage if his wife be born under the stars Jyeshta [and other specified nakshatras]. Stabhishak, Moola, Krittika and Pushya — women born under these will be barren, have become widows, mothers of children that are dead, will have been cast away by their husbands or be without wealth.

interpretation.detailed: Classical astrologers declare: if a wife is born under Jyeshta Nakshatra, the husband's eldest brother will die soon after the marriage. [The complete mapping of which nakshatra causes which family member's death (eldest brother, mother, father, youngest brother) is only partially legible in the available OCR.] Additionally, women born under these Nakshatras face adverse fates: Shatabhishak — barren; Moola — widow or cast away; Krittika and Pushya — mothers of dead children or cast away by husband, without wealth. Note: This rule is partially OCR-corrupt (the full nakshatra-to-family-member mapping is incomplete in the available source).
interpretation.summary: A wife born under Jyeshta Nakshatra causes the husband's eldest brother's death soon after marriage. Women born under Shatabhishak, Moola, Krittika, or Pushya will face adverse fates: barrenness, widowhood, death of children, or abandonment.

condition.description: Wife's birth Nakshatra → adverse effects for husband's family or for wife herself. Full mapping partially OCR-corrupt.

source.original_text: If the lords of the Lagna, the 9th house and the sign occupied by the Moon be associated with benefics and are posited in good houses and be of brilliant rays (not eclipsed), the woman concerned will be held in high esteem by her relations. She will do many good deeds, will be very handsome and be prosperous. She will please her husband, bear good sons and be virtuous.

interpretation.detailed: If the lords of (1) the Lagna, (2) the 9th house, and (3) the sign occupied by the Moon are: associated with benefics AND posited in good houses (not Dusstthanas) AND of brilliant rays (not combust/eclipsed) — the woman will be held in high esteem by her relations, will do many good deeds, will be very handsome and prosperous, will please her husband, will bear good sons, and will be virtuous in disposition. The period of her happy conjugal life depends on the strength derived by the 8th house from benefics through association or aspect. Held in high esteem, very handsome, prosperous, pleases husband, bears good sons, virtuous
interpretation.summary: When the lords of the Lagna, 9th house, and Moon's sign are all associated with benefics, in good houses, and not combust — the woman will be held in high esteem, do good deeds, be very handsome, prosperous, pleasing to husband, and bear good sons.

source.original_text: If a woman's menses set in when the Moon is in an Anupachaya (1st, 2nd, 4th, 5th, 7th, 8th, 9th and 12th place) and aspected by Mars, they become favourable to conception. The husband should sow the seed when the Moon occupies an Upachaya (3rd, 6th, 10th and 11th) house and is aspected by Jupiter. This is to be done at an unexceptionable Lagna with many good points in its favour and unconnected with Parva and other objectionable periods.

interpretation.detailed: Conception timing methodology: (1) Menses become favourable for conception when the Moon is posited in Anupachaya houses (1st, 2nd, 4th, 5th, 7th, 8th, 9th, and 12th positions from some reference) AND is aspected by Mars. (2) The husband should sow the seed (act for conception) when the Moon occupies an Upachaya house (3rd, 6th, 10th, and 11th) AND is aspected by Jupiter. (3) This should be performed at an auspicious (unexceptionable) Lagna with many good astrological points in its favour, and not during objectionable periods such as Parva (lunar/solar eclipse nodes), Tithis, etc. Source: body from Ch11 PDF; completion from Ch12 PDF page 1. Optimal conditions for conception identified by Moon's Upachaya/Anupachaya position and Mars/Jupiter aspects
interpretation.summary: Menses are favourable for conception when Moon is in Anupachaya positions (1,2,4,5,7,8,9,12) and aspected by Mars. The husband should act when Moon is in Upachaya (3,6,10,11) and aspected by Jupiter, at an auspicious Lagna.

condition.description: Electional astrology for conception: (a) menses favourable when Moon in Anupachaya + Mars aspect, (b) act when Moon in Upachaya + Jupiter aspect, (c) at auspicious Lagna.

source.original_text: If Jupiter and the lords of the 5th house reckoned from the Lagna and the Moon be well-placed, and the 5th house has on it the aspect of a benefic planet or of one owning an auspicious house (i.e., other than 6th, 8th and 12th), the acquisition of children is assured.

interpretation.detailed: If Jupiter AND the lords of the 5th house reckoned from both the Lagna AND the Moon are well-placed (in good houses, in own/exaltation signs, not combust), AND the 5th house has the aspect of a benefic planet OR the aspect of a planet that owns an auspicious house (not the 6th, 8th, or 12th), then the acquisition of children is assured. Acquisition of children is assured
interpretation.summary: When Jupiter and the 5th lords (from Lagna and Moon) are all well-placed AND the 5th house receives benefic aspect or aspect from a non-Dusstthana lord, children are assured.

source.original_text: If the lords of the Lagna and the 5th house be posited together in a house or have mutual benefic aspect or occupy each other's places, the acquisition of children is assured.

interpretation.detailed: If the lords of the Lagna and the 5th house are: (a) posited together in the same house, OR (b) have mutual benefic aspect between each other, OR (c) occupy each other's signs (Parivartana yoga) — the acquisition of children is assured. Any one of the three conditions suffices. Acquisition of children is assured
interpretation.summary: When the Lagna lord and 5th lord are in the same house, or aspect each other with benefic aspects, or exchange their signs (Parivartana), children are assured.

components.description: Lagna lord + 5th lord conjunct in same house
Lagna lord and 5th lord have mutual benefic aspect
Lagna lord and 5th lord in Parivartana (each in other's sign)

source.original_text: When the 5th places counted from the Lagna, Jupiter and the Moon are either associated with or aspected by malefics and are devoid of benefics or of their aspect, or when these houses are surrounded by malefics on both sides and when the lords of the above said houses are posited in Dusstthanas, the person concerned can have no issue whatever.

interpretation.detailed: When the 5th house from Lagna, the 5th from Jupiter, and the 5th from the Moon are all: associated with OR aspected by malefic planets AND devoid of benefic planets or benefic aspects, AND when these houses are surrounded by malefics on both sides (Papakartari yoga), AND when the lords of these 5th houses are posited in Dusstthanas (6th, 8th, or 12th) — the person can have no children whatsoever. No children whatsoever
interpretation.summary: When the 5th places from Lagna, Jupiter, and Moon are all associated with or aspected by malefics, devoid of benefics, surrounded by malefics (Papakartari), AND their lords are in Dusstthanas — no children at all.

source.original_text: If a malefic planet owning the 5th house be in that house, the person concerned will have children.

interpretation.detailed: If a malefic planet is the lord of the 5th house AND is posited in that 5th house, the person will have children. This is a positive exception: normally a malefic in the 5th is adverse for children, but when that malefic is the 5th lord itself (owning the house it occupies), the result is positive — the malefic lord strengthens its own house. Native will have children
interpretation.summary: When a malefic planet that owns the 5th house is also posited in the 5th house, the native will have children — an exception to the general malefic affliction rule.

source.original_text: When that house is occupied by a malefic, the person will have sons in plenty.

interpretation.detailed: When the 5th house is occupied by a malefic planet (that is not the 5th house lord), the person will have sons in plenty. The distinction between this rule and Rule 004: here the malefic is a visitor, not the house owner. The result is abundant male progeny. Sons in plenty
interpretation.summary: When a malefic planet that does not own the 5th house occupies it, the native will have sons in plenty.

source.original_text: If a benefic planet should occupy the 5th house and at the same time own that sign or be in exaltation there, the result is loss of children.

interpretation.detailed: If a benefic planet occupies the 5th house AND simultaneously owns that 5th house sign OR is in exaltation in the 5th house — the result is loss of children. This counterintuitive rule applies the Karako Bhava Nasaya principle from Ch15: when a Karaka (here, Jupiter is the natural Karaka of children) is in its own or exalted position in the Bhava it signifies, it can destroy that Bhava's human-level manifestation. Loss of children
interpretation.summary: When a benefic planet occupies the 5th house and simultaneously is in its own sign or exaltation, the result is loss of children — counterintuitive to general benefic doctrine.

source.original_text: The signs Vrischika, Kanya and Simha when they happen to represent the 5th house are termed childless Rasis and a person born under such a condition will be of very limited progeny and this too will be accomplished only after a long interval.

interpretation.detailed: The signs Scorpio (Vrischika), Virgo (Kanya), and Leo (Simha), when they represent the 5th house in a nativity, are termed childless Rasis. A person born with any of these signs as their 5th house sign will have very limited progeny, and this too will be accomplished only after a long interval (delayed children). These signs are naturally infertile for the 5th house by classical Phaladeepika classification. Very limited progeny, only after long interval
interpretation.summary: When Scorpio (Vrischika), Virgo (Kanya), or Leo (Simha) is the 5th house sign, these are 'childless Rasis' — the native will have very limited progeny and only after a long interval.

source.original_text: When the Sun is posited in the 5th house identical with childless Rasi, Saturn is in the 8th and Mars in the Lagna — or when Saturn, Jupiter and Mars occupy respectively the Lagna, the 5th and the 12th and the 5th house happens to be a childless sign — or when the Moon occupies the 11th and the 5th house reckoned from Jupiter is occupied by a malefic planet and there are many planets stationed in the Lagna — the person concerned will have a child late in life after a great effort.

interpretation.detailed: Three yogas that predict a child only late in life after great effort: (1) Sun in 5th (childless Rasi) + Saturn in 8th + Mars in Lagna; (2) Saturn/Jupiter/Mars in Lagna/5th/12th respectively AND 5th house is a childless sign (Scorpio/Virgo/Leo); (3) Moon in 11th + malefic in the 5th reckoned from Jupiter + many planets in the Lagna. Child late in life after great effort
interpretation.summary: Three specific planetary configurations predict that the native will have a child only late in life and after great effort, involving childless signs and specific malefic placements.

components.description: Sun in 5th (childless Rasi) + Saturn in 8th + Mars in Lagna
Saturn in Lagna + Jupiter in 5th + Mars in 12th + 5th house is childless sign
Moon in 11th + malefic in 5th from Jupiter + many planets in Lagna

source.original_text: If the Sun should singly occupy the 5th house identical with Karkataka there is possibility of the person concerned having children by a second wife. The same should be predicted if Mars or Venus be similarly situated. Saturn in such a position will give many children. The Moon or Mercury similarly placed will not give many while Jupiter in the Moon's sign identical with the 5th house will make the person concerned the father of many daughters.

interpretation.detailed: When Cancer (Karkataka) is the 5th house, the outcome for children depends on which planet occupies it alone (singly): Sun alone → children by second wife; Mars alone → children by second wife; Venus alone → children by second wife; Saturn → many children; Moon → not many children; Mercury → not many children; Jupiter (in Moon's sign Cancer as 5th) → father of many daughters.
interpretation.summary: When Cancer (Karkataka) is the 5th house, the planet occupying it determines the children outcome: Sun/Mars/Venus alone → children by second wife; Saturn → many children; Moon/Mercury → not many children; Jupiter → many daughters.

source.original_text: The following 4 yogas lead to family extinction: (1) the 4th, the 7th and the 10th houses being occupied respectively by a malefic planet, Venus and the Moon; (2) the 12th, the 8th, the 5th and the 1st houses being occupied by malefics; (3) Venus and Mercury in the 7th, Jupiter in the 5th and malefics in the 4th houses and (4) the Moon in the 5th and malefics in the 8th, the 12th and the 1st.

interpretation.detailed: Four yogas that lead to family extinction (complete childlessness/no descendants): (1) Malefic in 4th + Venus in 7th + Moon in 10th; (2) Malefics in 12th + 8th + 5th + 1st simultaneously; (3) Venus+Mercury in 7th + Jupiter in 5th + malefics in 4th; (4) Moon in 5th + malefics in 8th + 12th + 1st. Family extinction — no descendants
interpretation.summary: Four specific planetary configurations lead to family extinction — no descendants. Malefics in key houses, combined with specific benefic/malefic placements, destroy the 5th house potential.

components.description: Malefic in 4th + Venus in 7th + Moon in 10th
Malefics in 12th, 8th, 5th, and 1st
Venus+Mercury in 7th + Jupiter in 5th + malefics in 4th
Moon in 5th + malefics in 8th, 12th, and 1st

source.original_text: The following two yogas lead to affliction through children or barrenness: (1) a malefic in the Lagna, its lord in the 5th, the lord of the 5th in the 3rd, and the Moon in an odd Rasi or Amsa in the 5th and aspected by the Sun. [Yoga 2: OCR corrupt]

interpretation.detailed: Of two yogas declared for barrenness or affliction through children, only Yoga 1 is legible from the available PDF: Malefic planet in the Lagna + Lagna lord in the 5th house + 5th lord in the 3rd house + Moon in an odd Rasi or Amsa posited in the 5th house + Moon aspected by the Sun → barrenness or affliction through children. The second yoga of Sloka 7 is OCR-corrupt and cannot be determined from the available source. Barrenness or affliction through children
interpretation.summary: Yoga 1: Malefic in Lagna + Lagna lord in 5th + 5th lord in 3rd + Moon in odd sign/Navamsa in 5th + Moon aspected by Sun → barrenness or affliction through children.

source.original_text: If the 5th bhava be a sign owned by Saturn or Mercury and is aspected by or associated with Mandi or Saturn, the person concerned will have a son by adoption. The same will be the result when the lord of the 5th house is weak and is not connected in any way with the lords of the 1st and the 7th houses.

interpretation.detailed: Two conditions that lead to having a son by adoption: (A) The 5th Bhava is a sign owned by Saturn (Capricorn/Aquarius) or Mercury (Gemini/Virgo) AND that 5th house is aspected by or associated with Mandi or Saturn; (B) The lord of the 5th house is weak AND not connected in any way with the lords of the 1st and 7th houses (no conjunction, aspect, or sign exchange). Either condition indicates adopted progeny. Son by adoption
interpretation.summary: Two conditions for an adopted son: (A) 5th is a Saturn/Mercury sign and aspected/associated with Mandi or Saturn; (B) 5th lord is weak and unconnected with 1st and 7th lords.

components.description: 5th house is Saturn or Mercury sign AND aspected/associated with Mandi or Saturn
5th lord is weak AND not connected with 1st or 7th lords

source.original_text: If the lord of the 5th house be in depression or in an inimical house or be eclipsed, or be in conjunction with the lords of the 12th, the 6th and the 8th houses, the result will be the loss of children. The same will be the case when the lord of the 5th is posited in the 5th and is not aspected by benefics.

interpretation.detailed: Two conditions causing loss of children: (A) The lord of the 5th house is in depression (Neecha) OR in an inimical sign OR is eclipsed (combust) OR is in conjunction with the lords of the 12th, 6th, and 8th houses — loss of children results. (B) The lord of the 5th house is posited in the 5th house itself but is not aspected by any benefic planet — the same loss of children results. The second condition is unexpected: a 5th lord in its own house but without benefic aspect is still adverse. Loss of children
interpretation.summary: Loss of children results when the 5th lord is debilitated, in enemy's sign, combust, or conjunct 12/6/8 lords. Also when the 5th lord is in the 5th but unaspected by benefics.

components.description: 5th lord in depression or inimical sign or combust or conjunct 6/8/12 lords
5th lord in 5th house but unaspected by benefics

source.original_text: If in any nativity the lord of the 5th house, Jupiter, Mars and the Sun are all posited in male Navamsas, they lead to the possession of a good number of children, so the sages say, the nature — good or otherwise — of the children being ascertained from the strength of the lord of the 5th house.

interpretation.detailed: If in any nativity the lord of the 5th house, Jupiter, Mars, and the Sun are all posited in male Navamsas (Navamsa signs of odd signs: Aries, Gemini, Leo, Libra, Sagittarius, Aquarius), they lead to the possession of a good number of children. The quality and character of the children — good or otherwise — is ascertained from the strength and dignity of the lord of the 5th house. Good number of children
interpretation.summary: When the 5th lord, Jupiter, Mars, and the Sun are all in male Navamsas, the native will have a good number of children. The quality of children depends on the strength of the 5th lord.

condition.description: 5th lord + Jupiter + Mars + Sun all in male Navamsas (odd sign Navamsas)

source.original_text: If the house or its lord be posited in a male sign or Amsa or be in conjunction with or aspected by male planets, the children will be all males.

interpretation.detailed: If the 5th house sign or the 5th lord is posited in a male sign (odd signs: Aries, Gemini, Leo, Libra, Sagittarius, Aquarius) or a male Navamsa (Amsa), OR is in conjunction with or aspected by male planets (Sun, Mars, Jupiter — the three male grahas), the children will all be males. All children will be male
interpretation.summary: When the 5th house or its lord is in a male sign or Navamsa, or conjunct/aspected by male planets, all children will be male.

condition.description: 5th house sign OR 5th lord in male sign/Navamsa, or with/aspected by male planets (Sun, Mars, Jupiter).

source.original_text: The birth will be of daughters if the said house or its lord be in a female Rasi or Amsa, or be associated with or aspected by female planets.

interpretation.detailed: The birth will be of daughters if the 5th house sign or the 5th lord is in a female Rasi (even signs: Taurus, Cancer, Virgo, Scorpio, Capricorn, Pisces) or a female Navamsa (Amsa of even signs), OR is associated with or aspected by female planets (Moon, Venus — the two female grahas). Children will be daughters
interpretation.summary: When the 5th house or its lord is in a female sign or Navamsa, or associated/aspected by female planets, the children will be daughters.

condition.description: 5th house sign OR 5th lord in female sign/Navamsa, or with/aspected by female planets (Moon, Venus).

source.original_text: Conception (of a birth) may take place when the Sun and Venus in the case of males, and Mars and the Moon in the case of females, are possessed of strength and pass through their Rasis or Amsas identical with an Apachaya (1st, 2nd, 4th, 7th, 8th, 9th and 12th Rasi).

interpretation.detailed: Conception of a birth may take place when: (a) For male nativities: the Sun and Venus are strong AND are transiting through their Rasis or Navamsas (Amsas) that coincide with Apachaya positions (1st, 2nd, 4th, 7th, 8th, 9th, and 12th houses from some reference). (b) For female nativities: Mars and the Moon are strong AND are in similar Apachaya positions. Apachaya houses = 1, 2, 4, 7, 8, 9, 12 (contrast with Upachaya = 3, 6, 10, 11).
interpretation.summary: Conception occurs when Sun and Venus (for male native) or Mars and Moon (for female native) are strong and transit Apachaya positions (1,2,4,7,8,9,12 from a reference).

condition.description: Conception timing: Sun+Venus (male) or Mars+Moon (female) strong and in Apachaya positions (1,2,4,7,8,9,12).

source.original_text: The number of issues should be determined by a consideration of the planets in the 5th house or those that are posited along with the lord of the 5th house, as to how many of them are in friendly, depression or inimical Navamsas. A similar examination should also be made in respect of the 5th house or its lord reckoned from the sign occupied by Jupiter, the sign representing the Navamsa occupied by the Sun.

interpretation.detailed: The number of children is determined by: (1) Count planets in the 5th house OR planets conjunct the 5th lord — evaluate how many are in friendly, depression, or inimical Navamsas. (2) Repeat the same examination for the 5th house reckoned from the sign occupied by Jupiter. (3) Repeat for the 5th house reckoned from the sign representing the Navamsa occupied by the Sun. The combined count from all three reference points gives the number of children. Number of children determined by Navamsa dignity count from 3 reference points
interpretation.summary: Count children by examining planets in the 5th house (or with 5th lord) by their Navamsa dignity (friendly/depression/inimical). Repeat from 5th from Jupiter's sign and from 5th from Sun's Navamsa sign.

condition.description: Count children: planets in 5th (or with 5th lord) by Navamsa dignity × 3 reference points (5th from Lagna, 5th from Jupiter's sign, 5th from Sun's Navamsa sign).

source.original_text: Add together the figures representing the positions of Jupiter, the Moon and Mars in the case of female horoscopes. If the result denotes an even Rasi and an even Navamsa, the strength of fecundity in the female for producing offspring is assured. If it is mixed (i.e., Rasi male and Amsa female or vice versa), there will be children only after a great effort.

interpretation.detailed: Female fecundity test: Add together the positional figures for Jupiter, Moon, and Mars in the female horoscope. Evaluate the result as a Rasi (sign) and Navamsa: (a) Even Rasi + Even Navamsa → strength of fecundity is assured, easy child-bearing. (b) Mixed (Rasi male/Amsa female or Rasi female/Amsa male) → children only after great effort. (Note: the PDF also shows an example calculation for both a husband and wife's chart, but the table is OCR-corrupt and cannot be decoded.)
interpretation.summary: For female horoscopes, add the positional figures for Jupiter, Moon, and Mars. Even Rasi + even Navamsa = strong fecundity assured. Mixed (one even, one odd) = children only after great effort.

condition.description: Female: sum positions of Jupiter+Moon+Mars → evaluate as even/odd Rasi and Navamsa.

source.original_text: If the sum total of the figures denoting the positions of the Sun, Venus and Jupiter signify an odd Rasi and an odd Navamsa, it denotes that the virility in the male to produce offspring is very strong; and in case one of the two (Rasi and Navamsa) be even, one has to predict a mixed result.

interpretation.detailed: Male virility test: Add the positional figures for the Sun, Venus, and Jupiter. Evaluate the sum as a Rasi and Navamsa: (a) Odd Rasi + Odd Navamsa → very strong virility to produce offspring. (b) One of the two (Rasi or Navamsa) is even → mixed result predicted (moderate fertility).
interpretation.summary: For male horoscopes, add positions of Sun, Venus, and Jupiter. Odd Rasi + odd Navamsa = very strong virility. If one of the two is even = mixed result.

condition.description: Male: sum positions of Sun+Venus+Jupiter → evaluate as odd/even Rasi and Navamsa.

source.original_text: Subtract five times the figures for the Sun from five times the figures for the Moon. If the Tithi represented by the result be an auspicious one in the bright half of a month, progeny is assured to the native even without much exertion. But if it be one of the dark half of the month, there is no such possibility. It is by a close examination of the strength of the Tithi — whether it is auspicious or otherwise — in both the Pakshas that one has to divine the possibility of the native being blessed with issue. During an Amavasya, a Chidra Tithi, the Vishti Karana or any one of the Sthira Karanas, there will be no issue at all.

interpretation.detailed: Tithi-based progeny assessment methodology: Subtract 5 × Sun's positional figures from 5 × Moon's positional figures. The resulting value represents a Tithi in the lunar calendar. Interpretation: (a) Bright half auspicious Tithi → progeny assured, even without much exertion. (b) Dark half Tithi → no easy progeny possibility. (c) Absolutely no progeny during: Amavasya (new moon), any Chidra Tithi (Chaturthi, Shashthi, Ashtami, Navami, Dwadasi, Chaturdasi), Vishti Karana, or any Sthira Karana (Chatushpada, Nagava, Kimstughna, Shakuna).
interpretation.summary: Calculate (5 × Moon position) − (5 × Sun position) to find a Tithi. Bright half auspicious Tithi = progeny assured easily. Dark half = no progeny. Amavasya/Chidra/Vishti/Sthira Karanas = no children at all.

condition.description: Calculate (5 × Moon) − (5 × Sun) → determine Tithi → evaluate Paksha and Tithi quality.

source.original_text: If at a birth the lord of the 5th house be posited in its inimical or depression sign or be eclipsed (by the Sun's rays) or occupy any of the Dusstthanas (viz., the 6th, the 8th or the 12th); or the planet occupying the 5th house be similarly situated or happen to be the lord of any one of the three houses, viz., the 6th, the 8th or the 12th — one ought to declare childlessness as an inevitable result. He ought to divine the source of the same by an examination of the particular deity, tree and animal represented by the sign occupied or ruled by that planet.

interpretation.detailed: At birth, childlessness is inevitable when: (a) The 5th lord is in an inimical or depression sign OR is combust OR occupies a Dusstthana (6th, 8th, or 12th); OR (b) The planet occupying the 5th house is similarly debilitated/combust/Dusstthana-placed OR is the lord of the 6th, 8th, or 12th house. The source of this childlessness is identified by examining the deity, tree, and animal represented by the sign occupied or ruled by that afflicting planet. [Note: Sloka 19 recapitulates and extends Sloka 9 with the deity/tree/animal diagnostic dimension.] Inevitable childlessness
interpretation.summary: Childlessness is inevitable when the 5th lord is in depression, inimical sign, combust, or Dusstthana; or when the planet in 5th is similarly placed or is a Dusstthana lord. Source identified by the deity, tree, and animal of the offending planet's sign.

condition.description: 5th lord or planet in 5th: in depression/inimical/combust/Dusstthana or is Dusstthana lord.

source.original_text: If the planet in question happens to be the Sun, the person concerned becomes sonless owing to injury done to God Siva and Garuda and the displeasure of the Maries and anger of the mother. If the Moon, it will be owing to some hurt caused to a Sumangali or other venerable woman. Mars: fault to village deity, Kartikeya, enemy, or Dayadins. Mercury: curses by youngsters, killing of spawns, wrath of Vishnu. Jupiter: harm to hereditary Brahmin priest or destruction of fruit-bearing tree. Venus: cutting flower-bearing tree, injury to virtuous lady, cows, or revered persons. Saturn: destruction of Ashwattha tree, Yama's ire, departed spirits. Rahu: curse of a serpent. Ketu: curse of a Brahmin. Mandi: curse from departed spirits. Venus+Moon+Mandi: murder of a damsel or killing of a cow. Jupiter/Ketu+Mandi in 5th: murder of a Brahmin.

interpretation.detailed: Karmic cause of childlessness by afflicting planet: Sun → injury to Siva/Garuda or curse of Maries (ancestors)/anger of mother. Moon → hurt feelings of Sumangali (married woman) or venerable woman. Mars → fault done to village deity/Kartikeya/enemy/Dayadins. Mercury → curses by youngsters/killing of spawns (fish eggs)/wrath of Vishnu. Jupiter → harm to hereditary Brahmin priest or destruction of fruit-bearing tree. Venus → cutting flower-bearing tree or injury to virtuous lady/cows/revered persons. Saturn → destruction of Ashwattha (Peepal) tree or Yama's ire or departed spirits/goblins. Rahu → curse of a serpent. Ketu → curse of a Brahmin. Mandi → curse from departed spirits. Venus+Moon+Mandi together → murder of a damsel or killing of a cow. Jupiter/Ketu+Mandi in 5th → murder of a Brahmin.
interpretation.summary: When childlessness is indicated by an afflicted planet in/owning the 5th, the planet identifies the karmic cause (past-life sin). Complete 9-planet + Mandi + combination lookup table.

condition.description: Lookup: afflicting planet in or owning 5th → karmic cause of childlessness.

source.original_text: The birth of a son should be expected during the Dasa or Apahara of any one of the 6 planets, viz., (1) the lord of the Lagna, (2) the lord of the 7th, (3) the lord of the 5th, (4) Jupiter; (5) the planet aspecting the 5th house or (6) the one occupying the 5th house or when Jupiter in his orbit transits the sign or the Navamsa Rasi occupied by the lord of the 5th house or the Upagraha Yamakantaka.

interpretation.detailed: The birth of a son should be expected during the Dasa (Maha Dasha) or Apahara (Antardasha/Bhukti) of any one of these 6 planets: (1) Lord of the Lagna, (2) Lord of the 7th house, (3) Lord of the 5th house, (4) Jupiter, (5) Planet aspecting the 5th house, (6) Planet occupying the 5th house. ALTERNATIVELY: when Jupiter in his orbit transits the sign occupied by the lord of the 5th house OR the Navamsa-Rasi of the 5th lord OR the Upagraha Yamakantaka's position. Birth of a son is possible
interpretation.summary: Son birth expected during Dasha/Apahara of Lagna lord, 7th lord, 5th lord, Jupiter, planet aspecting 5th, or planet in 5th; OR when Jupiter transits the 5th lord's sign or Navamsa-Rasi or Yamakantaka.

condition.description: Dasha/Apahara of: Lagna lord, 7th lord, 5th lord, Jupiter, planet aspecting 5th, planet in 5th. OR Jupiter transit of 5th lord's sign/Navamsa.

source.original_text: Find when the lord of Lagna comes during his transit (1) in conjunction with the lord of the 5th house (2) to his exaltation sign (3) to his own Rasi (4) to the 5th house and (5) to the sign occupied by the lord of the 5th house. During any one of these transits the birth of a son is possible.

interpretation.detailed: The birth of a son is possible when the lord of the Lagna (Lagna lord) during its transit: (1) Comes into conjunction with the lord of the 5th house, OR (2) Transits to its own exaltation sign, OR (3) Transits to its own Rasi (own sign), OR (4) Transits to the 5th house, OR (5) Transits to the sign occupied by the lord of the 5th house. Any one of these five transit conditions is sufficient. Birth of a son is possible
interpretation.summary: Son birth is possible during any of 5 Lagna lord transit conditions: conjunct 5th lord, in own exaltation, in own sign, transiting 5th house, or transiting sign of 5th lord.

condition.description: Lagna lord transit to: (1) conjunct 5th lord, (2) own exaltation, (3) own sign, (4) 5th house, (5) 5th lord's sign — any one = son birth possible.

source.original_text: Add the figures of the following three planets (1) the lord of the Lagna (2) the lord of the 7th house and (3) the lord of the 5th house. During the course of the Maha Dasa represented by the ruler of the asterism and in the Apaharas of any one of the following, viz., (1) the planet in the 5th house, (2) the planet aspecting the 5th house and (3) the planet owning the 5th house, the birth of a son may be predicted.

interpretation.detailed: Compound birth timing: Add the positional figures of (1) Lagna lord + (2) 7th lord + (3) 5th lord. The result represents a Nakshatra. During the course of the Maha Dasa of the planet ruling that Nakshatra, AND during the Apahara (Bhukti) of any one of: (a) the planet in the 5th house, (b) the planet aspecting the 5th house, or (c) the planet owning the 5th house — the birth of a son may be predicted. Birth of a son may be predicted
interpretation.summary: Add positions of Lagna lord + 7th lord + 5th lord. During the MahaDasa of the ruler of the Nakshatra of that sum AND Apahara of any of the 5th house activators — son birth predicted.

condition.description: MahaDasa of ruler of Nakshatra of (Lagna lord + 7th lord + 5th lord sum) AND Apahara of any 5th house activator.

source.original_text: Find which of the following is strong: (1) The lord of the 5th house (2) Jupiter, (3), (4), (5) and (6) the lords respectively of the Rasis and Navamsas occupied by (1) and (2). During the Dasa or Apahara of this strong planet, birth of a son is possible.

interpretation.detailed: Determine which planet is the strongest among: (1) The lord of the 5th house, (2) Jupiter, (3) The lord of the Rasi occupied by the 5th lord, (4) The lord of the Navamsa occupied by the 5th lord, (5) The lord of the Rasi occupied by Jupiter, (6) The lord of the Navamsa occupied by Jupiter. During the Dasa or Apahara of whichever among these 6 planets is the strongest, the birth of a son is possible. Birth of a son is possible during Dasha/Apahara of the strongest identified planet
interpretation.summary: Find the strongest among the 5th lord, Jupiter, and the lords of the signs and Navamsas they occupy. During its Dasha or Apahara, son birth is possible.

condition.description: Identify strongest of: 5th lord, Jupiter, lords of signs/Navamsas they occupy. During its Dasha/Apahara = son birth possible.

source.original_text: Men will generally have the birth of a son when Jupiter in the course of his orbit passes through a Hastrine to the sign representing the Kara or Amsa occupied by the planet owning the 5th house reckoned from Jupiter.

interpretation.detailed: Men will generally have the birth of a son when Jupiter, in the course of its orbital transit, passes through a house that is a Trikona (1st, 5th, or 9th) to the sign representing the Kara (sign) or Amsa (Navamsa) occupied by the planet owning the 5th house reckoned from Jupiter. The reference point for the 5th lord is Jupiter's own position: find the 5th from Jupiter, find that sign's lord, find where that lord is positioned, then look for Jupiter to transit Trikona to that position. Birth of a son is generally possible
interpretation.summary: Son birth generally occurs when Jupiter transits a Trikona to the sign or Navamsa occupied by the 5th lord (counting the 5th lord from Jupiter's position).

condition.description: Jupiter transits Trikona to sign/Navamsa of 5th lord reckoned from Jupiter.

source.original_text: Note the ruler of the asterism occupied by the Moon as also that of the 5th from it. Add the figures of these two planets. When Jupiter in his orbit passes through the sign represented by this result or through one of its triangular ones, the birth of a son is possible.

interpretation.detailed: Moon-based son timing: (1) Note the planet ruling the Nakshatra (asterism) occupied by the Moon. (2) Note the planet ruling the 5th Nakshatra from the Moon's Nakshatra. (3) Add the positional figures of these two planets. (4) The result represents a sign. When Jupiter in its orbit transits that resulting sign or any of its Trikona signs (1st, 5th, or 9th from it), the birth of a son is possible. Birth of a son is possible
interpretation.summary: Find the Nakshatra rulers of (a) the Moon's Nakshatra and (b) the 5th Nakshatra from it. Add their figures. When Jupiter transits the resulting sign or its Trikona — son birth is possible.

condition.description: Sum Nakshatra rulers of Moon's Nakshatra + 5th Nakshatra from Moon. When Jupiter transits that sign or Trikona = son possible.

source.original_text: The birth (of a child) may also take place when the Sun in his orbit passes through the third sign reckoned from the Rasi representing the Nisheka Lagna or transits a Rasi triangular to the Adhana Lagna.

interpretation.detailed: The birth of a child may also take place when: (a) The Sun in its orbit passes through the 3rd sign reckoned from the Rasi representing the Nisheka Lagna (conception Lagna — the Lagna at the time of conception), OR (b) The Sun transits a Rasi that is a Trikona (1st, 5th, or 9th) to the Adhana Lagna (the Lagna at the time of impregnation). Both Nisheka and Adhana refer to the Lagna at the time of conception/impregnation. Birth of a child may take place
interpretation.summary: Child birth may occur when the Sun transits the 3rd sign from the Nisheka (conception) Lagna, or any Trikona to the Adhana (impregnation) Lagna.

condition.description: Sun transits 3rd from Nisheka Lagna OR Trikona to Adhana Lagna = child birth possible.

source.original_text: If a birth takes place in a Lagna which is the 5th or the 9th from the Adhana Lagna, it should be declared as through the effects of the native's good actions done in previous births. If benefics should occupy or aspect the Adhana Lagna, the person born will be endowed with long life, wealth and happiness.

interpretation.detailed: If the Lagna at birth falls in the 5th or 9th sign from the Adhana Lagna (the Lagna at the time of conception/impregnation) — this indicates that the birth occurs through the effects of the native's good actions in previous births (positive karma). Additionally, if benefic planets occupy or aspect the Adhana Lagna, the person born will be endowed with long life, wealth, and happiness.
interpretation.summary: If the birth Lagna is the 5th or 9th from the Adhana (conception) Lagna, it indicates good past karma. If benefics occupy or aspect the Adhana Lagna, the born child will have long life, wealth, and happiness.

condition.description: (A) Birth Lagna is 5th or 9th from Adhana Lagna. (B) Benefics in/aspecting Adhana Lagna.

source.original_text: Find the exact Dwadasamsa of the Moon at the time of the Adhana and the Rasi to which it belongs. Count from Mesha (or from this sign) as many Rasis as the number represented by the Dwadasamsa in question. When the Moon is in the Rasi thus found in the month of delivery, the birth of the child in the womb may be expected.

interpretation.detailed: Delivery timing method: Find the exact Dwadasamsa division of the Moon at the time of Adhana (conception). Identify the number of that Dwadasamsa (1 through 12, each being 2.5° of a sign = 30° divided into 12 parts). Count that many Rasis from Aries (Mesha) or from the Moon's current sign. The resulting sign is the delivery indicator. When the Moon is in that sign during the month of expected delivery, the birth of the child in the womb may be expected. Requires `dwadasamsa_calculator` engine dependency. Birth expected when Moon transits the sign determined by Dwadasamsa count
interpretation.summary: Find the Dwadasamsa (1/12 division) of the Moon at the time of conception. Count that many Rasis from Aries. When the Moon transits that resulting sign in the delivery month, birth is expected.

condition.description: Dwadasamsa of Moon at Adhana → count Rasis from Aries → Moon reaches that sign in delivery month.

source.original_text: One ought to predict effects by a consideration of the positions of the several planets with respect to the Moon and the Lagna at the time of a query, adoption of a son, investiture of sacred thread, the gift of a girl, the first maturity, or the time of impregnation, as he would if a birth had taken place at the time.

interpretation.detailed: For any of the following events, predict effects by examining the positions of all planets with respect to the Moon and the Lagna at the time of that event, exactly as one would for a birth chart: (1) A query (Prashna), (2) Adoption of a son, (3) Upanayana (investiture of sacred thread), (4) Gift/marriage of a daughter, (5) A girl's first maturity (first menstruation), (6) Time of impregnation (Adhana). The event chart (Prashna chart) at the moment of the event is treated as equivalent to a birth horoscope for prediction purposes. Effects predicted from event chart as if it were a birth chart
interpretation.summary: For any event (query, adoption, Upanayana, marriage of daughter, first maturity, impregnation), predict effects from Moon and Lagna positions at that event time as if it were a birth chart.

condition.description: Event chart (query/adoption/Upanayana/first maturity/impregnation): Moon+Lagna at event time = treated as birth chart.

source.original_text: As regards the correct determining of the Lagna of birth, some opine that it is the time of Adhana (impregnation); others say that it is the time when the head of the infant emerges; some others say that it is the time when the child touches the ground; while other experts in Astrology hold that it is the time when the child gets itself completely separated from the mother's womb.

interpretation.detailed: Four classical opinions exist regarding the correct birth Lagna for longevity determination: (1) The time of Adhana (impregnation) — Adhana Lagna. (2) The time when the head of the infant emerges from the birth canal. (3) The time when the child touches the ground (first contact with Earth). (4) The time when the child is completely separated from the mother's womb. The text presents all four without declaring a definitive standard. For engine implementation, the standard modern practice is the time of first breath/complete separation from the womb. Birth Lagna defined by one of four classical methods. Standard default: complete separation from womb.
interpretation.summary: Four different classical opinions on what constitutes the birth Lagna for longevity calculation: (1) Adhana/impregnation time, (2) head emergence, (3) child touching ground, (4) complete separation from womb.

condition.description: Four definitions of birth Lagna for longevity calculation. Engine should default to complete separation time unless user specifies otherwise.

source.original_text: In the case of viviparous creatures, it is not possible to determine the period of life within the first twelve years. In consequence of the sinful acts of the parents, the child meets with destruction being seized by demons called Balagrahas.

interpretation.detailed: For all viviparous (born from the womb) creatures, including humans, it is not possible to determine the period of life definitively within the first twelve years. During this Balarishta period, children are susceptible to destruction from Balagrahas (malefic demons/forces attacking children) as a consequence of the sinful acts of the parents in this or a previous birth. Longevity calculations should only be applied with confidence after the child survives the 12-year Balarishta window. Longevity indeterminate in first 12 years; Balarishta threat from Balagrahas
interpretation.summary: In the first 12 years of life, definitive longevity cannot be determined. Children face Balarishta (childhood ills) from Balagrahas due to parental sins. Longevity analysis is only reliable after the child survives the Balarishta period.

condition.description: Longevity calculation gated: only reliable after 12-year Balarishta period survives.

source.original_text: If the child dies in the first four years, it is because of the mother's sins. If in the middle four years, it is owing to the accumulated sins of the father. If it comes by its death in the last four years, it must be due to its own sins in a previous birth.

interpretation.detailed: The cause of a child's death within the Balarishta window (first 12 years) is identified by which 4-year sub-period the death occurs in: First 4 years (ages 1-4) → caused by the mother's sins (in this or a previous birth). Middle 4 years (ages 5-8) → caused by the accumulated sins of the father. Last 4 years (ages 9-12) → caused by the child's own sins from a previous birth.
interpretation.summary: Within the first 12 years: death in years 1-4 = mother's sins; years 5-8 = father's sins; years 9-12 = child's own past-life sins.

condition.description: Death timing within 12-year Balarishta → identifies karmic cause by 4-year sub-period.

source.original_text: The first eight years in men's lives is the period of Balarishta — ills that afflict children. Till the 20th year, they say, it is the Yogarishta period. It is called Alpayus or short life when the period extends to 32. It is called Madhyamayus or middle age when the period of life extends to 70 years. It is Purnayus when the period of life extends to 100 years. A hundred years are generally reckoned as the period of life for human beings.

interpretation.detailed: Life stage categories per Phaladeepika: (1) Balarishta: first 8 years — ills that afflict children (childhood diseases, Balagrahas). (2) Yogarishta: ages 8-20 — evils brought on by planetary conjunctions. (3) Alpayus: up to 32 years — short life classification. (4) Madhyamayus: up to 70 years — medium/middle age classification. (5) Purnayus: up to 100 years — full life. The standard human lifespan is 100 years, divided into three equal portions representing short/medium/long lived.
interpretation.summary: Phaladeepika's longevity classification: 0-8 years = Balarishta; 8-20 = Yogarishta; up to 32 = Alpayus (short life); up to 70 = Madhyamayus (medium); up to 100 = Purnayus (full life). 100 years = standard human lifespan.

condition.description: Longevity category thresholds: Balarishta 0-8, Yogarishta 8-20, Alpayus to 32, Madhyamayus to 70, Purnayus to 100.

source.original_text: If a birth occurs in any of the evil Yogas Dinamrityu, Dinaroga or Vishaghatikala, the child will die very soon.

interpretation.detailed: If a birth occurs during any of the three evil Yogas: (1) Dinamrityu (day of death — occurring when specified quarter falls during daytime), (2) Dinaroga (day of illness), or (3) Vishaghatikala (poison-time) — the child will die very soon after birth. These are specific Tithi-Karana-time combinations that create powerful adversarial conditions for newborns. Child dies very soon after birth
interpretation.summary: A child born during Dinamrityu, Dinaroga, or Vishaghatikala Yoga will die very soon after birth.

condition.description: Birth during Dinamrityu, Dinaroga, or Vishaghatikala yoga.

source.original_text: If there be a birth when the Moon is in the asterisms Pushya, Purvashadha, and Chitra, the death of the father, the mother, the child or the maternal uncle respectively should be predicted according as the Moon is stationed in the 1st, 2nd, 3rd or 4th quarter of any of these stars at the time.

interpretation.detailed: If a birth occurs when the Moon is in the Nakshatras Pushya, Purvashadha, or Chitra, the death of a specific family member is predicted based on which quarter (pada) of the Nakshatra the Moon occupies: 1st quarter → father dies; 2nd quarter → mother dies; 3rd quarter → child (the newborn) dies; 4th quarter → maternal uncle dies. This applies equally to all three Nakshatras (Pushya, Purvashadha, Chitra).
interpretation.summary: Birth when Moon is in Pushya, Purvashadha, or Chitra — the quarter of that Nakshatra determines who dies: 1st quarter = father; 2nd = mother; 3rd = child; 4th = maternal uncle.

condition.description: Moon in Pushya/Purvashadha/Chitra at birth → quarter determines which family member dies.

source.original_text: If a birth occurs when the Moon is in Moola and if the Lagna should also have no connection with any of the benefic planets either by occupation or by aspect, the destruction respectively of the father, the mother or of the family itself should be expected according as the Moon is in the 1st, 2nd or the 3rd quarter. But if the birth be when the Moon is in the 4th quarter of Moola, there will be prosperity and wealth. In the case of Aslesha, the result will be reverse.

interpretation.detailed: If a birth occurs when the Moon is in Moola Nakshatra AND the Lagna has no connection with any benefic planet (neither by occupation nor by aspect): 1st quarter → father is destroyed; 2nd quarter → mother is destroyed; 3rd quarter → the family itself is destroyed. If the birth is in the 4th quarter of Moola → prosperity and wealth. For Ashlesha Nakshatra, the results are the reverse of Moola.
