interpretation.summary: Birth with Moon in Moola: 1st quarter = father dies; 2nd = mother dies; 3rd = family itself destroyed (condition: no benefic in/aspecting Lagna). 4th quarter = prosperity. Ashlesha gives reverse results.

source.original_text: If a birth happens at the extreme end of a Rasi which is associated with or aspected by a malefic planet, the child will surely meet with its death at once. If the birth be at a Gandantha, the father, the mother, or the child itself will die. Should however the child survive, he will become a king. If born at the junction of any one of the four corners identical with the conjunction at or aspect by a malefic, the death of the child will soon happen. The same result will occur if the Moon at birth attains the fateful degree in any sign and is at the same time posited in a Kendra or the 8th house.

interpretation.detailed: Four Gandantha/extreme birth conditions: (1) Birth at extreme end of a Rasi with malefic association/aspect → child dies at once. (2) Gandantha birth (junction of Water and Fire signs: Pisces-Aries, Cancer-Leo, Scorpio-Sagittarius) → father, mother, or child dies; BUT if the child survives, they will become a king. (3) Birth at junction of any one of the four corners (Kendra cusps) with malefic conjunction or aspect → child dies soon. (4) Moon at the Mrityubhaga (fatal) degree in any sign AND simultaneously in a Kendra or the 8th house → death.
interpretation.summary: Birth at extreme Rasi end with malefic = immediate child death. Gandantha birth = father/mother/child dies; but if child survives, becomes king. Birth at 4-corner junction with malefic = child dies soon. Moon at Mrityubhaga degree in Kendra/8th = death.

components.description: Birth at extreme end of Rasi + malefic in/aspecting that sign
Gandantha birth (sign junction point of Water-Fire)
Birth at 4-corner junction with malefic aspect/conjunction
Moon at Mrityubhaga degree + in Kendra or 8th

source.original_text: If the degrees attained by the Moon in Mesha and the other signs be respectively 26, 12, 13, 25, 24, 11, 26, 14, 13, 25, 5 and 12, they indicate death.

interpretation.detailed: If the Moon attains the following degrees in the respective signs (from Mesha/Aries through Meena/Pisces), they indicate death: Mesha 26°, Vrishabha 12°, Mithuna 13°, Karkataka 25°, Simha 24°, Kanya 11°, Tula 26°, Vrischika 14°, Dhanu 13°, Makara 25°, Kumbha 5°, Meena 12°. (This is one of two sets of Mrityubhaga degrees — see Rule 010 for the second set.)
interpretation.summary: Set 1 of Mrityubhaga (fatal) degrees: if the Moon is at these specific degrees in the respective signs, death is indicated. Signs from Mesha (Aries) to Meena (Pisces).

condition.description: Moon at Mrityubhaga degree in any sign → death indicated. Lookup: sign → fatal degree.

source.original_text: The following are also respectively deemed (by some others) as Mrityubhagas or fateful degrees in the several signs from Mesha onwards: 8, 9, 22, 22, 25, 14, 4, 23, 18, 20, [OCR missing], and 10.

interpretation.detailed: A second set of Mrityubhaga (fateful) degrees declared by other classical authorities, from Mesha (Aries) onwards: 8, 9, 22, 22, 25, 14, 4, 23, 18, 20, [11th sign value OCR-corrupt], 10. The 11th sign (Aquarius/Kumbha) degree is not legible in the available PDF. This set differs from Set 1 (Rule 009) and represents an alternative classical opinion.
interpretation.summary: Set 2 of Mrityubhaga degrees (alternative classical authority): Aries 8°, Taurus 9°, Gemini 22°, Cancer 22°, Leo 25°, Virgo 14°, Libra 4°, Scorpio 23°, Sagittarius 18°, Capricorn 20°, Aquarius [OCR-missing], Pisces 10°.

condition.description: Moon at Mrityubhaga degree (Set 2) in any sign → death indicated. 11th sign (Aquarius) value OCR-missing.

source.original_text: One may predict the death of the child to occur very soon in the following cases: (1) when malefics occupy by themselves the 8th and the Kendra houses, (2) when malefics are all placed in the 1st and the 8th houses (3) when they occupy the 1st and the 7th, (4) when the Moon or the Lagna is betwixt two malefics, (5) if the Moon being devoid of strength occupy the 6th, the 5th or the 12th, (6) if the waning Moon in conjunction with a malefic is in the 1st, 5th, 7th, or 9th house (7) if the malefics be in the 8th and 7th and (8) when no benefic planets occupy or aspect a Kendra house.

interpretation.detailed: Eight configurations predicting imminent child death (any one sufficient): (1) Malefics alone in 8th AND Kendra houses. (2) All malefics in 1st and 8th. (3) Malefics in 1st and 7th. (4) Moon or Lagna situated between two malefics (Papakartari yoga). (5) Weak Moon in 6th, 5th, or 12th. (6) Waning Moon conjunct a malefic in 1st, 5th, 7th, or 9th. (7) Malefics in 8th and 7th simultaneously. (8) No benefic planets occupying or aspecting any Kendra house. Child will die very soon
interpretation.summary: Any one of 8 planetary configurations predicts the child will die very soon: malefics in 8th+Kendra; all malefics in 1st+8th; malefics in 1st+7th; Papakartari on Moon/Lagna; weak Moon in 6/5/12; waning Moon+malefic in 1/5/7/9; malefics in 8+7; no benefics in any Kendra.

components.description: Malefics alone in 8th + Kendra houses
All malefics in 1st and 8th
Malefics in 1st and 7th
Moon or Lagna Papakartari (between two malefics)
Weak Moon in 6th, 5th, or 12th
Waning Moon + malefic in 1st/5th/7th/9th
Malefics in 8th and 7th
No benefic in any Kendra

source.original_text: When the lord of the Lagna or of the sign occupied by the Moon at birth is weak and badly placed (i.e., in the 6th, 8th or 12th house), the child will die within as many years as are represented by the said sign when counted from Mesha. If the planet owning the Lagna-decanate or the decanate occupied by the Moon be weak and badly placed, the period of exit of the child will be as many months as are represented by the sign owning the decanate. The period of life will be so many days from birth as are signified by the Rasi owning the Navamsa Lagna or Chandra Navamsa when the planet owning this is weak and similarly badly-placed.

interpretation.detailed: Longevity arithmetic using weak/badly placed lords: (1) If the lord of the Lagna OR of the Moon's sign is weak AND in 6th/8th/12th → life = as many YEARS as the sign number counting from Mesha (Aries=1, Taurus=2... Pisces=12). (2) If the lord of the Lagna-decanate OR the Moon's decanate lord is weak AND badly placed → life = as many MONTHS as the sign number of that decanate's owner. (3) If the lord of the Navamsa Lagna OR the Chandra Navamsa lord is weak AND similarly placed → life = as many DAYS as the sign number of that Navamsa's owner. Compare all three levels and determine which dominates, checking also malefics in the 5th and 8th.
interpretation.summary: When Lagna lord or Moon sign lord is weak in 6/8/12: life = sign-number in YEARS. If decanate lord is weak: life = sign-number in MONTHS. If Navamsa lord is weak: life = sign-number in DAYS.

condition.description: Weak Lagna/Moon lord in Dusstthana → years; weak decanate lord → months; weak Navamsa lord → days. Life = sign-number count from Mesha.

source.original_text: Consider the following 3 pairs (A) the decanate Rasis of the Lagna and the Moon; (B) the Navamsa Rasis of the lord of the Lagna and the lord of the sign occupied by the Moon and (C) the Dwadasamsa Rasis of the lord of the Lagna and of the lord of the 8th house. The life of the child may be pronounced as Deergha, Madhya and Alpa according as when one of the Rasis is a Chara sign the other is a Chara, Sthira and Ubhaya sign respectively, when one is a Sthira sign the other is Dwandwa, Chara and Sthira sign and when one is Dwandwa the other is in a Sthira, Dwandwa and Chara sign.

interpretation.detailed: Three pairs are evaluated: (A) Lagna decanate Rasi vs Moon decanate Rasi; (B) Navamsa Rasi of Lagna lord vs Navamsa Rasi of Moon sign lord; (C) Dwadasamsa Rasi of Lagna lord vs Dwadasamsa Rasi of 8th lord. For each pair, apply the sign-type matrix: Chara×Chara=Deergha(long); Chara×Sthira=Madhya(medium); Chara×Ubhaya=Alpa(short); Sthira×Ubhaya=Deergha; Sthira×Chara=Madhya; Sthira×Sthira=Alpa; Ubhaya×Sthira=Deergha; Ubhaya×Ubhaya=Madhya; Ubhaya×Chara=Alpa. Sign types: Chara (moveable/cardinal) = Aries, Cancer, Libra, Capricorn; Sthira (fixed) = Taurus, Leo, Scorpio, Aquarius; Ubhaya/Dwandwa (dual/mutable) = Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, Pisces. Aggregate results from all 3 pairs to determine overall longevity category.
interpretation.summary: Evaluate 3 pairs of Rasis across three varga levels. The longevity category (Deergha/Madhya/Alpa) is determined by the sign-type combination of each pair using a 3×3 matrix.

condition.description: 3-pair sign-type matrix for longevity: (A) decanate Rasis, (B) Navamsa Rasi lords, (C) Dwadasamsa lords. Apply Chara/Sthira/Ubhaya matrix per pair.

source.original_text: The life of the native may be pronounced as long, medium and short according as the benefics and the lord of the Lagna are all posited in Kendra, Panaphara and Apoklima houses respectively. If the lord of the 8th house and the malefics occupy similar positions, the reverse should be predicted.

interpretation.detailed: Longevity determination by house position group: (a) Benefics AND Lagna lord all in Kendra houses (1,4,7,10) → long life. (b) Same in Panaphara houses (2,5,8,11) → medium life. (c) Same in Apoklima houses (3,6,9,12) → short life. Reverse condition: If the lord of the 8th house AND malefics occupy Kendra → short life; Panaphara → medium life reversed; Apoklima → long life.
interpretation.summary: Life is long when benefics and Lagna lord are in Kendra; medium in Panaphara; short in Apoklima. When 8th lord and malefics occupy similar positions, the reverse applies.

condition.description: Position of benefics + Lagna lord in Kendra/Panaphara/Apoklima → longevity. 8th lord + malefics in same → reverse.

source.original_text: Ascertain the friendship or otherwise of the following pairs: (1) the lord of the house occupied by the Moon and that of the 8th house from the Moon (2) lord of the Lagna and that of the 8th house from the Lagna and (3) the Sun and the lord of the Lagna. If they are friendly, the native will be long-lived; if inimical, he will be short-lived; if neutral, he will have medium life.

interpretation.detailed: Three planet-pair friendship tests for longevity: Pair 1: Lord of Moon's sign vs Lord of 8th from Moon — friendly relationship → long life; inimical → short life; neutral → medium life. Pair 2: Lagna lord vs Lord of 8th house from Lagna — same analysis. Pair 3: The Sun vs Lagna lord — same analysis. The predominant result across all three pairs determines overall longevity classification.
interpretation.summary: Evaluate three pairs: (1) Moon sign lord vs 8th from Moon lord; (2) Lagna lord vs 8th lord; (3) Sun vs Lagna lord. Friendly pair = long life; inimical = short; neutral = medium.

condition.description: Evaluate friendship of: (1) Moon's sign lord vs 8th from Moon lord; (2) Lagna lord vs 8th lord; (3) Sun vs Lagna lord. Friendly = long; inimical = short; neutral = medium.

source.original_text: If the lord of the Lagna Rasi and the lord of the Lagna Navamsa be stronger than the lords of the 8th house reckoned from each, the native will be long-lived. The same remark holds good with respect to the lord of the Rasi occupied by the Moon or the lord of the Moon's Navamsa. If otherwise, the reverse will be the result.

interpretation.detailed: Two strength comparison tests for longevity: (A) If the lord of the Lagna (natal sign) AND the lord of the Lagna Navamsa are both stronger than the lords of the 8th house counted from each of them respectively → long life. (B) Same for the Moon: lord of Moon's natal sign AND lord of Moon's Navamsa sign both stronger than their respective 8th lords → long life. If either comparison shows the 8th lord stronger → reverse (short life).
interpretation.summary: When the Lagna Rasi lord AND Lagna Navamsa lord are both stronger than their respective 8th lords — long life. Same analysis for Moon Rasi lord and Moon Navamsa lord. If reverse → short life.

condition.description: Lagna Rasi lord + Lagna Navamsa lord both stronger than respective 8th lords; Moon Rasi lord + Moon Navamsa lord same.

source.original_text: If the lord of the 8th house possessing greater strength than that of the lord of the Lagna occupy a Kendra, and if malefics be posited in the 8th and 12th houses, the life of the native will be short, or he may be of medium life, or even prolong his life to the full period with the vicissitudes of happiness and misery.

interpretation.detailed: When the lord of the 8th house is stronger than the lord of the Lagna AND occupies a Kendra house AND malefics are in the 8th and 12th houses — the life of the native may be: short life, OR medium life, OR even full 100-year life with alternating happiness and misery. The ambiguity is deliberate — this configuration is a mixed indicator requiring Dasha/Bhukti confirmation to determine which life length applies. Short life, medium life, OR full 100 years with vicissitudes — requires Dasha confirmation
interpretation.summary: When the 8th lord is stronger than the Lagna lord and occupies a Kendra, with malefics in 8th and 12th — life may be short, medium, or even full 100 years with vicissitudes. Dasha confirmation needed.

source.original_text: In the case of an Alpayuryoga, the person meets with his death when Saturn during his transit reaches in his first cycle the particular portion of the zodiac signified by the sum-total of the figures representing the position at nativity of Saturn, Jupiter, the Sun and the Moon. If the native is found to be of medium life, the event will come off in the 2nd cycle. It will happen in the 3rd if the native is pronounced to be a long-lived one. A clever astrologer will predict the event after also satisfying that the Dasa and Bhukti at the time is untoward.

interpretation.detailed: Saturn transit-based death timing: (1) Calculate the sum of the positional figures for natal Saturn + Jupiter + Sun + Moon. The result indicates a specific zodiac sign. (2) For a native classified as Alpayus (short life): death occurs when Saturn first transits that zodiacal sign (1st cycle). (3) For Madhyamayus (medium life): death in Saturn's 2nd transit cycle. (4) For Purnayus (long life): death in 3rd cycle. (5) A skilled astrologer must also confirm that the Dasha and Bhukti at the time of the Saturn transit are adverse/untoward before declaring death.
interpretation.summary: Death timing by Saturn transit: find the sign from sum of natal Saturn+Jupiter+Sun+Moon positions. For short life = death when Saturn first reaches that sign; medium life = 2nd Saturn cycle; long life = 3rd. Confirm with adverse Dasha/Bhukti.

condition.description: Sum natal Saturn+Jupiter+Sun+Moon → zodiac sign. Saturn transit to that sign in 1st/2nd/3rd cycle = death for Alpayus/Madhyamayus/Purnayus. Confirm adverse Dasha/Bhukti.

source.original_text: If the lord of the Lagna be associated with a malefic and be eclipsed by the Sun's rays or be in depression or an inimical sign, the demise of the native will have to be predicted, when the same lord in his transit happens to occupy one of the Dusstthanas (6th, 8th or 12th) or the Lagna or be somehow connected with it. The same event may also be predicted from the Navamsa Lagna, the decanate Lagna or the Lagna Rasi occupied by the Moon.

interpretation.detailed: When the Lagna lord simultaneously: is associated with a malefic planet AND is combust (eclipsed by Sun) AND is in depression or inimical sign — death of the native is predicted when that same Lagna lord (in transit) occupies a Dusstthana (6th, 8th, or 12th) OR the Lagna itself OR somehow connects with the Lagna. The same death prediction may also be derived from: the Navamsa Lagna, the decanate Lagna, or the Lagna Rasi occupied by the Moon. Death predicted when Lagna lord (in transit) reaches Dusstthana or Lagna
interpretation.summary: When the Lagna lord is combust AND associated with a malefic AND in depression or inimical sign — death predicted when that lord's transit reaches a Dusstthana (6/8/12) or the Lagna. Also predicted from Navamsa/decanate Lagna or Moon's sign Lagna.

source.original_text: If the following three planets, viz., the Moon, the lord of the sign occupied by the same and the lord of the Lagna be all well-placed by being associated with or aspected by good planets and possess many points of strength, that time must be declared as very auspicious and favourable to the native concerned.

interpretation.detailed: When the following three planets are all simultaneously well-placed: (1) The Moon, (2) The lord of the sign occupied by the Moon, and (3) The lord of the Lagna — all being associated with or aspected by benefic/good planets AND possessing many points of strength (Shadbala) — the time must be declared very auspicious and favourable to the native. This is a positive longevity counterbalance to the adverse configurations in Rules 005-019. Very auspicious and favourable time for the native
interpretation.summary: When the Moon, the lord of the Moon's sign, and the Lagna lord are all associated with or aspected by good planets and are strong — the time is very auspicious and favourable for the native.

source.original_text: The lord of the rising sign being possessed of great strength and unaspected by malefic planets but aspected by benefic ones and occupying a Kendra position, wards off death and secures to the child long life graced with numerous virtues and an illustrious or powerful sovereignty.

interpretation.detailed: When the lord of the rising sign (Lagna lord) possesses great strength AND is unaspected by malefic planets AND is aspected by benefic planets AND occupies a Kendra (1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th) position — this configuration wards off death and secures to the native long life graced with numerous virtues and an illustrious or powerful sovereignty (leadership/authority). Wards off death; long life with virtues and illustrious sovereignty
interpretation.summary: A strong Lagna lord unaspected by malefics, aspected by benefics, and in a Kendra position wards off death and grants long life with virtues and illustrious sovereignty.

source.original_text: Jupiter, the minister of the Gods, endowed with all surpassing strength and glittering with his full collection of rays, if posited in the Lagna, he can singly ward off many of the evils which would otherwise be difficult to be got over.

interpretation.detailed: Jupiter, the minister of the Gods, when endowed with all surpassing strength (maximum Shadbala, own sign, or exaltation, not combust, brilliant with full rays) and posited in the Lagna — can singlehandedly ward off many evils which would otherwise be very difficult to overcome. This is one of the most powerful single-planet protective configurations in the entire chapter. Singlehandedly wards off many evils difficult to overcome
interpretation.summary: A very strong Jupiter placed in the Lagna can singlehandedly ward off many evils that would otherwise be difficult to overcome — a powerful longevity protector.

source.original_text: The waxing Moon if posited in a Trikona, the 11th house or a Kendra position with respect to the Lagna and at the same time in a sign or Navamsa belonging to the Sun, Moon or Jupiter, will conduce to the performance of meritorious deeds every day and ward off completely all ills.

interpretation.detailed: The waxing Moon (Shukla Paksha Moon, increasing in brightness) when positioned in: a Trikona (1st, 5th, or 9th house) OR the 11th house OR a Kendra (1st, 4th, 7th, 10th) from the Lagna — AND simultaneously in a sign or Navamsa belonging to the Sun, Moon, or Jupiter — will conduce to the performance of meritorious deeds every day AND ward off completely all ills. Meritorious deeds every day; completely wards off all ills
interpretation.summary: A waxing Moon in Trikona, 11th, or Kendra AND in a Sun/Moon/Jupiter sign or Navamsa conduces to meritorious deeds and completely wards off all ills.

components.condition: in Sun or Moon or Jupiter sign/Navamsa

source.original_text: If, in a nativity, there be no malefics in the 1st, 4th, 5th, 7th, 8th, 9th and 10th houses, and if the lord of the Lagna and Jupiter occupy Kendra positions, the person concerned will perform many good acts, enjoy all kinds of comforts, and live for a hundred years free from disease.

interpretation.detailed: When a nativity has: no malefic planets in the 1st, 4th, 5th, 7th, 8th, 9th, and 10th houses AND the lord of the Lagna occupies a Kendra AND Jupiter occupies a Kendra — the person will perform many good acts, enjoy all kinds of comforts, and live for a hundred years completely free from disease. This is the maximum longevity configuration in Phaladeepika's longevity chapter. Lives 100 years free from disease; performs good acts; enjoys all comforts
interpretation.summary: When no malefics are in the 1st, 4th, 5th, 7th, 8th, 9th, and 10th houses AND the Lagna lord and Jupiter are in Kendra — the native lives 100 years free from disease with many comforts.

source.original_text: Through the Dasas enunciated by Sripati, through Ashtakavarga, through Kalachakra Dasa and through the Ududasa system, a wise man ought to predict the Ayus of the native by the application of suitable rules after a correct calculation of the several planetary positions, careful working, and a minute scrutiny.

interpretation.detailed: For predicting the Ayus (longevity/lifespan) of a native, a wise astrologer should employ four classical systems: (1) Sripati Dasas — the Dasha system expounded by Sripati. (2) Ashtakavarga — the eight-source strength measurement system. (3) Kalachakra Dasa — the zodiac-based cycle Dasha system. (4) Udu Dasa — the Nakshatra/asterism-based Dasha system (related to Vimshottari). The prediction should be made by applying the suitable rules of each system after: correct calculation of planetary positions, careful working, and minute scrutiny. Longevity predicted by applying all four Dasha systems with careful calculation
interpretation.summary: Four classical Dasha systems are prescribed for predicting longevity: Sripati Dasas, Ashtakavarga, Kalachakra Dasa, and the Udu (Vimshottari/Nakshatra-based) Dasa system. All four should be applied with careful planetary calculations.

condition.description: Use all four Dasha systems: Sripati, Ashtakavarga, Kalachakra, Udu for Ayus calculation.

interpretation.detailed:

interpretation.detailed:

interpretation.detailed:

interpretation.detailed:
Method for determining the cause of death — apply in priority order: (1) Planets occupying or aspecting the 8th house → death by diseases of the strongest such planet; (2) No planets in/aspecting 8th → diseases of the nature of the 8th house sign, or the house where 8th lord is placed; (3) Foregoing tests inapplicable → death caused by lord of 8th house or lord of 22nd decanate from Lagna decanate

interpretation.summary: Death cause determination: priority hierarchy

engine_notes: The 22nd decanate from Lagna = count from Lagna decanate onwards to the 22nd decanate (each sign has 3 decanates, so 22nd = 7th sign's 1st decanate, approximately). Engine needs decanate calculator. This is the primary death-cause determination framework.

interpretation.detailed:

If at a person's birth the 12th house or its lord is in a house or Navamsa owned by a benefic, or is associated with a benefic, death will be a happy one — free from anguish or suffering. If otherwise, death will be painful

source.original_text: All Bhavas produce completely their good results if occupied or aspected by benefics, or their own lords, or planets owning benefic Bhavas and free from association or aspect of malefics. The same good effect is produced by malefics also if they are owners of those Bhavas and are not in depression, not eclipsed and not in inimical signs.

interpretation.detailed: All Bhavas produce completely their good results if occupied or aspected by benefics, or their own lords, or planets owning benefic Bhavas, and free from association or aspect of malefics. The same good effect is produced by malefics also if they are owners of those Bhavas and are not in depression, not eclipsed (combust), and not in inimical signs. The Bhava produces its complete good effects
interpretation.summary: A Bhava produces its full good effects when occupied or aspected by benefics, its own lord, or lords of benefic Bhavas, and is free from malefic influence. Malefic owners of a Bhava also produce good results provided they are not afflicted.

condition.description: Bhava occupied or aspected by: (a) natural benefics, (b) own Bhava lord, or (c) lords of benefic Bhavas; AND free from malefic conjunction or aspect. Secondary: malefic Bhava owners produce same good effect when not in depression, not combust, not in inimical sign.

source.original_text: A Bhava will be strong (and yield auspicious results) when its Trikona, 2nd, 4th, 7th, and 10th are occupied by auspicious planets or the Bhava lord, and the Bhava itself is unoccupied and unaspected by malefics. A Bhava will be in decayed condition if opposite. A mixed condition when both benefics and malefics are present.

interpretation.detailed: A Bhava will be strong and yield auspicious results when the Trikona, 2nd, 4th, 7th, and 10th houses reckoned from it are occupied by auspicious planets or the Bhava lord, and the Bhava itself is unoccupied and unaspected by malefics. A Bhava will be in a decayed condition when those positions are occupied by malefics and the Bhava is bereft of benefic connection. A Bhava shows mixed effects when both benefics and malefics occupy or aspect those positions.
interpretation.summary: A Bhava is strong when its Trikona, 2nd, 4th, 7th, 10th positions (from the Bhava) are auspiciously occupied and it is free from malefics. Opposite conditions produce decay. Mixed occupancy produces mixed effects.

condition.description: Assess Trikona (1st, 5th, 9th from Bhava), 2nd, 4th, 7th, 10th positions reckoned from the target Bhava. Strong = benefics/Bhava lord in those positions + Bhava itself free from malefics. Decayed = malefics in those positions, no benefic support. Mixed = both types present.

source.original_text: Total destruction of a Bhava is to be predicted when its lord occupies the 8th from the Bhava, or is combust, or in depression, or in inimical sign, with no benefic aspecting or associated with it. Even a benefic similarly placed without benefic support is incapable of good.

interpretation.detailed: Total destruction of a Bhava is to be predicted when its lord occupies the 8th house from that Bhava, OR is combust (obscured by solar rays), OR is in depression, OR is in an inimical sign — AND no benefic planet aspects or is associated with the lord. Even a benefic planet placed in the Bhava under such conditions (combust/depression/inimical, without benefic support) renders the Bhava incapable of producing good. Total destruction of the Bhava — its significations fail to manifest
interpretation.summary: When a Bhava's lord is in the 8th from that Bhava, or combust, or in depression, or in an inimical sign — and no benefic aspects or associates with it — total destruction of the Bhava is predicted.

components.condition: one_of: in_8th_from_bhava OR combust OR in_depression OR in_inimical_sign

source.original_text: If a malefic occupies the Bhava and is combust or in depression or in inimical sign without benefic support, there will be total destruction.

interpretation.detailed: If a malefic planet occupies the Bhava AND is combust, or in depression, or in an inimical sign, AND there is no benefic aspecting or associated with it, then total destruction of the Bhava is predicted. The occupant-based destruction condition operates independently from the lord-based destruction condition (Rule pd-ch15-003). Total destruction of the Bhava — its significations fail to manifest
interpretation.summary: A malefic planet occupying a Bhava while combust, in depression, or in an inimical sign — and with no benefic aspect or association — causes total destruction of that Bhava.

components.condition: one_of: combust OR in_depression OR in_inimical_sign

source.original_text: Malefics in the 6th, 8th, or 12th from a Bhava cause destruction of that Bhava. Benefics in those positions are not capable of producing good effects for the Bhava.

interpretation.detailed: Malefics in the 6th, 8th, or 12th house reckoned from any Bhava cause destruction of that Bhava. Benefics in those same positional houses are NOT capable of producing good effects for the Bhava. This rule applies to ALL Bhavas and is one of the primary Bhava destruction indicators. Destruction of the Bhava when malefics occupy 6th, 8th, or 12th from it
interpretation.summary: Malefic planets in the 6th, 8th, or 12th house reckoned from any Bhava cause destruction of that Bhava. Benefics in those same positions do not compensate — they are incapable of producing good for the Bhava.

condition.description: Evaluate 6th, 8th, 12th positions reckoned from the target Bhava (not from Lagna). Malefic occupants in any of those positions = Bhava destruction indicator. Benefic occupants in those positions = neutral (no benefit to Bhava).

source.original_text: A Bhava suffers annihilation when its lord occupies the 6th, 8th, or 12th, or when the lord of those houses occupies the Bhava.

interpretation.detailed: A Bhava suffers annihilation in two configurations: (1) the Bhava lord occupies the 6th, 8th, or 12th house (Dusstthana); OR (2) the lord of any of the Dusstthanas (6th lord, 8th lord, or 12th lord) occupies the Bhava itself. Rule pd-ch15-007 provides the benefic-aspect override for this configuration. Bhava suffers annihilation — its positive significations are suppressed
interpretation.summary: A Bhava suffers annihilation when its lord is in a Dusstthana (6th, 8th, or 12th), or when the lord of a Dusstthana occupies the Bhava itself.

condition_options.description: Bhava lord placed in 6th, 8th, or 12th house from Lagna
Lord of 6th, 8th, or 12th house placed in the target Bhava

source.original_text: But if the Bhava is aspected by a benefic (in the above configuration), the Bhava will be in a flourishing condition.

interpretation.detailed: When a Bhava is subject to annihilation conditions (lord in Dusstthana, or Dusstthana lord in Bhava — per pd-ch15-006), if a benefic planet aspects the Bhava, the annihilation is overridden and the Bhava enters a flourishing condition. interpretation.summary: When the Dusstthana annihilation configuration (Rule pd-ch15-006) is present BUT a benefic planet aspects the Bhava, the annihilation is cancelled and the Bhava flourishes instead.

components.description: pd-ch15-006 configuration present (lord in Dusstthana OR Dusstthana lord in Bhava)
A natural or temporal benefic aspects the Bhava

source.original_text: A Bhava suffers annihilation when the Bhava, its lord, and its Karaka are devoid of strength; and it is hemmed in between malefics, or associated with or aspected by malefic or inimical planets and not by benefics, or if the 4th, 8th, and 12th or the 5th and 9th from them are occupied by malefics. This is more certain when two or three of these conditions synchronize.

interpretation.detailed: A Bhava suffers certain annihilation when: (a) The Bhava itself, its lord, and its Karaka are ALL devoid of strength; AND (b) The Bhava is hemmed in between malefics (paapakartari), OR associated with or aspected by malefic/inimical planets without benefic counterweight, OR the 4th/8th/12th or 5th/9th positions from the Bhava are occupied by malefics. The prediction becomes more certain when two or three of conditions (a) and (b) synchronize simultaneously. Certain annihilation of the Bhava — all significations fail
interpretation.summary: When the Bhava, its lord, AND its Karaka are all devoid of strength, combined with malefic hemming, malefic association/aspect, or malefics in 4/8/12 or 5/9 positions — Bhava annihilation is certain. More certain when multiple conditions coincide.

components.condition: one_or_more_of: paapakartari OR malefic_aspect_association OR malefics_in_4_8_12_or_5_9_from_bhava

source.original_text: The lord of the 8th from the Bhava, the lord of the 22nd Drekkana, and the planets in the 6th, 8th, and 7th from the Bhava (if weak) cause destruction during their Dasha periods. Malefics in 3, 6, 11 from Bhava (if strong), benefics in Kendra and Trikona from Bhava (if strong), and planets friendly to the Bhava lord (if strong) cause success.

interpretation.detailed: Planets that cause destruction to a Bhava during their Dasha/Bhukti periods (when they are weak): (1) Lord of the 8th house reckoned from that Bhava; (2) Lord of the 22nd Drekkana from that Bhava; (3) Planets occupying the 6th, 8th, or 7th from the Bhava. These are the Bhava-specific Dasha destroyers. See pd-ch15-010 for Bhava-promoter Dasha planets. Destruction of the Bhava's significations manifests during the Dasha/Bhukti of the identified destroyer planets
interpretation.summary: During their Dasha periods, these planets cause destruction to a Bhava: the lord of the 8th from that Bhava, the lord of the 22nd Drekkana, and weak planets in the 6th, 8th, or 7th from the Bhava.

condition.description: Identify: (1) lord of 8th from target Bhava, (2) lord of 22nd Drekkana from Bhava, (3) planets in 6th, 8th, 7th from Bhava that are also weak. During these planets' Dasha/Bhukti periods, predict Bhava destruction.

source.original_text: Malefics in 3rd, 6th, 11th from the Bhava (if strong), benefics in Kendra and Trikona from the Bhava (if strong), and planets friendly to the Bhava lord (if strong) cause success to the Bhava during their Dasha periods.

interpretation.detailed: Planets that bring success and good results to a Bhava during their Dasha/Bhukti periods (when they are strong): (1) Malefic planets occupying the 3rd, 6th, or 11th house from the Bhava — when strong; (2) Benefic planets in Kendra (1st, 4th, 7th, 10th) or Trikona (1st, 5th, 9th) positions from the Bhava — when strong; (3) Planets that are friends of the Bhava lord — when strong. The strength condition is mandatory for all three categories. The Bhava's significations flourish and produce good results during these planets' Dasha/Bhukti periods
interpretation.summary: Strong malefics in 3rd, 6th, or 11th from a Bhava, strong benefics in Kendra or Kona from it, and strong planets friendly to its lord all promote the Bhava's success during their Dasha periods.

condition.description: Identify: (1) strong malefics in 3rd/6th/11th from Bhava, (2) strong benefics in Kendra/Kona from Bhava, (3) strong planets friendly to Bhava lord. During their Dasha/Bhukti periods, predict Bhava success.

source.original_text: The lord of the 3rd from Lagna and the Moon, the planet occupying and aspecting the 8th, Saturn, the lord of the 22nd decanate, the planet owning the sign occupied by Mandi, planets owning the Rasis and Amsas occupied by the above, and Rahu when weak — all cause destruction to the Bhava during their Dasha periods.

interpretation.detailed: Additional planets that cause destruction to a Bhava during their Dasha periods: (1) Lord of the 3rd house from the Lagna AND the Moon; (2) The planet occupying AND aspecting the 8th house; (3) Saturn; (4) Lord of the 22nd Drekkana from the Bhava; (5) Planet owning the sign occupied by Mandi (Gulika); (6) Planets owning the Rasis and Amsas (Navamsa signs) occupied by all the above-listed destroyers; (7) Rahu when weak — occupying 6th, 8th, or 12th, or conjunct/aspected by malefics. Note: the 3rd lord here is from the Lagna (not from the Bhava), making it a Lagna-relative indicator. The engine must distinguish between Bhava-relative and Lagna-relative position references. Destruction to the Bhava's significations during the Dasha/Bhukti of the identified destroyer planets
interpretation.summary: Extended list of Dasha-period Bhava destroyers: 3rd lord from Lagna, Moon, 8th house occupant and aspector, Saturn, 22nd Drekkana lord, Mandi's sign lord, Rasi and Navamsa lords of the above, and weak Rahu.

condition.description: During Dasha/Bhukti of: 3rd lord from Lagna, Moon, 8th house occupant-and-aspector, Saturn, 22nd Drekkana lord, Mandi sign lord, Rasi/Navamsa lords of the above, or weak Rahu — predict Bhava destruction. Engine note: 3rd lord reference is from Lagna, not from the target Bhava.

source.original_text: Wherever the Lagna lord occupies, that Bhava prospers and is assured of good results. Note the houses owned by planets associated with or aspecting the Lagna lord — these are the effects the Lagna lord promotes.

interpretation.detailed: Wherever the Lagna lord occupies, that Bhava prospers and its good effects are assured. Additionally, the houses owned by planets that are associated with or aspecting the Lagna lord — those houses' effects are also promoted by the Lagna lord. The Lagna lord's influence radiates to all houses whose lords it connects with. The Bhava occupied by the Lagna lord prospers — its significations flourish
interpretation.summary: The Bhava occupied by the Lagna lord prospers and produces good results. Additionally, houses whose lords are associated with or aspect the Lagna lord also receive the Lagna lord's promotional benefit.

condition.description: Lagna lord occupies a specific Bhava OR a planet whose lord is associated with/aspects the Lagna lord

source.original_text: If the Bhava lord occupies a Dusstthana (6th, 8th, 12th), the effects are reversed. If weak, immensely harmful. If strong, only slight injury.

interpretation.detailed: If the lord of a Bhava occupies a Dusstthana (6th, 8th, or 12th house): the effects of that Bhava are reversed (adverse rather than beneficial). The degree of harm depends on the lord's strength in the Dusstthana: if the lord is WEAK — immensely harmful to the Bhava; if the lord is STRONG — only slight injury results (partial mitigation). Strength modulates the degree, not the direction, of the adverse effect.
interpretation.summary: When a Bhava's lord is in a Dusstthana (6th, 8th, or 12th), the Bhava's effects are reversed. If the lord is weak there, the harm is immense. If the lord is strong, the injury is only slight.

condition.description: Bhava lord placed in 6th, 8th, or 12th house from Lagna

source.original_text: The lord of the Lagna, though malefic, only promotes the growth of the Bhava it occupies. If it also owns a Dusstthana, the effect of its Lagna ownership predominates over the Dusstthana ownership. Example: Mars owning Lagna in Simha, occupying the 5th — if aspected by a benefic, the native begets sons very soon.

interpretation.detailed: The lord of the Lagna, even though it is a natural malefic, only promotes the growth of the Bhava it occupies. If the Lagna lord also owns a Dusstthana (6th, 8th, or 12th house), the effect of its Lagna lordship predominates over its Dusstthana ownership — the adverse Dusstthana tendency is suppressed. Example in text: Mars owning the Lagna in a chart where it is also associated with the 5th house — if aspected by a benefic, the native begets sons soon. The key principle: Lagna lordship is the strongest lordship and overrides adversarial secondary ownership. The Bhava occupied by the malefic Lagna lord prospers
interpretation.summary: Even a malefic Lagna lord promotes the Bhava it occupies. When the Lagna lord also owns a Dusstthana, the Lagna lordship takes precedence — the Dusstthana ownership's adverse influence is subordinated.

condition.description: Planet is Lagna lord AND is a natural malefic AND also owns a Dusstthana. Evaluate: Lagna lordship function predominates. The Bhava the Lagna lord occupies prospers. Dusstthana ownership effect is suppressed.

source.original_text: When a planet owns two houses: the Moolatrikona house effects predominate and are felt in full; the other (own sign) house effects are at half strength. First half of the planet's Dasha: effects of the first house in order. Second half: effects of the second house. Alternate: odd house first, even house second.

interpretation.detailed: When a planet owns two houses: (1) The Moolatrikona house (preferred own sign) effects predominate and are felt at full strength; (2) The other Bhava (regular own sign) effects are at half strength. Regarding Dasha timing: the first half of the planet's Dasha period is dominated by the Bhava that comes first in house-number order; the second half by the other Bhava. Alternate opinion: if the planet is in an odd-numbered house, effects of that house's Bhava are felt first; if in an even-numbered house, the other Bhava's effects come first.
interpretation.summary: When a planet owns two Bhavas, the Moolatrikona Bhava's effects are full and the other own-sign Bhava's effects are at half strength. The Dasha period is split: effects of the first-ordered Bhava in the first half, the second in the second half.

condition.description: Planet owns two houses. Identify which is Moolatrikona and which is regular own sign. Apply full strength to Moolatrikona Bhava, half strength to other. Split Dasha timing by house order.

source.original_text: Declare destruction of Bhavas during the Dasha periods of planets very inimical to the lord of the particular Bhava, or of planets occupying houses where there are no benefic dots in their Ashtakavargas.

interpretation.detailed: Declare destruction of any Bhava during the Dasha period of: (1) Planets that are very inimical (bitter enemies) to the lord of that particular Bhava; OR (2) Planets that occupy houses where there are NO benefic dots (zero bindus) in those planets' individual Ashtakavargas. Engine dependency: requires Ashtakavarga calculation to identify zero-bindu house placements for each planet. Destruction of the Bhava's significations during the identified Dasha/Bhukti periods
interpretation.summary: Predict Bhava destruction during the Dasha period of planets that are very inimical to the Bhava's lord, or planets positioned in houses where they have no benefic dots (zero bindus) in their individual Ashtakavarga.

condition.description: For each Bhava, identify: (1) planets in bitter enmity with the Bhava lord, (2) planets with zero Ashtakavarga bindus in their current natal house. During those planets' Dasha/Bhukti, predict Bhava destruction.

source.original_text: Even if a planet is in exaltation, friendly sign, or endowed with 6 kinds of strength — if it is in Bhavasandhi (house junction), it becomes ineffective. This must be noted before predicting Dasha and Bhukti effects.

interpretation.detailed: Even if a planet is in exaltation, in a friendly sign, or endowed with the 6 kinds of strength (Shadbalas — positional, directional, temporal, motion-based, natural, and aspectual) — if it is positioned in Bhavasandhi (the junction/boundary between two Bhavas), it becomes completely ineffective and does NOT produce its predicted results. This Bhavasandhi check must be determined BEFORE predicting any Dasha or Bhukti effects attributable to that planet's house position. Implementation priority: highest — this is a pre-prediction override rule. Planet is ineffective — all predictions attributable to its Bhava position are suppressed
interpretation.summary: Any planet positioned at the Bhavasandhi (junction between two Bhavas) becomes ineffective, regardless of its exaltation, friendly sign placement, or Shadbala strength. This must be checked BEFORE any prediction.

condition.description: Check if planet's degree position falls within the Bhavasandhi zone (junction between two Bhavas). If yes: suppress ALL predictions based on that planet's Bhava occupancy regardless of its dignity or Shadbala score.
condition.priority: HIGHEST — evaluate before any house-based prediction

source.original_text: Planets in the exact degrees of any Bhava produce the full effect of that Bhava. When a planet is in Bhavasandhi it produces no effect at all. For intermediate positions the effect is determined by rule of three (proportional interpolation).

interpretation.detailed: The quantitative Bhava effectiveness algorithm: (1) Planet at the exact midpoint (madhya) of a Bhava → produces 100% of the Bhava's effect; (2) Planet at the Bhavasandhi (junction between two Bhavas) → produces 0% effect; (3) Planet at an intermediate position → effectiveness is determined by proportional calculation (rule of three / linear interpolation). This rule provides the engine's Bhava effectiveness scalar (0.0 to 1.0) for any planet. Inputs: planet's degree position, Bhava cusp positions, Bhava midpoint degree. Output: effectiveness scalar applied to all predictions from that Bhava placement.
interpretation.summary: Planets at the exact Bhava midpoint produce full effects. Planets at the Bhavasandhi produce no effect. Intermediate positions are calculated proportionally (rule of three) between full and zero effectiveness.

condition.description: Input: (a) planet's longitudinal degree, (b) Bhava cusp and midpoint degrees (Sripati/Placidus per engine config). Output: effectiveness_scalar = (distance_from_sandhi) / (distance_from_sandhi + distance_to_cusp). Apply scalar to all predictions from that planet's Bhava occupancy.

source.original_text: Sun: self, father, influence, health, vigour, fortune. Moon: heart/mind, royal favour, mother, affluence. Mars: courage, disease, characteristic qualities, younger brothers, lands, foes, blood relations. Mercury: learning, relatives in general, discrimination, maternal uncle, friends, speech, action.

interpretation.detailed: Karakas (significators) for life domains — part 1 of 2 (see pd-ch15-020 for remaining planets): Sun: self/body, father, influence/authority, health, vigour, fortune/luck. Moon: heart/mind/understanding, royal favour/patronage, mother, affluence/prosperity. Mars: courage/valor, disease/physical wounds, characteristic qualities, younger brothers/siblings, lands/property, foes/enemies, blood relations/paternal kin. Mercury: learning/education, relatives in general, discrimination/discernment/intelligence, maternal uncle, friends, speech/communication, actions/daily activities. Note: OCR on page 7 shows 'Sloka 25' — resolved by sequential count as Sloka 15.
interpretation.summary: Karakatwa (significatorship) assignments for Sun, Moon, Mars, and Mercury — the complete list of life domains each planet signifies.

condition.description: Reference table: planet → list of life domains it signifies. Used by the engine to identify which life areas are activated when a planet is prominent in a chart.

source.original_text: Jupiter: genius, wealth, sons, knowledge. Venus: wife, vehicles, ornaments, love, pleasures. Saturn: period of life, livelihood, cause of death, adversity, servants. Rahu: paternal grandfather. Ketu: maternal grandfather.

interpretation.detailed: Karakas (significators) for life domains — part 2 of 2 (see pd-ch15-019 for Sun/Moon/Mars/Mercury): Jupiter: genius/intellect, wealth/prosperity, physical development/growth, sons/children, knowledge/wisdom. Venus: wife/spouse, vehicles/conveyances, ornaments/jewels, love affairs/romance, pleasures/comforts. Saturn: period of life/longevity, livelihood/earnings, cause of death (maraka function), adversity/suffering/hardships, servants/subordinates. Rahu: paternal grandfather. Ketu: maternal grandfather. Together with pd-ch15-019, this forms the complete Karakatwa lookup table for all 9 grahas.
interpretation.summary: Karakatwa (significatorship) assignments for Jupiter, Venus, Saturn, Rahu, and Ketu — completing the 9-graha Karakatwa reference table.

condition.description: Reference table: planet → list of life domains it signifies. Continuation of pd-ch15-019.

source.original_text: Karakas of the 12 Bhavas: 1st=Sun; 2nd=Jupiter; 3rd=Mars; 4th=Moon and Mercury; 5th=Jupiter; 6th=Saturn and Mars; 7th=Venus; 8th=Saturn; 9th=Sun and Jupiter; 10th=Jupiter, Sun, Mercury, Saturn; 11th=Jupiter; 12th=Saturn.

interpretation.detailed: The Karaka (significator) planet(s) for each of the 12 Bhavas: 1st Bhava (Lagna) = Sun; 2nd Bhava = Jupiter; 3rd Bhava = Mars; 4th Bhava = Moon and Mercury; 5th Bhava = Jupiter; 6th Bhava = Saturn and Mars; 7th Bhava = Venus; 8th Bhava = Saturn; 9th Bhava = Sun and Jupiter; 10th Bhava = Jupiter, Sun, Mercury, Saturn; 11th Bhava = Jupiter; 12th Bhava = Saturn. Engine note: multi-Karaka Bhavas (4th, 6th, 9th, 10th) require the engine to assess all listed Karakas and combine their strengths when evaluating that Bhava. The 10th Bhava has the maximum coverage (4 Karakas) — critical for career/status predictions.
interpretation.summary: The 12 Bhavas and their assigned Karaka planets. The 10th Bhava has the highest Karaka count (4 planets). Some Bhavas share Karakas with others.

condition.description: Reference table: bhava_number → list of Karaka planets. Used for Bhava triple-strength confirmation (pd-ch15-028) and Karako Bhava Nasaya (pd-ch15-029).

source.original_text: The fullness or otherwise of the effects of planets in any house must be judged by the exact nature of the sign occupied — whether friendly, inimical, neutral, own, or exaltation.

interpretation.detailed: The fullness or otherwise of the effects produced by planets in any house must be judged by the exact nature of the sign occupied by the planet — whether that sign is friendly (mitra), inimical (shatru), neutral (sama), own (swakshetra), or exaltation (uchcha). The sign relationship establishes a quality scalar on top of the positional placement. This applies universally to all Bhava predictions. Note: OCR misread this sloka's number; resolved as Sloka 18 by sequential count.
interpretation.summary: The degree of a planet's effectiveness in any Bhava is determined by the nature of the sign occupied: exaltation > own sign > friendly sign > neutral sign > inimical sign.

condition.description: For any planet in a Bhava: determine sign relationship (exaltation > own > friendly > neutral > inimical). Apply as effectiveness modifier to Bhava predictions.

source.original_text: Satyacharya's opinion: benefics generally promote the advancement of any Bhava; malefics cause decay. This rule is reversed for the 6th, 8th, and 12th houses.

interpretation.detailed: Satyacharya's general principle: benefic planets generally promote the advancement of any Bhava they occupy; malefic planets cause the decay of any Bhava they occupy. EXCEPTION: for the 6th, 8th, and 12th Bhavas (the Dusstthanas/adversarial houses), this general rule is reversed. The reversal is clarified in Sloka 19 (pd-ch15-024): malefics in Dusstthanas strengthen those adversarial Bhavas (bad for native); benefics in Dusstthanas destroy those adversarial Bhavas (good for native, as the evil Bhava's power is weakened).
interpretation.summary: Satyacharya's general principle: benefic planets promote any Bhava they occupy; malefic planets cause its decay. EXCEPTION: for the 6th, 8th, and 12th Bhavas (Dusstthanas), this rule operates in reverse.

condition.description: General: benefic in Bhava = promotion, malefic in Bhava = decay. Exception: for Bhavas 6, 8, 12 — reverse the rule. See pd-ch15-024 for the specific reversal mechanism.

source.original_text: Malefics in 6th, 8th, 12th promote the evil effects of those Bhavas. Benefics in the same houses cause destruction of those Bhavas. Therefore, declare destruction of the evil effects of these three houses when benefics occupy them.

interpretation.detailed: Malefics occupying the 6th, 8th, or 12th house (Dusstthanas) promote the evil effects of those Bhavas — increasing the native's enemies, disease, loss, and suffering. Benefics occupying those same three houses cause destruction of those Bhavas' adversarial power — reducing the native's enemies, disease, and losses. Therefore: when benefics occupy the 6th, 8th, or 12th, declare destruction of the evil effects typically associated with those houses. The translator notes: 'The general principle is: benefics in good houses promote their good effects and in inauspicious houses spoil their evil effects, while malefics in good houses spoil them and in bad houses create untold sufferings.'
interpretation.summary: In the 6th, 8th, and 12th Bhavas: malefics enhance the adversarial power of those Bhavas (bad for native); benefics destroy the evil power of those Bhavas (good for native). Predict reduction of enemy/illness/loss when benefics occupy Dusstthanas.

condition.description: For Bhavas 6, 8, 12: malefic occupant = Bhava's adversarial significations strengthened (more enemies/disease/loss); benefic occupant = Bhava's adversarial significations weakened (fewer enemies/disease/loss). Invert the standard benefic-promotes/malefic-decays rule.

source.original_text: Whenever the effects of any Bhava are to be determined, consider that Bhava as the Lagna and examine the 12 houses reckoned from it.

interpretation.detailed: Whenever the effects of any Bhava are to be determined in detail: treat that Bhava as if it were the Lagna (Ascendant), and examine all 12 houses reckoned from that Bhava using the same interpretive framework as for the Lagna. The 1st from the Bhava = form/appearance; 2nd = wealth/prosperity; 3rd = siblings; 4th = mother/happiness; and so on through all 12 positions. This provides a complete analytical framework for any Bhava's internal structure. Combined with pd-ch15-026 (Karaka-as-Lagna), this gives two complementary axes for Bhava analysis. Complete 12-house sub-analysis of any Bhava using the Bhava itself as reference Lagna
interpretation.summary: To determine the full effects of any Bhava, treat that Bhava as the Lagna and apply the 12-house analysis system from that starting point.

condition.description: Engine function: bhava_as_lagna(target_bhava, chart). Re-index all 12 house positions relative to target_bhava as position 1. Apply standard 12-house interpretive framework from that origin.

source.original_text: In the same way, the effects of father, mother, brother, maternal uncle, son, husband, and servant should be determined by treating the signs occupied by their respective Karakas as the Lagna.

interpretation.detailed: The same Bhava-as-Lagna methodology (pd-ch15-025) applies to determining effects for family members. For each family member, treat the sign occupied by their ruling Karaka planet as the Lagna: Father = Sun's natal sign as Lagna; Mother = Moon's natal sign; Brothers = Mars's natal sign; Maternal uncle = Mercury's natal sign; Sons = Jupiter's natal sign; Wife/husband = Venus's natal sign; Servants = Saturn's natal sign. Engine implementation: karaka_as_lagna(karaka_planet, chart). Find the sign occupied by the karaka planet, use that as position 1, and apply the 12-house framework.
interpretation.summary: To determine effects for any family member, treat the sign occupied by their Karaka planet as the Lagna and examine 12 houses from it.

condition.description: Engine function: karaka_as_lagna(karaka_planet, chart). Identify sign occupied by karaka. Use that sign as reference Lagna. Apply 12-house framework for family member prediction.

source.original_text: From Sun's position: father's appearance (1st), prosperity and renown (2nd), brothers/character (3rd), father's mother/happiness (4th), intelligence/tranquility (5th), sufferings/enemies/disease (6th), love/passion (7th), misery/death/longevity (8th), religious merit/father's father (9th), occupation (10th), gains/income (11th), expenditure/loss (12th).

interpretation.detailed: Working example of the Karaka-as-Lagna methodology (pd-ch15-026) applied to the father (Sun as Karaka). Treat the sign occupied by the Sun as the Lagna and examine all 12 houses from it for the father's life: 1st from Sun = father's appearance, physique, general self; 2nd from Sun = father's prosperity, renown, and wealth; 3rd from Sun = father's siblings/brothers, character and valor; 4th from Sun = father's mother (native's paternal grandmother), father's home and happiness; 5th from Sun = father's intelligence, tranquility, and spiritual development; 6th from Sun = father's sufferings, injuries, enemies, diseases; 7th from Sun = father's love affairs, passions, and spouse; 8th from Sun = father's misery, death and longevity; 9th from Sun = father's religious merit, auspicious works, and his own father (native's paternal grandfather); 10th from Sun = father's occupation, career, status; 11th from Sun = father's gains and income; 12th from Sun = father's expenditure and losses. The same methodology applies from Moon (mother), Mars (brothers), Mercury (maternal uncle), Jupiter (sons), Venus (father's wife), Saturn (servants). Source spans Slokas 22, 23, 24 — encoded as single rule.
interpretation.summary: Using Sun's natal sign as Lagna, the 12 houses from the Sun map to 12 specific domains of the father's life. This is the canonical worked example of the Karaka-as-Lagna methodology.

condition.description: Reference table: position from Sun → father's life domain. Generalizable to all planets and their respective family members.

source.original_text: When the Bhava, its lord, and its Karaka are all strong, predict happiness and good effects for that Bhava with full confidence.

interpretation.detailed: When a Bhava, its lord, AND its Karaka are all strong simultaneously: predict happiness and good results for that Bhava without qualification. This is the gold-standard confirmation condition for any Bhava prediction. All three components must be strong — not just two. The triple strength provides the maximum prediction confidence. Engine: when all three components are assessed as strong, prediction confidence for that Bhava = maximum. This condition supersedes weaker individual indicators. Predict happiness and good effects for the Bhava with full confidence
interpretation.summary: When a Bhava, its lord, AND its Karaka are all strong simultaneously, predict happiness and good effects for that Bhava with full confidence. This is the highest-confidence prediction condition.

source.original_text: Others say: Sun in the 9th, Moon in the 4th, Mars in the 3rd, Jupiter in the 5th, Venus in the 7th, and Saturn in the 8th — each causes distress to the Bhavas concerned.

interpretation.detailed: Classical principle cited as 'Others say' (alternate authority): when a planet occupies the Bhava of which it is the primary Karaka (significator), it causes distress to the significations of that Bhava rather than strengthening them. The six instances: Sun in 9th house → distress to father; Moon in 4th house → distress to mother; Mars in 3rd house → distress to brothers; Jupiter in 5th house → distress to sons/children; Venus in 7th house → distress to wife/spouse; Saturn in 8th house → distress to longevity. This is the classical karako bhava nasaya (Karaka destroys its own Bhava) principle. The 'Others say' attribution indicates it represents a traditional school's view rather than the author's primary position — but it is widely accepted in classical Jyotish and should be implemented. Engine: treat as adversarial modifier co-present with the general Karaka benefit; net effect depends on the Karaka's overall strength. Distress to the significations of the Bhava occupied by its own Karaka planet
interpretation.summary: When a planet occupies the Bhava it rules as Karaka (significator), it causes distress to that Bhava's significations: Sun in 9th (father), Moon in 4th (mother), Mars in 3rd (brothers), Jupiter in 5th (sons), Venus in 7th (spouse), Saturn in 8th (longevity).

source.original_text: Lagna lord produces the effects pertaining to the Bhava with whose lord it is conjoined, or the one it occupies. If that Bhava or its lord is strong, good results follow. If weak, only untoward things.

interpretation.detailed: The Lagna lord produces the effects pertaining to: (a) The Bhava with whose lord it is conjoined, OR (b) The Bhava that it directly occupies. If the relevant Bhava or its lord is STRONG → the native receives good results from that Bhava during the appropriate period. If the relevant Bhava or its lord is WEAK → only untoward (adverse) results follow. The Lagna lord acts as an amplifier: it amplifies whichever Bhava it connects with — good if that Bhava is strong, bad if that Bhava is weak.
interpretation.summary: The Lagna lord produces the effects of the Bhava it occupies OR the Bhava whose lord it is conjoined with. The quality of those effects depends on whether the relevant Bhava and its lord are strong (good) or weak (untoward).

options.description: Lagna lord occupies a Bhava directly
Lagna lord is conjoined with another Bhava lord

source.original_text: Bhavas where the Lagna lord has many benefic dots in its Ashtakavarga will produce happy effects — if the respective owners are strong and associated with the Lagna lord. Bhavas with few dots produce adverse effects — if the Lagna lord is associated with the owners of those Bhavas and they are weak.

interpretation.detailed: Examining the Lagna lord's individual Ashtakavarga contributions to each Bhava: Bhavas where the Lagna lord has MANY benefic dots (bindus) → predict happy effects for those Bhavas — provided the respective Bhava owners are strong AND associated with the Lagna lord. Bhavas where the Lagna lord has FEW benefic dots → predict adverse effects — provided the Lagna lord is associated with the owners of those Bhavas AND those owners are weak. The double condition (bindu count + lord association + lord strength) is required for both positive and negative predictions. Engine dependency: requires the Ashtakavarga calculator to compute the Lagna lord's individual Ashtakavarga.
interpretation.summary: Bhavas receiving many Ashtakavarga bindus from the Lagna lord produce happy effects (when their lords are strong and associated with the Lagna lord). Bhavas with few bindus produce adverse effects (when the Lagna lord is with those weak lords).

condition.description: Compute Lagna lord's individual Ashtakavarga. For each Bhava: check bindu count (many vs few) AND whether Bhava lord is associated with Lagna lord AND Bhava lord's strength.

source.original_text: If the lord of a Dusstthana should occupy another house of his own (Swakshetra), he will produce the effects of only that house as Swakshetra and not the effects of the Dusstthana. Example: if Saturn occupies Makara (5th Bhava) — be the acquisition of sons, and the untoward effects due as owner of the 6th house will not happen.

interpretation.detailed: If the lord of a Dusstthana (6th, 8th, or 12th house) occupies a different house that is also its own sign (Swakshetra) — not the Dusstthana itself — then during its Dasha period, the planet produces the effects of THAT Swakshetra house only. The adverse Dusstthana effects are NOT produced. Example from text: Saturn is lord of the 6th (Dusstthana) in some Lagna configurations. If Saturn occupies Makara (Capricorn — its own sign, identical with the 5th Bhava), then in Saturn's Dasha: the chief effect will be the acquisition of sons (5th Bhava's signification), and the untoward effects due as owner of the 6th house will NOT happen. Source note: Sloka 29 body is on Ch15 PDF; the completion ('be the acquisition of sons... will not happen') is on Ch16 PDF page 1. Dasha produces the significations of the Swakshetra house, not the Dusstthana adverse effects
interpretation.summary: When a Dusstthana lord (6th, 8th, or 12th lord) is placed in its own sign (Swakshetra) in a different house, its Dasha produces the effects of that Swakshetra house rather than the Dusstthana's adverse effects.

condition.description: Planet is lord of a Dusstthana (6th, 8th, or 12th) AND is placed in its own sign (Swakshetra) in a non-Dusstthana house. During that planet's Dasha: apply the effects of the Swakshetra house, suppress the Dusstthana lord effects.

source.original_text: When two planets mutually occupy each other's sign (Parivartana); or both are in the same house; or they aspect each other mutually; or they are in mutual Kendra positions (90 degrees apart); or they are in mutual Trikona positions (120 degrees apart) — these are the five ways in which two planets are said to be connected.

interpretation.detailed: When two planets are described as 'connected' in any classical prediction rule, there are exactly five valid types of connection: (1) Parivartana — each planet occupies the other's own sign (mutual sign exchange); (2) Conjunction — both planets occupy the same house; (3) Mutual aspect — each planet aspects the other's natal position (with standard Jyotish aspect rules); (4) Kendra positions — the two planets are in houses that are mutually 1-4-7-10 from each other (90° angular separation); (5) Trikona positions — the two planets are in houses that are mutually 1-5-9 from each other (120° trine separation). This rule is designated 'XV-30' because it is the 30th Sloka of Adhyaya XV. It is cross-referenced in at least 12 rules in Adhyaya XVI and expected to appear in subsequent chapters. Source note: Physically located on Ch16 PDF page 1 as the tail of Ch15.
interpretation.summary: The five valid types of connection between two planets: (1) Parivartana (sign exchange), (2) conjunction (same house), (3) mutual aspect, (4) mutual Kendra (90° apart), (5) mutual Trikona (120° apart). This is the XV-30 reference used throughout Adhyaya XVI.

condition.description: Engine function: planetary_connection_resolver(planet_A, planet_B, chart) → returns list of active connection types from: ['parivartana', 'conjunction', 'mutual_aspect', 'mutual_kendra', 'mutual_trikona']. Used as a prerequisite resolver for any rule citing 'planets connected per XV-30'.

source.original_text: The native will correspond in mein to the lord of the rising Navamsa, or his appearance will be like that of the planet that has the greatest strength.

interpretation.detailed: The native will correspond in his physical form and bearing (mein) to the lord of the rising Navamsa at birth. Alternatively, his appearance will be like that of the planet that has the greatest strength in the chart. The engine should compute both the Navamsa Lagna lord and the Shadbala-strongest planet, and use the physical descriptions associated with those planets for appearance delineation. Native's physical form = lord of rising Navamsa character. Alternatively = planet with greatest strength in chart.
interpretation.summary: The native's physical form and bearing corresponds to the lord of the Navamsa rising at birth, or to the planet with the greatest Shadbala strength in the chart.

source.original_text: His hue will be like that of the lord of the Navamsa occupied by the Moon.

interpretation.detailed: The native's hue (complexion) will be like that of the lord of the Navamsa occupied by the Moon. To determine this: (1) find the Moon's longitude; (2) calculate which Navamsa (D9) sign the Moon falls in; (3) identify the lord of that sign; (4) apply the color/hue associated with that planet (e.g., Sun = reddish/copper, Moon = white/fair, Mars = reddish/dark, Mercury = green/mixed, Jupiter = yellow/golden, Venus = white/bright, Saturn = dark/blue-black, Rahu = smoke-colored, Ketu = mixed). Native's complexion/hue = planetary color of the lord of the Navamsa sign occupied by the Moon.
interpretation.summary: The native's complexion and skin hue corresponds to the lord of the Navamsa (D9 sign) occupied by the Moon at birth.

source.original_text: His body and limbs will be commensurate in their proportions with the rising sign and other Rasis which are described as forming the head and other portions of Kalapurusha.

interpretation.detailed: The native's body and limbs will be commensurate in their proportions with the rising sign and other Rasis which form the head and other portions of the Kalapurusha (cosmic universal man). The Kalapurusha mapping: Mesha = head, Vrishabha = face/neck, Mithuna = arms/shoulders, Karkataka = chest, Simha = heart/stomach, Kanya = hips, Tula = navel/lower abdomen, Vrischika = genitals, Dhanus = thighs, Makara = knees, Kumbha = calves/ankles, Meena = feet. The rising sign governs the overall body type and the prominent body part. Native's body proportions and prominent limbs determined by the rising sign's Kalapurusha body-part assignment.
interpretation.summary: The native's body proportions and limb structure correspond to the rising sign, read against the classical Kalapurusha (cosmic man) scheme where each zodiac sign rules a specific body part.

source.original_text: If the lord of the Lagna occupy a Kendra or a Kona with clear rays (uneclipsed) in exaltation or Swakshetra, when the lord of the 8th house is posited in a house other than a Kendra and when the Lagna is occupied by a benefic, the person born will be long-lived, rich, honoured, endowed with good qualities, will be praised by kings, fortunate, possess beautiful limbs, be of good physique, fearless, virtuously disposed and will have a good and happy family.

interpretation.detailed: When three conditions are simultaneously present: (1) the lord of the Lagna occupies a Kendra (1st, 4th, 7th, 10th) or Kona (1st, 5th, 9th) with clear rays — meaning uneclipsed by Sun's combustion — and is in its exaltation or own sign (Swakshetra); (2) the lord of the 8th house is in a house other than a Kendra; and (3) the Lagna itself is occupied by a natural benefic planet — then the person born will be long-lived, rich, honored, endowed with good qualities, praised by kings, fortunate, possess beautiful limbs, be of good physique, fearless, virtuously disposed, and will have a good and happy family. Long-lived, rich, honored, praised by kings, fortunate, beautiful limbs, good physique, fearless, virtuous, good and happy family
interpretation.summary: When the Lagna lord is in a Kendra or Kona with bright rays in exaltation or own sign, the 8th lord is not in a Kendra, and a benefic occupies the Lagna — the native is long-lived, rich, honored, praised by kings, virtuous, fearless, beautiful, and has a happy family.

components.factor: Lagna lord in Kendra or Kona, uneclipsed, in exaltation or Swakshetra
Lord of 8th house NOT in Kendra
Lagna occupied by a natural benefic planet

source.original_text: If the lord of the Lagna be well-associated, the person born will live in a good village or amidst good associations. When the associated planet is strong, he will be under the patronage of a renowned king. When the said planet is in his exaltation, the person will become a king. If the planet should be in his own house, the person will live in his own native place. He will always be on his legs if the planet be in a moveable house. He will be stationary in one place if the planet be in a fixed sign. The effect will be mixed if in a dual sign.

interpretation.detailed: If the lord of the Lagna is well-associated with another planet: the native lives in a good village or amidst good associations. The associated planet's condition further refines this: if the associate is strong → native is under patronage of a renowned king; if in exaltation → becomes a king himself; if in own house → lives in his own native place; if in a moveable sign → always on his legs (wandering); if in a fixed sign → stationary in one place; if in a dual sign → mixed effects between wandering and settled. (Connection per Sloka XV-30 types.) Lives in good village or good associations. If associate strong → king's patronage. If associate exalted → becomes king. If associate in own sign → native place. If moveable sign → wandering; fixed sign → settled; dual sign → mixed.
interpretation.summary: When the Lagna lord is well-associated with another planet, the character and condition of that associated planet determines the native's social environment, place of residence, and social status.

source.original_text: If the lord of the Lagna be of brilliant rays, he will become famous; if the planet be well-placed, the person will be happy and prosperous.

interpretation.detailed: If the lord of the Lagna is possessed of brilliant rays — meaning strong, unafflicted, not combust, and not in an adverse position — the native will become famous. If the lord of the Lagna is well-placed — occupying a favorable house with good dignity — the person will be happy and prosperous. Native becomes famous (if Lagna lord has brilliant rays) and happy and prosperous (if Lagna lord well-placed)
interpretation.summary: When the lord of the Lagna has brilliant rays (strong and unafflicted) or is well-placed in the chart, the native becomes famous, happy, and prosperous.

condition.placement: brilliant rays (strong and unafflicted) or well-placed

source.original_text: But if he should occupy a Dusstthana, be in the house of a malefic or an enemy or occupy his depression sign, the native will be miserable and will live in a despicable place, beside amidst outcasts or vile people.

interpretation.detailed: If the lord of the Lagna occupies a Dusstthana (the 6th, 8th, or 12th house), or is placed in the house of a malefic planet, or in an enemy's sign, or in his own depression sign — the native will be miserable and will live in a despicable place, beside amidst outcasts or vile people. Native is miserable, lives in despicable place amidst outcasts or vile people
interpretation.summary: When the lord of the Lagna occupies a Dusstthana (6th/8th/12th), a malefic planet's sign, an enemy's sign, or his depression sign — the native is miserable and lives in a despicable place among outcasts or vile people.

condition.placement: Dusstthana (6th/8th/12th) or malefic sign or enemy sign or depression

source.original_text: If the Lagna is strong, the person concerned will live happy, thrive well and will come to power and prominence. But if the Lagna be without strength, the man will constantly be overcome by calamities, be sad and will suffer from disease.

interpretation.detailed: If the Lagna (Ascendant sign) itself is strong — occupied or aspected by its lord or benefics, and free from malefic affliction — the person will live happily, thrive well, and will come to power and prominence. But if the Lagna is without strength — afflicted, occupied by malefics, or its lord weakened — the native will constantly be overcome by calamities, be sad, and will suffer from disease. Strong Lagna → happy, thriving, power and prominence. Weak Lagna → constant calamities, sadness, disease.
interpretation.summary: A strong Lagna gives happiness, prosperity, and power. A weak Lagna brings constant calamities, sadness, and disease.

condition.note: Applies to strength of the Lagna sign itself, not just its lord

source.original_text: If the lord of the 2nd house be posited in the Lagna and benefics occupy the 2nd house, the person concerned will be endowed with the best qualities, have a prosperous family, will be rich, affable, and far-sighted.

interpretation.detailed: If the lord of the 2nd house is posited in the Lagna (1st house) AND natural benefic planets occupy the 2nd house, the person concerned will be endowed with the best qualities. He will have a prosperous family, will be rich, affable, and far-sighted. Best qualities, prosperous family, rich, affable, far-sighted
interpretation.summary: When the lord of the 2nd house is placed in the Lagna and natural benefics occupy the 2nd house, the native is endowed with the best qualities, has a prosperous family, is rich, affable, and far-sighted.

components.factor: Lord of 2nd house posited in Lagna (1st house)
Natural benefic planets occupy the 2nd house

source.original_text: If the planet owning the 2nd Bhava be connected with the Sun, the native will utilize his Knowledge and wealth for the good of humanity.

interpretation.detailed: If the planet owning the 2nd Bhava is connected with the Sun — by mutual exchange, conjunction, mutual aspect, Kendra positions, or Trikona positions (per Sloka XV-30) — the native will utilize his knowledge and wealth for the good of humanity. Uses knowledge and wealth for the good of humanity
interpretation.summary: When the lord of the 2nd house is connected with the Sun (per XV-30 connection types), the native uses his knowledge and wealth for the good of humanity.

source.original_text: If the association of the said Lord is with Saturn, the person's learning will be very insignificant and of a low order.

interpretation.detailed: If the planet owning the 2nd Bhava is connected with Saturn (per Sloka XV-30), the person's learning will be very insignificant and of a low order. Learning very insignificant and of low order
interpretation.summary: When the lord of the 2nd house is connected with Saturn, the native's learning is very insignificant and of a low order.

source.original_text: If the associated planet be Jupiter, the person concerned will become proficient in the sacred scriptures and code of laws.

interpretation.detailed: If the planet owning the 2nd Bhava is associated with Jupiter (per XV-30 connection types), the person concerned will become proficient in the sacred scriptures and the code of laws. Proficient in sacred scriptures and code of laws
interpretation.summary: When the lord of the 2nd house is associated with Jupiter, the native becomes proficient in sacred scriptures and the code of laws.

source.original_text: If Mercury, he will be clever in politics.

interpretation.detailed: If the planet owning the 2nd Bhava is associated with Mercury (per XV-30), the person concerned will be clever in politics. Clever in politics
interpretation.summary: When the lord of the 2nd house is associated with Mercury, the native is clever in politics and political affairs.

source.original_text: If Venus, he will know some things of the arts.

interpretation.detailed: If the planet owning the 2nd Bhava is associated with Venus (per XV-30), the person concerned will know some things of the arts. Knows some things of the arts
interpretation.summary: When the lord of the 2nd house is associated with Venus, the native has knowledge of the arts.

source.original_text: If Moon, he will... [OCR corrupt — outcome text unreadable in source PDF]

interpretation.detailed: If the planet owning the 2nd Bhava is associated with the Moon (per XV-30), the person concerned will [outcome text OCR corrupt in source PDF — requires clean edition check]. Classical context suggests this may relate to eloquence, emotional expression, or public reputation, as the Moon governs the mind and public face. [OCR corrupt — outcome text unreadable. Requires clean edition verification before this rule can be populated.]
interpretation.summary: When the lord of the 2nd house is associated with the Moon, the specific outcome is documented but the OCR rendering of the outcome text is corrupt in the source PDF. Requires clean edition verification.

source.original_text: If Mars, he will be an adept in works involving hard labour and will be a back-biter.

interpretation.detailed: If the planet owning the 2nd Bhava is associated with Mars (per XV-30), the person concerned will be an adept in works involving hard labour and will be a back-biter (speaks ill of others behind their backs). Adept in works involving hard labour; back-biter
interpretation.summary: When the lord of the 2nd house is associated with Mars, the native is adept in works involving hard labour and is a back-biter.

source.original_text: If Rahu, he will be lisping or stammering (will speak indistinctly).
