interpretation.detailed: If the planet owning the 2nd Bhava is associated with Rahu (per XV-30), the person concerned will be lisping or stammering — will speak indistinctly. Lisping or stammering speech; speaks indistinctly
interpretation.summary: When the lord of the 2nd house is associated with Rahu, the native has a lisping or stammering speech defect.

source.original_text: If Ketu, he will stammer and utter falsehoods.

interpretation.detailed: If the planet owning the 2nd Bhava is associated with Ketu (per XV-30), the person concerned will stammer and utter falsehoods. Stammers and utters falsehoods
interpretation.summary: When the lord of the 2nd house is associated with Ketu, the native stammers and utters falsehoods.

source.original_text: If malefics occupy the 2nd house, the person concerned will be a fool and without wealth.

interpretation.detailed: If malefic planets (natural malefics: Sun, Mars, Saturn, Rahu, Ketu; waning Moon) occupy the 2nd house, the person concerned will be a fool and without wealth. Fool and without wealth
interpretation.summary: When natural malefic planets occupy the 2nd house, the native is foolish and without wealth.

source.original_text: If the lords of the 3rd house and of the Lagna be connected by their mutual exchange of places and be also strong, the native will be brave, valorous, and helpful to his brothers; he will also be capable of accomplishing daring acts.

interpretation.detailed: If the lord of the Lagna and the lord of the 3rd house are connected by their mutual exchange of places (Parivartana yoga — each occupying the other's sign) AND both are strong, the native will be brave, valorous, and helpful to his brothers. He will also be capable of accomplishing daring acts. Brave, valorous, helpful to brothers, capable of daring acts
interpretation.summary: When the lords of the Lagna and the 3rd house are in Parivartana (mutual exchange of signs) and are both strong, the native is brave, valorous, helpful to brothers, and capable of daring acts.

components.factor: Lord of Lagna and lord of 3rd in Parivartana (mutual sign exchange)

source.original_text: If the lord of the 3rd house be strong and be associated with a benefic and if the Karaka of the Bhava (Mars) be strong and also posited in a benefic house, the prosperity of the brothers is indicated.

interpretation.detailed: If the lord of the 3rd house is strong AND associated with a benefic planet AND the Karaka of the 3rd Bhava (Mars) is also strong AND posited in a benefic house — the prosperity of the native's brothers is indicated. Prosperity of brothers
interpretation.summary: When the lord of the 3rd house is strong and associated with a benefic, and the Karaka of the 3rd (Mars) is strong and in a benefic house, the prosperity of the native's brothers is indicated.

components.factor: Lord of 3rd associated with a benefic
Mars posited in a benefic house

source.original_text: But should he be weak or badly placed, there will be loss of brothers.

interpretation.detailed: But if the lord of the 3rd house should be weak or badly placed — in a Dusstthana, in debilitation, in an enemy's sign, or under malefic influence — there will be loss of brothers. Loss of brothers
interpretation.summary: When the lord of the 3rd house is weak or badly placed in the chart, there will be loss of brothers.

condition.placement: weak or badly placed (Dusstthana, debilitation, enemy sign, malefic influence)

source.original_text: If both the Karaka and the lord of the 3rd Bhava be posited in odd Rasis and be aspected by Jupiter, the Sun and Mars, and if the 3rd house also happen to be an odd sign, the native will have as many brothers as are revealed by the Navamsa.

interpretation.detailed: If both the Karaka of the 3rd Bhava (Mars) AND the lord of the 3rd Bhava are posited in odd Rasis (Mesha, Mithuna, Simha, Tula, Dhanus, Kumbha) AND are aspected by Jupiter, the Sun, and Mars AND the 3rd house itself is also an odd sign — the native will have as many brothers as are revealed by the Navamsa (D9 chart analysis). Number of brothers = number revealed by Navamsa analysis
interpretation.summary: When both the Karaka of the 3rd (Mars) and the 3rd lord are in odd signs, aspected by Jupiter, Sun, and Mars, and the 3rd house itself is an odd sign, the number of brothers is revealed by the Navamsa position.

components.factor: Both aspected by Jupiter, Sun, and Mars
3rd house itself is an odd sign

source.original_text: If at a birth, the lord of the 4th house as well as the Moon occupy a Dusstthana (6th, 8th or 12th) and be devoid of conjunction or aspect of benefics, or, be hemmed in between malefics, be also aspected by or conjoined a malefic, the result will be the death of the mother.

interpretation.detailed: If at a birth, the lord of the 4th house AND the Moon BOTH occupy a Dusstthana (the 6th, 8th, or 12th house) AND are devoid of any conjunction or aspect of natural benefic planets AND are hemmed in between malefics AND are also aspected by or conjoined with a malefic — the result will be the death of the mother. Death of the mother
interpretation.summary: When the lord of the 4th house and the Moon are both in Dusstthana houses (6th/8th/12th), devoid of benefic conjunction or aspect, hemmed between malefics and aspected/conjoined by malefics — the result is the death of the native's mother.

components.factor: Both devoid of benefic conjunction or aspect
Both hemmed between malefics or aspected/conjoined by malefic

source.original_text: But, should the above two planets be strong and be associated with or aspected by benefics, and if benefics be posited in the 4th house, the Yoga will conduce to the mother's happiness.

interpretation.detailed: If the lord of the 4th house AND the Moon are both strong AND associated with or aspected by natural benefic planets AND benefics are posited in the 4th house — this yoga will conduce to the mother's happiness. The happiness of the mother should also be declared by reference to benefics occupying favorable positions reckoned from the Moon, or if they aspect each other or are conjoined. Mother's happiness
interpretation.summary: When the lord of the 4th house and the Moon are both strong, associated with or aspected by benefics, and benefics occupy the 4th house, the yoga conduces to the mother's happiness.

components.factor: Both associated with or aspected by benefics

source.original_text: If the lord of the Lagna occupy the 4th house or the lord of the latter be in the Lagna; if the Moon should have the aspect of either of these, the person born will certainly perform the mother's funeral rites.

interpretation.detailed: If the lord of the Lagna occupies the 4th house OR the lord of the 4th house is in the Lagna; AND if the Moon has the aspect of either of these two planets — the person born will certainly perform the mother's funeral rites (meaning he will outlive his mother and be present at her death). Native will certainly perform the mother's funeral rites (survives mother)
interpretation.summary: When the Lagna lord is in the 4th house or the 4th lord is in the Lagna, and the Moon is aspected by either of these planets, the native will certainly perform his mother's funeral rites.

components.factor: Lagna lord in 4th OR 4th lord in Lagna (mutual position)
Moon aspected by either the Lagna lord or the 4th lord

source.original_text: But if these two planets be posited in the inimical or depression signs of each other or the 6th and the 9th houses and are not in any way connected with each other (either by association or aspect), the person will not be able to do the last funeral rites for the mother at the time of her demise.

interpretation.detailed: But if the lord of the Lagna and the lord of the 4th house are posited in each other's inimical or depression signs OR are in the 6th and 8th houses from each other AND are not in any way connected with each other by association or aspect (per XV-30) — the person will not be able to perform the last funeral rites for the mother at the time of her demise. Cannot perform mother's last funeral rites at time of her demise
interpretation.summary: When the Lagna lord and 4th lord are in mutual enemy or depression signs, or in 6th-8th positions from each other, and are not connected, the native will not be able to perform the mother's last rites at the time of her demise.

components.factor: Lagna lord and 4th lord in mutual enemy/depression signs OR in 6th-8th positions from each other
Not connected by any XV-30 type of relationship

source.original_text: Just as what has been said about the mother from the 4th Bhava, similar remarks should be made in the case of the father, brothers and sons from a reference to the respective Bhavas, Karakas of the Bhavas concerned, the planet owning the Bhava, the Lagna and its lord.

interpretation.detailed: Just as the analysis of the mother's welfare has been conducted from the 4th Bhava (its strength, its lord, its Karaka Moon, its relationship with the Lagna and Lagna lord), similar analysis applies for: father → 9th Bhava (Karaka Sun); brothers → 3rd Bhava (Karaka Mars); sons → 5th Bhava (Karaka Jupiter). The same conjunction, affliction, and benefic-protection patterns determine the welfare of each respective family member. Apply 4th Bhava mother methodology to 9th (father), 3rd (brothers), 5th (sons) using respective Karakas and lords
interpretation.summary: Engine meta-rule: all analysis principles applied to the 4th Bhava (for mother) should be applied equally to the father (9th Bhava), brothers (3rd Bhava), and sons (5th Bhava), using the respective Bhava, its Karaka, its lord, the Lagna, and the Lagna lord.

source.original_text: The lord of the 4th house and Venus, if well-placed, the Lagna and the 4th house, will confer on the native the honor of using a palanquin as his vehicle, lordship and kingship; they will also lead to the acquisition to the native of gold and the like, silk, costly jewels, ornaments, bed, and such other appendages as will facilitate sexual gratification, cows, elephants and horses.

interpretation.detailed: When the lord of the 4th house and Venus are well-placed AND the Lagna and the 4th house are strong — this yoga will confer on the native the honor of using a palanquin as his vehicle, lordship, and kingship. It will also lead to the acquisition of gold and the like, silk, costly jewels, ornaments, bed and such appendages as facilitate sexual gratification, cows, elephants, and horses. Palanquin honors, lordship and kingship; acquires gold, silk, costly jewels, ornaments, cows, elephants, and horses
interpretation.summary: When the lord of the 4th house and Venus are well-placed, and both the Lagna and 4th house are strong, the native receives palanquin honors, lordship and kingship, and acquires gold, silk, jewels, ornaments, cows, elephants, and horses.

source.original_text: If the lord of the 4th house be in a Dusstthana (6th, 8th or 12th) or conjoined with the Sun and Mars, or if the 4th house be occupied by Mars and the Sun, the house where the native was born or conjoined with will be burnt.

interpretation.detailed: If the lord of the 4th house occupies a Dusstthana (6th, 8th, or 12th house), OR is conjoined with the Sun and Mars; OR if the 4th house itself is occupied by both Mars and the Sun — the house where the native was born will be burnt (destroyed by fire). Native's birth-home will be destroyed by fire
interpretation.summary: When the 4th lord is in a Dusstthana or conjoined with Sun and Mars, or when Sun and Mars occupy the 4th house, the native's birth-home will be destroyed by fire.

components.factor: Lord of 4th conjoined with Sun AND Mars
4th house occupied by both Mars and Sun

source.original_text: If Rahu or Saturn be in the 4th with its lord the house will be old and dilapidated.

interpretation.detailed: If Rahu or Saturn occupies the 4th house in conjunction with the lord of the 4th house, the native's home will be old and dilapidated. Home is old and dilapidated
interpretation.summary: When Rahu or Saturn occupies the 4th house along with the 4th lord, the native's home will be old and dilapidated.

source.original_text: If the 4th or its lord occupied by an inimical planet, the native's belongings such as the cows, lands, vehicles, etc., will be usurped by his enemies.

interpretation.detailed: If the 4th house or its lord is occupied by or afflicted through an inimical planet — a planet whose natural relationship with the 4th lord is that of an enemy — the native's belongings such as cows, lands, vehicles, and similar property will be usurped by his enemies. Native's belongings (cows, lands, vehicles) usurped by enemies
interpretation.summary: When the 4th house or the 4th lord is occupied or afflicted by an inimical planet, the native's belongings (cows, lands, vehicles) will be usurped by enemies.

condition.placement: occupied by or conjunct with an inimical planet

source.original_text: If the 5th Bhava be identical with a Rasi or Amsa owned by Mercury (a benefic) or occupied by that planet, the person born will be intelligent and open-hearted.

interpretation.detailed: If the 5th Bhava is identical with a Rasi (D1 sign) or Amsa (Navamsa D9 sign) owned by Mercury (a natural benefic), or if Mercury occupies the 5th house — the person born will be intelligent and open-hearted. Intelligent and open-hearted
interpretation.summary: When the 5th house falls in a Rasi or Navamsa sign owned by Mercury, or Mercury occupies the 5th house, the native is intelligent and open-hearted.

condition.note: Also triggered when 5th house sign or its Navamsa is owned by Mercury

source.original_text: The same will be the case if the lord of the 5th house is well posited and has attained a Vaiseshikamsa.

interpretation.detailed: The same intelligence and open-hearted nature will be the result if the lord of the 5th house is well-placed in the chart AND has attained a Vaiseshikamsa — meaning the planet occupies auspicious Varga positions (such as being in its own or exaltation sign in multiple divisional charts). Intelligent and open-hearted
interpretation.summary: When the lord of the 5th house is well-placed and has attained a Vaiseshikamsa (favorable Varga position), the native is intelligent and open-hearted.

source.original_text: Malefics in the 6th, the lord of the Lagna in conjunction with or aspected by the lord of the 6th possessed of strength, the same lord posited in the 6th, the lord of the 6th in a Kendra house and in conjunction with or aspected by malefics, will subject the native to constant and intense annoyance from enemies, which cannot be easily remedied.

interpretation.detailed: The following five conditions, any one of which is sufficient, will subject the native to constant and intense annoyance from enemies that cannot be easily remedied: (1) Malefics in the 6th house; (2) Lord of the Lagna in conjunction with or aspected by the lord of the 6th house when the 6th lord is strong; (3) Lord of the Lagna posited in the 6th house; (4) Lord of the 6th in a Kendra house (1st/4th/7th/10th); (5) Lord of the 6th in conjunction with or aspected by malefics. Constant and intense annoyance from enemies, which cannot be easily remedied
interpretation.summary: Any of five chart conditions subject the native to constant, intense, and difficult-to-remedy annoyance from enemies: malefics in 6th; Lagna lord conjunct/aspected by powerful 6th lord; Lagna lord in 6th; 6th lord in Kendra; or 6th lord with malefics.

components.factor: Lagna lord conjunct or aspected by strong 6th lord
6th lord conjunct or aspected by malefics

source.original_text: If the lord of the Lagna be stronger than the lord of the 6th house and be posited in the Amsa of a benefic and also be aspected by a benefic and if the lord of the 4th endowed with strength occupy a Kendra or a Kona, the person born will be hale and healthy being endowed with a strong constitution and will enjoy all comforts and happiness.

interpretation.detailed: If the lord of the Lagna is stronger than the lord of the 6th house AND is posited in the Amsa (Navamsa sign) of a natural benefic AND is also aspected by a natural benefic planet AND the lord of the 4th house, endowed with strength, occupies a Kendra (1st/4th/7th/10th) or Kona (1st/5th/9th) — the person born will be hale and healthy with a strong constitution and will enjoy all comforts and happiness. Hale and healthy with strong constitution; enjoys all comforts and happiness
interpretation.summary: When the Lagna lord is stronger than the 6th lord, in a benefic Amsa, aspected by a benefic, and the 4th lord is strong in a Kendra or Kona — the native is hale, healthy, of strong constitution, and enjoys all comforts and happiness.

components.factor: Lagna lord in Amsa (Navamsa) of a benefic
Lagna lord aspected by a benefic
4th lord strong in Kendra or Kona

source.original_text: If at a birth the lord of the 6th house be in a Dusstthana, identical with its depression or inimical sign or be eclipsed by the Sun's rays and if the lord of the Lagna be stronger than him and if the Sun be in the 9th house, the destruction of the enemies of the native may be declared.

interpretation.detailed: If at a birth the lord of the 6th house is in a Dusstthana (6th/8th/12th) OR is in its depression sign OR is in an inimical sign OR is eclipsed by the Sun's rays (combust) AND the lord of the Lagna is stronger than him AND the Sun is in the 9th house — the destruction of the enemies of the native may be declared. Translator's alternate reading: 'and if the 6th house be occupied by a benefic, the destruction of the enemies.' Destruction of native's enemies
interpretation.summary: When the 6th lord is weakened (Dusstthana, depression, inimical sign, or combust), the Lagna lord is stronger, and the Sun is in the 9th house — the destruction of the native's enemies may be declared.

components.factor: 6th lord in Dusstthana OR depression OR inimical sign OR combust

source.original_text: The following Bhavas viz., (1) that owned by the planet associated with the lord of the 6th house, (2) that occupied by the lord of the 6th and (3) that owned by the planet in the 6th — these Bhavas will prove inimical to the native concerned.

interpretation.detailed: The following three Bhavas will prove inimical to the native: (1) The Bhava owned by the planet that is associated with the lord of the 6th house; (2) The Bhava occupied by the lord of the 6th house; (3) The Bhava owned by any planet that occupies the 6th house. The significations of these three Bhavas are where the native will face enmity, rivalry, and opposition during life. Three Bhavas are inimical: Bhava owned by 6th lord's associate; Bhava occupied by 6th lord; Bhava owned by planet in 6th
interpretation.summary: Engine methodology: three Bhavas prove inimical to the native — the Bhava owned by the planet associated with the 6th lord; the Bhava occupied by the 6th lord; and the Bhava owned by any planet in the 6th house.

source.original_text: If the 7th house be connected (vide XV-30, supra) with a benefic (either by association or aspect) and its lord be endowed with strength, the wife of the person born will be virtuously disposed, and will live happily with her husband, being blessed with children and endowed with all good qualities.

interpretation.detailed: If the 7th house is connected with a natural benefic planet (per Sloka XV-30 — by mutual exchange, conjunction, mutual aspect, Kendra relation, or Trikona relation) AND the lord of the 7th house is endowed with strength — the wife of the person born will be virtuously disposed and will live happily with her husband. She will be blessed with children and endowed with all good qualities. Wife virtuously disposed, lives happily with husband, blessed with children, endowed with all good qualities
interpretation.summary: When the 7th house is connected with a natural benefic (by association or aspect) and the 7th lord is strong, the native's wife will be virtuous, will live happily with her husband, and will be blessed with children and all good qualities.

components.factor: 7th house connected with natural benefic per XV-30

source.original_text: Persons in whose nativities the lord of the 8th house is posited in a house other than a Kendra and is also weaker than the lord of the Lagna should be declared to be long-lived and free from anxieties, obstacles and miseries.

interpretation.detailed: Persons in whose nativities the lord of the 8th house is posited in a house other than a Kendra (i.e., not in the 1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th house) AND is weaker than the lord of the Lagna — should be declared to be long-lived and free from anxieties, obstacles, and miseries. Long-lived and free from anxieties, obstacles, and miseries
interpretation.summary: When the lord of the 8th house is not placed in a Kendra and is weaker than the lord of the Lagna, the native should be declared long-lived and free from anxieties, obstacles, and miseries.

components.factor: Lord of 8th NOT in Kendra (not in 1st/4th/7th/10th)
Lord of 8th weaker than lord of Lagna

source.original_text: If Mars or the Sun occupy the 9th house and the lord of the latter be in a Dusstthana or betwixt two malefics, the effect will be the demise of the father of the native soon after his birth. Note: If the death does not take place immediately, it may take place in the Dasa of the Sun or Mars.

interpretation.detailed: If Mars or the Sun occupies the 9th house AND the lord of the 9th house is in a Dusstthana (6th, 8th, or 12th house) OR is placed betwixt two malefics — the result will be the demise of the father of the native soon after his birth. Note: If the death does not take place immediately, it may take place in the Dasha of the Sun or Mars. Father dies soon after native's birth; if not immediately, death occurs during Sun or Mars Dasha
interpretation.summary: When Mars or Sun occupies the 9th house and the 9th lord is in a Dusstthana or hemmed between malefics, the father will die soon after the native's birth. If not immediately, the father's death may occur in the Sun or Mars Dasha.

components.factor: Lord of 9th in Dusstthana OR betwixt two malefics

source.original_text: If the Sun in the case of a day-birth or Saturn in the case of a night-birth be well placed and aspected by benefics, and if the lord of the 9th be also strong, the father of the native will live for a long time.

interpretation.detailed: If the Sun (in the case of a day-birth) or Saturn (in the case of a night-birth) is well-placed in the chart AND is aspected by natural benefic planets AND the lord of the 9th house is also strong — the father of the native will live for a long time. Father of native lives for a long time
interpretation.summary: When the Sun (for day births) or Saturn (for night births) is well-placed and aspected by benefics, and the 9th lord is also strong, the native's father will live for a long time.

components.factor: Sun (day birth) or Saturn (night birth) is well-placed
Sun or Saturn aspected by benefics

source.original_text: If the two luminaries (the Sun and the Moon) be in trine to Saturn and Mars, the child will be abandoned by both the parents.

interpretation.detailed: If the two luminaries — the Sun and the Moon — are both in trine (Trikona position, i.e., in the 5th or 9th sign) to both Saturn and Mars, the child will be abandoned by both parents. Child abandoned by both parents
interpretation.summary: When both the Sun and the Moon are in trine (120° / 5th or 9th from each other) to Saturn and Mars, the child will be abandoned by both parents.

components.factor: Sun in trine to Saturn and Mars
Moon in trine to Saturn and Mars

source.original_text: But if they be aspected by Jupiter, the child will be long-lived and happy.

interpretation.detailed: In the same configuration where the Sun and Moon are in trine to Saturn and Mars — if Jupiter also aspects the Sun and Moon — Jupiter's benefic influence overrides the abandonment outcome and instead the child will be long-lived and happy. Child long-lived and happy (Jupiter overrides abandonment outcome from pd-ch16-043)
interpretation.summary: When the Sun and Moon are in trine to Saturn and Mars (abandonment condition) but are also aspected by Jupiter, the child will be long-lived and happy instead.

components.factor: Sun in trine to Saturn and Mars
Moon in trine to Saturn and Mars
Jupiter aspects Sun and Moon (overriding condition)

source.original_text: If Saturn owning the 9th house occupy a moveable sign and be unaspected by benefics or if the Sun be in a Dusstthana, the child concerned lives under the care of a foster-father.

interpretation.detailed: If Saturn is the owner of the 9th house AND occupies a moveable sign (Mesha, Karkataka, Tula, or Makara) AND is unaspected by any natural benefic planet — OR if the Sun is in a Dusstthana (6th, 8th, or 12th house) — the child concerned will live under the care of a foster-father. Child lives under the care of a foster-father
interpretation.summary: When Saturn owns the 9th house and occupies a moveable sign without benefic aspect, or the Sun is in a Dusstthana, the native lives under the care of a foster-father.

components.factor: Saturn owns 9th house AND occupies moveable sign AND unaspected by benefics

source.original_text: If the 9th house or its lord being in a moveable sign is conjoined with or aspected by Saturn and if the lord of the 12th house be strong, the child born is sure to be adopted by another.

interpretation.detailed: If the 9th house or the lord of the 9th house, being in a moveable sign (Mesha, Karkataka, Tula, or Makara), is conjoined with or aspected by Saturn AND the lord of the 12th house is strong — the child born is sure to be adopted by another person or family. Child is sure to be adopted by another (family)
interpretation.summary: When the 9th house or its lord is in a moveable sign, conjoined with or aspected by Saturn, and the lord of the 12th house is strong, the child will surely be adopted by another family.

components.factor: 9th house or 9th lord in moveable sign
9th house or 9th lord conjoined or aspected by Saturn

source.original_text: If a benefic planet occupy the 10th house and the lord of the latter in full strength be in a Kendra or Kona position identical with its Swakshetra or exaltation sign, or if the lord of the Lagna be in the 10th, the person concerned will be revered by all, widely renowned, and disposed to do always virtuous deeds. His affluence will be similar to that of a king and he will be long-lived.

interpretation.detailed: If a natural benefic planet occupies the 10th house AND the lord of the 10th house in full strength is in a Kendra or Kona position identical with its Swakshetra (own sign) or exaltation sign — OR if the lord of the Lagna is in the 10th house — the person concerned will be revered by all, widely renowned, disposed to always do virtuous deeds. His affluence will be similar to that of a king and he will be long-lived. Revered by all, widely renowned, virtuous, king-like affluence, long-lived
interpretation.summary: When a benefic occupies the 10th house and the 10th lord is fully strong in a Kendra or Kona in own or exaltation sign — or when the Lagna lord is in the 10th — the native is revered by all, widely renowned, virtuous, king-like in affluence, and long-lived.

components.factor: Benefic in 10th AND 10th lord in Kendra/Kona in Swakshetra or exaltation, full strength

source.original_text: If the Sun or Mars occupy the 10th house, the native concerned will be a great and mighty personage and liked by the people. If the lord of the 10th house should also be well-placed, he will be able to accomplish great undertakings involving much valour and heroism.

interpretation.detailed: If the Sun or Mars occupies the 10th house, the native concerned will be a great and mighty personage and liked by the people. If the lord of the 10th house should additionally be well-placed, he will be able to accomplish great undertakings involving much valour and heroism. Great and mighty person, liked by the people. If 10th lord also well-placed → accomplishes great undertakings with valour and heroism.
interpretation.summary: When Sun or Mars occupies the 10th house, the native is great, mighty, and liked by people. If the 10th lord is additionally well-placed, he accomplishes great undertakings requiring valour and heroism.

source.original_text: He will perform some beneficial acts commended by the good if the 10th house be occupied by benefics.

interpretation.detailed: If the 10th house is occupied by natural benefic planets (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury waxing, Moon waxing), the native will perform beneficial acts that are commended by good and virtuous people. Performs beneficial acts commended by the good
interpretation.summary: When natural benefic planets occupy the 10th house, the native performs beneficial acts that are commended by good and virtuous people.

source.original_text: But if Rahu, Saturn and Ketu be posited in the 10th house, the result will be that the person concerned will do sinful and wicked acts.

interpretation.detailed: If Rahu, Saturn, or Ketu is posited in the 10th house, the result will be that the person concerned will do sinful and wicked acts. Sinful and wicked acts
interpretation.summary: When Rahu, Saturn, or Ketu occupies the 10th house, the native does sinful and wicked acts.

source.original_text: Note the following two Bhavas: (1) the Bhava owned by the planet associated with the lord of the 11th house and (2) the Bhava occupied by the lord of the 11th. The (gain) acquisition of things connected by the Bhavas concerned may be predicted. A similar guess may be made also through planets occupying the 11th house.

interpretation.detailed: To predict the domain and nature of a native's gains and acquisitions: (1) Identify the Bhava owned by the planet that is associated with the lord of the 11th house — the significations of that Bhava will be a domain of gain; (2) Identify the Bhava occupied by the lord of the 11th house — the significations of that Bhava will also be a domain of gain; (3) Additionally, planets occupying the 11th house indicate further gain domains through the Bhavas they own. Gains and acquisitions will come from the domains represented by: Bhava owned by 11th lord's associate, Bhava occupied by 11th lord, Bhavas owned by planets in the 11th
interpretation.summary: Engine methodology: to predict the domains of a native's gains, identify (1) the Bhava owned by the planet associated with the 11th lord and (2) the Bhava occupied by the 11th lord. Additionally check planets occupying the 11th. The significations of these Bhavas will be the domains of gain.

source.original_text: Note the following two Bhavas: (1) the Bhava owned by the planet if any occupying the 12th house; (2) the Bhava occupied by the lord of the 12th. The loss of things connected by these two Bhavas should be predicted.

interpretation.detailed: To predict the domain and nature of a native's losses and expenditures: (1) Identify the Bhava owned by the planet (if any) that occupies the 12th house — the significations of that Bhava will be lost; (2) Identify the Bhava occupied by the lord of the 12th house — the significations of that Bhava will also be a domain of loss. Losses will occur in domains represented by: Bhava owned by planet in 12th, Bhava occupied by 12th lord
interpretation.summary: Engine methodology: to predict the domains of a native's losses, identify (1) the Bhava owned by any planet occupying the 12th house and (2) the Bhava occupied by the 12th lord. The significations of these Bhavas will be the domains of loss.

source.original_text: One ought to predict the success or acquisition of a Bhava (1) when the lord of the Lagna during his transit arrives at a sign which happens to be a Trikona sign to the Rasi or Amsa occupied by the lord of the Bhava in question; or (2) when he comes to the Bhava itself; or (3) when the lord of the Bhava transits a sign which is triangular to the sign or Amsa occupied by the lord of the Lagna; or (4) when he comes to the Lagna itself; or (5) when the two lords come in conjunction or aspect each other. The same event may likewise be predicted when the Karaka of the Bhava in question comes during transit in conjunction with the lord of the Rasi containing the Lagna or the Moon.

interpretation.detailed: One ought to predict the success or acquisition of a Bhava's signification when: (1) The lord of the Lagna in transit arrives at a sign in Trikona (1st, 5th, or 9th) to the Rasi or Navamsa occupied by the lord of the Bhava in the natal chart; OR (2) The Lagna lord in transit comes to the Bhava itself; OR (3) The lord of the Bhava in transit arrives at a sign triangular to the sign/Amsa occupied by the Lagna lord in the natal chart; OR (4) The Bhava lord in transit comes to the Lagna itself; OR (5) The two lords (Lagna and Bhava) come in conjunction or mutual aspect in transit. Additionally: when the Karaka of the Bhava comes in transit conjunction with the lord of the Rasi containing the natal Lagna or the natal Moon. Success or acquisition of Bhava's signification predicted when Lagna lord and/or Bhava lord reach Trikona or conjunction positions in transit. Also activated when Bhava Karaka conjuncts Lagna/Moon sign lord in transit.
interpretation.summary: Engine transit methodology: success or acquisition of any Bhava's signification may be predicted by 5 transit methods involving Lagna lord and Bhava lord reaching Trikona positions of each other's natal placement, plus Karaka of the Bhava conjuncting the Lagna/Moon sign lord in transit.

source.original_text: Find out the Rasi and Amsa occupied by the lord of the Bhava under consideration. When Jupiter in his transit comes in trine to this Rasi or Amsa, the realisation of the (good) effect of the Bhava may be expected.

interpretation.detailed: To predict when the good effects of any Bhava will be realized: find the Rasi (D1 sign) and Amsa (D9 Navamsa sign) occupied by the lord of that Bhava in the natal chart. When transiting Jupiter reaches a trine position (i.e., arrives in the 5th or 9th sign from that Rasi or Amsa) — the realization of the good effect of the Bhava may be expected. Good effects of the Bhava realized when transiting Jupiter comes in trine to the natal Rasi or Navamsa of the Bhava's lord
interpretation.summary: When transiting Jupiter reaches a Trikona position (5th or 9th) from the Rasi or Navamsa sign occupied by the Bhava's lord in the natal chart, the good effects of that Bhava may be expected to manifest.

source.original_text: Whenever the lords of the Lagna and the 6th house come in conjunction (while in transit) the enemy of the native will come under his control, if the lord of the 6th house is weaker than the lord of the Lagna.

interpretation.detailed: Whenever the lord of the Lagna and the lord of the 6th house come in conjunction during their transit (i.e., they are in the same sign while transiting), and the lord of the 6th house is weaker than the lord of the Lagna — the enemy of the native will come under his control. Enemy comes under native's control during transit conjunction of Lagna lord and 6th lord (when 6th lord is weaker)
interpretation.summary: When the lords of the Lagna and 6th house come in conjunction in transit, and the 6th lord is weaker than the Lagna lord, the native's enemy will come under his control.

source.original_text: Otherwise, the contrary will be the result.

interpretation.detailed: When the lord of the Lagna and the lord of the 6th house come in conjunction during transit AND the lord of the 6th house is stronger than the lord of the Lagna — the contrary result occurs: the enemy will overpower the native (rather than coming under his control). Enemy overpowers native during transit conjunction of Lagna lord and 6th lord (when 6th lord is stronger)
interpretation.summary: When the lords of the Lagna and 6th house conjoin in transit and the 6th lord is stronger than the Lagna lord, the contrary occurs — the enemy overpowers the native.

source.original_text: If there should be enmity between the lord of a Bhava and that of the Lagna due to natural or temporal causes, or their being posited in the 6th and 8th places with respect to each other, envy, rivalry or jealousy will arise to the native with the person denoted by the Bhava during the transit of these planets.

interpretation.detailed: If there is enmity between the lord of a Bhava and the lord of the Lagna — whether due to natural (permanent) enmity or temporal (temporary chart-based) enmity — OR if the two lords are placed in the 6th and 8th positions with respect to each other natally — then envy, rivalry, or jealousy will arise between the native and the person denoted by that Bhava during the transit of these planets. Envy, rivalry, or jealousy with person denoted by the Bhava during transit of Lagna lord and Bhava lord
interpretation.summary: When there is natural or temporal enmity between the Lagna lord and any Bhava lord, or they are in 6-8 positions from each other natally, their transit conjunction will bring envy, rivalry, or jealousy with the person denoted by that Bhava.

source.original_text: But if there should be friendship — natural or temporary — between the aforesaid two planets, one ought to predict new friendship being formed when the planets also conjoin in their transit.

interpretation.detailed: If there is friendship — natural (permanent) or temporary (chart-based) — between the lord of the Lagna and the lord of a Bhava, one ought to predict that new friendship will be formed with the person denoted by that Bhava when these two planets also conjoin in their transit. New friendship formed with person denoted by the Bhava during transit conjunction of Lagna lord and Bhava lord
interpretation.summary: When there is natural or temporal friendship between the Lagna lord and a Bhava lord, their transit conjunction will bring new friendship with the person denoted by that Bhava.

interpretation.detailed:
With respect to any Bhava: when Saturn in transit arrives at the Rasi and Navamsa occupied by the lord of the 8th or the 12th house reckoned from that Bhava, the total destruction of that Bhava should be expected. Same result if Saturn transits signs triangular (Trikona) to these positions

Result: Total destruction of the Bhava in question.
interpretation.summary: Saturn transit over 8th/12th lord's Rasi+Navamsa → Bhava destruction

engine_notes: This is a general Bhava destruction rule applicable to any house, not just the native's longevity. The engine can apply it to any house when evaluating that house's prospects via transit.

interpretation.detailed:
Find the Rasi and Navamsa of any of these four: (1) lord of 8th house (natal), (2) Gulika/Mandi (natal), (3) Saturn (natal position), (4) lord of 22nd decanate from Lagna. When Saturn in transit passes through any of these Rasis, Navamsas, or their Trikona positions → death may happen

Result: Death.
interpretation.summary: Saturn transit over 4 death-reference points → death

interpretation.detailed:
Find: (1) lord of the rising decanate (Lagna Drekkana lord), (2) lord of the 8th house, (3) lord of the 22nd decanate from Lagna. When Jupiter in transit passes through the Rasi or Amsa occupied by any of these three planets, or a Trikona thereof → death may take place

Result: Death.
interpretation.summary: Jupiter transit over 3 death-reference points → death

interpretation.detailed:
Death may be expected when the Sun transits: (1) the Rasi representing the Sun's own Dwadasamsa (natal), (2) the Navamsa Rasi occupied by the lord of the 8th house, (3) the Navamsa Rasi occupied by the Lagna lord, or their Trikona positions. [Alternative reading: Jupiter takes place of Sun.]

Result: Death.
interpretation.summary: Sun transit over Dwadasamsa/Navamsa of 8th lord or Lagna lord → death

conditions.note: Alternative reading: Jupiter as transit planet instead of Sun — both readings valid

interpretation.detailed:
When the Moon in transit passes through the Rasi or Navamsa occupied by the lord of the 8th house (natal), or through the Rasi/Navamsa of the natal Sun, or their triangular positions → death may take place. All these should also be considered reckoning from the Moon (as alternate Lagna)

Result: Death.
interpretation.summary: Moon transit over Rasi/Navamsa of 8th lord or Sun → death

conditions.note: Apply from both Lagna and Moon

interpretation.detailed:
Subtract the longitudinal figures of Yamakantaka from those of the lord of the rising sign. Find the Rasi and Navamsa indicated by this difference. When Jupiter in transit passes through this Rasi/Navamsa or its Trikona → native's death

Result: Death of native.
interpretation.summary: Jupiter transit over (Lagna lord − Yamakantaka) Rasi → native's death

engine_notes: Yamakantaka is a shadow point (Upagraha). Subtraction: if difference is negative, add 360°. The result is a zodiacal position converted to Rasi.

interpretation.detailed:
Subtract the longitudinal figures of the Moon from those of Saturn (natal). Find the Rasi and Navamsa indicated by the difference. When Jupiter in transit passes through this Rasi/Navamsa or its Trikona → native's death

Result: Death of native.
interpretation.summary: Jupiter transit over (Saturn − Moon) Rasi → native's death

interpretation.detailed:
Subtract Mars's longitudinal figures from those of Rahu (natal). When Jupiter in transit passes through the Navamsa or Rasi indicated by this difference → death of a brother

Result: Death of native's brother.
interpretation.summary: Jupiter transit over (Rahu − Mars) Rasi → brother's death

interpretation.detailed:
Subtract Yamakantaka figures from Sun figures (natal). When Jupiter in transit passes through this Rasi/Trikona → father's death

Result: Death of native's father.
interpretation.summary: Jupiter transit over (Sun − Yamakantaka) Rasi → father's death

interpretation.detailed:
Subtract Mandi figures from Yamakantaka figures (natal). Find the Rasi and Navamsa. When Saturn in transit passes through this Rasi/Navamsa or Trikona → father's death

Result: Death of native's father.
interpretation.summary: Saturn transit over (Yamakantaka − Mandi) Rasi → father's death

interpretation.detailed:
Subtract Moon figures from Sun figures (natal). When Jupiter in transit passes through this Rasi/Navamsa or Trikona → mother's death

Result: Death of native's mother.
interpretation.summary: Jupiter transit over (Sun − Moon) Rasi → mother's death

interpretation.detailed:
Subtract Mandi figures from Moon figures (natal). When Saturn in transit passes through the Rasi/Navamsa thus indicated or Trikona → mother's death

Result: Death of native's mother.
interpretation.summary: Saturn transit over (Moon − Mandi) Rasi → mother's death

interpretation.detailed:
Find the planet ruling the 5th Nakshatra reckoned from the natal Moon's Nakshatra (Janma Tara). Subtract Yamakantaka figures from that planet's figures. When Jupiter in transit passes through the indicated Rasi or its Trikona → son's death

Result: Death of native's son.
interpretation.summary: Jupiter transit over (5th-Nakshatra planet − Yamakantaka) Rasi → son's death

engine_notes: The '5th Nakshatra from natal' = the 5th star reckoned from the native's Janma Tara. The planet ruling that Nakshatra (Nakshatra lord in the Vimshottari system) is the reference planet.

interpretation.detailed:
Find the aggregate of the longitudinal figures for the Lagna, the Sun, and Mandi (natal). Find the house (Rasi) indicated by this total. When Jupiter in transit passes through this Rasi or a Trikona thereof → native's death

Result: Death of native.
interpretation.summary: Jupiter transit over (Lagna + Sun + Mandi) aggregate Rasi → death

interpretation.detailed:
Subtract Saturn's longitudinal figures from Mandi's figures (natal). Find the Rasi and Navamsa indicated by the difference. When Saturn in transit arrives at this Navamsa or Rasi, or their Trikona → death

Result: Death.
interpretation.summary: Saturn transit over (Mandi − Saturn) Rasi+Navamsa → death

interpretation.detailed:
Find the aggregate of the figures for the five Upagrahas reckoned from Dhuma. Find the particular Drekkana of the particular Rasi indicated by this aggregate. When Saturn in transit arrives at this Drekkana → death

Result: Death.
interpretation.summary: Saturn transit over Drekkana of five Upagrahas aggregate (from Dhuma) → death

engine_notes: Five Upagrahas reckoned from Dhuma: Dhuma, Vyatipata, Paridhi, Indra Dhanus, Upaketu (the five secondary shadow points). Sum their longitudes, find the resulting Rasi and its Drekkana.

interpretation.detailed:
Three death-time predictions from Mandi formulas: (1) Lagna + Mandi aggregate → Rasi+Navamsa → when Sun transits this position, the person will die (indicates month of death). (2) Moon at time of death = Rasi of Mandi + Moon aggregate. (3) Rising sign at time of death = Lagna + Mandi + Moon aggregate

Result: Three predicted values for the time of death: (1) month of death (Sun position), (2) Moon's Rasi at death, (3) Lagna at death.
interpretation.summary: Month of death from (Lagna + Mandi) aggregate; Moon and Lagna at time of death predicted

conditions.note: Death month: when Sun transits this

interpretation.detailed:
Death when all four conditions are simultaneously met: (1) Jupiter transits the Navamsa occupied by natal Mandi, (2) Saturn transits the Dwadasamsa occupied by natal Mandi, (3) Sun transits a Trikona sign from the Drekkana of natal Mandi, (4) The rising Lagna at that moment is the Rasi occupied by the lord of (Lagna + Moon + Mandi) aggregate

Result: Death at that precise moment.
interpretation.summary: Multi-planet simultaneous transit trigger: Jupiter+Saturn+Sun all transiting Mandi-derived positions + correct Lagna → death

engine_notes: This is the most complex rule in Ch17 — requires four simultaneous conditions. All four must be satisfied at the same time. This rule predicts the exact moment of death, not just the year or month.

interpretation.detailed:
Multiply Mandi's longitudinal figures by 9. Multiply Saturn's longitudinal figures by 9. Add both products and find the Rasi and Navamsa indicated by the total. When Saturn in transit passes through this → death

Result: Death.
interpretation.summary: Saturn transit over (Mandi×9 + Saturn×9) aggregate → death

interpretation.detailed:
Subtract Yamakantaka figures from lord of rising sign figures. Find the Rasi and Navamsa indicated by this difference. When Jupiter in transit occupies this specific Navamsa within this specific Rasi → death without doubt

Result: Death without doubt (high certainty).
interpretation.summary: Jupiter transit into (Lagna lord − Yamakantaka) Navamsa within computed Rasi → certain death

engine_notes: This rule is similar to Rule 006 (Sloka 6a) but more specific — it requires Jupiter to be in the exact Navamsa within the computed Rasi, not just the Rasi. Higher precision = higher certainty.

interpretation.detailed:

interpretation.detailed:
Find the weakest planet from three sets: Set 1 = lord of 8th + lord of 22nd decanate from Lagna; Set 2 = lord of 8th + lord of 22nd decanate from Moon; Set 3 = Moon + Mandi. When Saturn transits a Trikona position from the Navamsa of any of the above weakest planets → death

Result: Death.

engine_notes: Navamsa Rasi distance from Mesha = Navamsa index (0=Mesha=0, 1=Vrishabha=1, ... 11=Meena=11). Add this offset to the 8th lord's Rasi index (mod 12) → target Rasi.

interpretation.detailed:
Find the natal house positions of five reference grahas: (1) lord of 8th, (2) lord of 12th, (3) lord of 6th, (4) lord of the 8th house's decanate (22nd decanate lord), (5) Mandi. engine_notes: This is the most comprehensive death-transit rule in Ch17 — 4 transit planets × 5 reference positions = 20 potential triggers. The engine should evaluate all 20 and flag death risk when any one is triggered.

interpretation.summary: Moon in Mithuna receiving Jupiter's aspect produces a learned person.

source.original_text: Moon in Mithuna aspected by Venus — fearless.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Mithuna and is aspected by Venus, the native will be fearless. Venus's stabilising, pleasure-oriented quality on the Moon in Mithuna reduces anxiety and fear. Fearless
interpretation.summary: Moon in Mithuna receiving Venus's aspect produces a fearless person.

source.original_text: Moon in Mithuna aspected by Saturn — weaver.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Mithuna and is aspected by Saturn, the native will be a weaver. Saturn governs threads, fibers, and slow methodical work; applied to Mithuna's dexterity and the Moon's softness, this produces textile craft. Weaver
interpretation.summary: Moon in Mithuna receiving Saturn's aspect produces a weaver by occupation.

source.original_text: Moon in Mithuna aspected by Sun — poor.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Mithuna and is aspected by the Sun, the native will be poor. The Sun's aspect depletes the Moon's material-giving capacity in the mercantile sign Mithuna. Poor
interpretation.summary: Moon in Mithuna receiving the Sun's aspect produces poverty.

source.original_text: The Moon in Kataka if aspected by Mars will make the person born a warrior.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Kataka (its own sign) and is aspected by Mars, the native will be a warrior. Mars's martial energy applied to the Moon in its own sign produces a courageous fighter who is emotionally driven in battle. Warrior
interpretation.summary: Moon in Kataka (Cancer) receiving Mars's aspect produces a warrior.

source.original_text: Moon in Kataka aspected by Mercury — learned.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Kataka and is aspected by Mercury, the native will be learned. Mercury's intellectual quality strengthens the Moon in its own sign, producing scholastic ability. Learned
interpretation.summary: Moon in Kataka receiving Mercury's aspect produces a learned person.

source.original_text: Moon in Kataka aspected by Jupiter — wise man.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Kataka and is aspected by Jupiter, the native will be a wise man. Jupiter's wisdom-giving aspect on the Moon in its own sign produces deep intuitive and practical wisdom. Wise man
interpretation.summary: Moon in Kataka receiving Jupiter's aspect produces a wise person.

source.original_text: Moon in Kataka aspected by Venus — king.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Kataka and is aspected by Venus, the native will be a king. Venus's affluence and grace on the Moon in its own strong sign creates a wealthy, powerful sovereign. King
interpretation.summary: Moon in Kataka receiving Venus's aspect produces a king.

source.original_text: Moon in Kataka aspected by Saturn — dealer in iron, copper, etc.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Kataka and is aspected by Saturn, the native will be a dealer in iron, copper, and similar metals. Saturn governs base metals; its aspect on the Moon in Kataka (a water sign governing commerce) produces metal trading. Dealer in iron, copper, etc.
interpretation.summary: Moon in Kataka receiving Saturn's aspect produces a dealer in iron, copper, and similar metals.

source.original_text: Moon in Kataka aspected by Sun — sufferer from eye-disease.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Kataka and is aspected by the Sun, the native will suffer from eye disease. The Sun's scorching aspect on the Moon (a planet governing eyes and fluids) in the water sign Kataka produces ocular ailments. Sufferer from eye-disease
interpretation.summary: Moon in Kataka receiving the Sun's aspect produces a person who suffers from eye disease.

source.original_text: If the Moon occupies Simha and is aspected by Mars, the person born will be a king.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Simha and is aspected by Mars, the native will be a king. Simha is the Sun's own sign; Mars's energetic aspect on the Moon there produces royal authority. King
interpretation.summary: Moon in Simha (Leo) receiving Mars's aspect produces a king.

source.original_text: Moon in Simha aspected by Mercury — astrologer.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Simha and is aspected by Mercury, the native will be an astrologer. Mercury's analytical and predictive quality applied to the Moon in Simha (sign of self-authority and solar knowledge) produces expertise in astrology. Astrologer
interpretation.summary: Moon in Simha receiving Mercury's aspect produces an astrologer.

source.original_text: Moon in Simha aspected by Jupiter — wealthy.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Simha and is aspected by Jupiter, the native will be wealthy. Jupiter's abundance-giving quality on the Moon in the regal sign Simha produces material prosperity. Wealthy
interpretation.summary: Moon in Simha receiving Jupiter's aspect produces wealth.

source.original_text: Moon in Simha aspected by Venus — king.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Simha and is aspected by Venus, the native will be a king. Venus's royal comfort and luxury on the Moon in the kingly sign Simha activates sovereignty. King
interpretation.summary: Moon in Simha receiving Venus's aspect produces a king.

source.original_text: Moon in Simha aspected by Saturn — barber.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Simha and is aspected by Saturn, the native will be a barber. Saturn's constricting, service-class quality suppresses the Moon in the regal sign Simha to the level of a humble service trade. Barber
interpretation.summary: Moon in Simha receiving Saturn's aspect produces a barber.

source.original_text: Moon in Simha aspected by Sun — king.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Simha and is aspected by the Sun, the native will be a king. The Sun is the lord of Simha; its aspect on the Moon in its own sign activates the full royal power of that sign. King
interpretation.summary: Moon in Simha receiving the Sun's aspect produces a king.

source.original_text: If at a birth the Moon be in Kanya and be aspected by Mars, the person born will be clever.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Kanya and is aspected by Mars, the native will be clever. Mars's sharpening quality applied to the Moon in Mercury's analytical sign Kanya produces a quick, clever intellect. Clever
interpretation.summary: Moon in Kanya (Virgo) receiving Mars's aspect produces a clever person.

source.original_text: Moon in Kanya aspected by Mercury — king.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Kanya and is aspected by Mercury, the native will be a king. Mercury is the lord of Kanya; its aspect on the Moon in its Moolatrikona sign activates strong kingly potential. King
interpretation.summary: Moon in Kanya receiving Mercury's aspect produces a king.

source.original_text: Moon in Kanya aspected by Jupiter — head of army.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Kanya and is aspected by Jupiter, the native will be a head of an army (military commander). Jupiter's authoritative aspect on the Moon in the analytical sign Kanya produces strategic military leadership. Head of army (military commander)
interpretation.summary: Moon in Kanya receiving Jupiter's aspect produces a head of an army (military commander).

source.original_text: Moon in Kanya aspected by Venus — skilful in all matters.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Kanya and is aspected by Venus, the native will be skilful in all matters. Venus's grace and dexterity on the Moon in Kanya (sign of craftsmanship and analysis) produces universal capability. Skilful in all matters
interpretation.summary: Moon in Kanya receiving Venus's aspect produces a person skilful in all matters.

source.original_text: Moon in Kanya aspected by Saturn — king.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Kanya and is aspected by Saturn, the native will be a king. Saturn's discipline and structured authority applied to the Moon in the diligent sign Kanya produces disciplined kingly rule. King
interpretation.summary: Moon in Kanya receiving Saturn's aspect produces a king.

source.original_text: Moon in Kanya aspected by Sun — king.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Kanya and is aspected by the Sun, the native will be a king. The Sun's royal authority cast upon the Moon in Kanya activates leadership and sovereignty. King
interpretation.summary: Moon in Kanya receiving the Sun's aspect produces a king.

source.original_text: The effect of the Moon in Tula being aspected by Mars will make the person born a rogue.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Tula and is aspected by Mars, the native will be a rogue. Mars's aggressive, rule-breaking quality applied to the Moon in Venus-ruled Tula produces deceptive, dishonest conduct. Rogue
interpretation.summary: Moon in Tula (Libra) receiving Mars's aspect produces a rogue.

source.original_text: Moon in Tula aspected by Mercury — king.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Tula and is aspected by Mercury, the native will be a king. Mercury's analytical and commercial acuity applied to the Moon in the balanced sign Tula produces diplomatic sovereign power. King
interpretation.summary: Moon in Tula receiving Mercury's aspect produces a king.

source.original_text: Moon in Tula aspected by Jupiter — goldsmith.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Tula and is aspected by Jupiter, the native will be a goldsmith (one who works in gold). Tula governs balancing/weighing; Jupiter governs gold and prosperity; the Moon governs craft. Their combination produces expertise in the gold trade and jewellery. Goldsmith
interpretation.summary: Moon in Tula receiving Jupiter's aspect produces a goldsmith.

source.original_text: Moon in Tula aspected by Venus — trader.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Tula and is aspected by Venus, the native will be a trader. Venus is the lord of Tula; its aspect on the Moon in its own sign combined with Tula's mercantile and balancing energy produces a commercial trader. Trader
interpretation.summary: Moon in Tula receiving Venus's aspect produces a trader.

source.original_text: Moon in Tula aspected by Saturn — tale-bearer.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Tula and is aspected by Saturn, the native will be a tale-bearer (one who spreads gossip and slander). Saturn's constricting, grudging quality applied to the Moon in the social sign Tula produces a petty, gossiping character. Tale-bearer (gossip)
interpretation.summary: Moon in Tula receiving Saturn's aspect produces a tale-bearer (gossip).

source.original_text: Moon in Tula aspected by Sun — wicked.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Tula and is aspected by the Sun, the native will be wicked. The Sun is debilitated in Tula; its aspect on the Moon in the sign of its own debilitation produces moral corruption. Wicked
interpretation.summary: Moon in Tula receiving the Sun's aspect produces a wicked person.

source.original_text: If the Moon be in Vrischika and is aspected by Mars, the person born will be a king.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Vrischika and is aspected by Mars, the native will be a king. Mars is the lord of Vrischika; its aspect on the Moon in its own sign activates royal power. King
interpretation.summary: Moon in Vrischika (Scorpio) receiving Mars's aspect produces a king.

source.original_text: Moon in Vrischika aspected by Mercury — father of twins.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Vrischika and is aspected by Mercury, the native will be a father of twins. Mercury governs duality and pairs; Vrischika governs regeneration and the 8th house; their combination on the Moon produces twin births in the native's family. Father of twins
interpretation.summary: Moon in Vrischika receiving Mercury's aspect produces a father of twins.

source.original_text: Moon in Vrischika aspected by Jupiter — king.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Vrischika and is aspected by Jupiter, the native will be a king. Jupiter's wisdom and authority mitigate Vrischika's harsh quality and elevate the Moon to kingly status. King
interpretation.summary: Moon in Vrischika receiving Jupiter's aspect produces a king.

source.original_text: Moon in Vrischika aspected by Venus — washerman.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Vrischika and is aspected by Venus, the native will be a washerman. The Moon governs water and cleansing; Venus governs cloth and beauty; Vrischika governs hidden/wet places. Their combination produces laundry/washing trade. Washerman
interpretation.summary: Moon in Vrischika receiving Venus's aspect produces a washerman.

source.original_text: Moon in Vrischika aspected by Saturn — one defective of some limb.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Vrischika and is aspected by Saturn, the native will have a physical defect in some limb. Saturn governs bones and physical limitations; Vrischika governs the 8th house of chronic conditions; Saturn's aspect on the Moon there produces bodily defects. Defective of some limb
interpretation.summary: Moon in Vrischika receiving Saturn's aspect produces a person defective in some limb.

source.original_text: Moon in Vrischika aspected by Sun — moneyless.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Vrischika and is aspected by the Sun, the native will be moneyless (without financial resources). The Sun's depleting aspect on the Moon in the difficult 8th-sign Vrischika removes all material security. Moneyless
interpretation.summary: Moon in Vrischika receiving the Sun's aspect produces a moneyless person.

source.original_text: If the Moon occupies Dhanus and be aspected by Mars, the person concerned will be a cheat.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Dhanus and is aspected by Mars, the native will be a cheat. Mars's aggressive, rule-breaking energy applied to the Moon in the idealistic sign Dhanus produces deceptive manipulation of others. Cheat (deceiver)
interpretation.summary: Moon in Dhanus (Sagittarius) receiving Mars's aspect produces a cheat (deceiver).

source.original_text: Moon in Dhanus aspected by Mercury — protects his kinsmen.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Dhanus and is aspected by Mercury, the native will protect his kinsmen. Mercury's communicative, calculating quality combined with the Moon's nurturing nature in the dharmic sign Dhanus produces family protectiveness. Protects his kinsmen
interpretation.summary: Moon in Dhanus receiving Mercury's aspect produces a person who protects his kinsmen.

source.original_text: Moon in Dhanus aspected by Jupiter — ruler of earth.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Dhanus and is aspected by Jupiter, the native will be a ruler of the earth. Jupiter is the lord of Dhanus; its aspect on the Moon in its own sign activates the highest leadership. This is the strongest positive outcome in the Dhanus Moon series. Ruler of earth
interpretation.summary: Moon in Dhanus receiving Jupiter's aspect produces a ruler of earth.

source.original_text: Moon in Dhanus aspected by Venus — support to many people.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Dhanus and is aspected by Venus, the native will be a support to many people — a benefactor, patron, or shelter figure. Venus's generous, comfort-giving quality on the Moon in the dharmic sign Dhanus produces large-scale benevolence. Support to many people
interpretation.summary: Moon in Dhanus receiving Venus's aspect produces a person who is a support and refuge to many people.

source.original_text: Moon in Dhanus aspected by Saturn — rogue.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Dhanus and is aspected by Saturn, the native will be a rogue. Saturn's restrictive, pessimistic quality applied to the Moon in the optimistic sign Dhanus produces cynical, dishonest conduct. Rogue
interpretation.summary: Moon in Dhanus receiving Saturn's aspect produces a rogue.

source.original_text: Moon in Dhanus aspected by Sun — arrogant fellow.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Dhanus and is aspected by the Sun, the native will be arrogant. The Sun's domineering aspect on the Moon in the proud, expansive sign Dhanus amplifies ego and arrogance. Arrogant
interpretation.summary: Moon in Dhanus receiving the Sun's aspect produces an arrogant person.

source.original_text: Moon in Makara aspected by Mars — king.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Makara and is aspected by Mars, the native will be a king. Mars's exaltation in Makara makes its aspect here particularly potent; the Moon receives this strong Martian energy and activates royal power. King
interpretation.summary: Moon in Makara (Capricorn) receiving Mars's aspect produces a king.

source.original_text: Moon in Makara aspected by Mercury — king.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Makara and is aspected by Mercury, the native will be a king. Mercury's intellectual, administrative quality on the Moon in Saturn's disciplined sign Makara produces methodical, structured sovereign power. King
interpretation.summary: Moon in Makara receiving Mercury's aspect produces a king.

source.original_text: Moon in Makara aspected by Jupiter — king.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Makara and is aspected by Jupiter, the native will be a king. Despite Jupiter being debilitated in Makara, its aspect on the Moon there still activates kingly potential according to this rule. King
interpretation.summary: Moon in Makara receiving Jupiter's aspect produces a king.

source.original_text: Moon in Makara aspected by Venus — learned or wise man.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Makara and is aspected by Venus, the native will be a learned or wise person. Venus's grace and cultivation applied to the Moon in the structured sign Makara produces disciplined scholarship and wisdom. Learned or wise man
interpretation.summary: Moon in Makara receiving Venus's aspect produces a learned or wise man.

source.original_text: Moon in Makara aspected by Saturn — wealthy.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Makara and is aspected by Saturn, the native will be wealthy. Saturn is the lord of Makara; its aspect on the Moon in its own sign produces material abundance despite Saturn's general malefic quality. Wealthy
interpretation.summary: Moon in Makara receiving Saturn's aspect produces wealth.

source.original_text: Moon in Makara aspected by Sun — poor.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Makara and is aspected by the Sun, the native will be poor. The Sun's depleting aspect on the debilitated Moon in Makara (the Moon's debilitation sign) eliminates material sustenance entirely. Poor
interpretation.summary: Moon in Makara receiving the Sun's aspect produces poverty.

source.original_text: Moon in Kumbha aspected by Mars — addicted to other people's wives.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Kumbha and is aspected by Mars, the native will be addicted to other people's wives. Mars's passionate, transgressive quality applied to the Moon in the detached sign Kumbha produces sexual transgression and moral boundary-crossing. Addicted to other people's wives
interpretation.summary: Moon in Kumbha (Aquarius) receiving Mars's aspect produces addiction to other people's wives.

source.original_text: Moon in Kumbha aspected by Mercury — king.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Kumbha and is aspected by Mercury, the native will be a king. Mercury's communicative and administrative quality applied to the Moon in the progressive sign Kumbha produces innovative leadership. King
interpretation.summary: Moon in Kumbha receiving Mercury's aspect produces a king.

source.original_text: Moon in Kumbha aspected by Jupiter — lord of men.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Kumbha and is aspected by Jupiter, the native will be a lord of men. Jupiter's vast, inclusive authority on the Moon in the humanitarian sign Kumbha produces a leader who commands broad human allegiance. Lord of men
interpretation.summary: Moon in Kumbha receiving Jupiter's aspect produces a lord of men (ruler of people).

source.original_text: Moon in Kumbha aspected by Venus — fond of women not his own.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Kumbha and is aspected by Venus, the native will be fond of women not his own (extramarital or other men's women). Venus's sensual, pleasure-seeking quality on the detached Moon in Kumbha produces unfaithfulness and promiscuity. Fond of women not his own
interpretation.summary: Moon in Kumbha receiving Venus's aspect produces fondness for women other than one's own partner.

source.original_text: Moon in Kumbha aspected by Saturn — best of kings.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Kumbha and is aspected by Saturn, the native will be the best of kings. Saturn is the lord of Kumbha; its aspect on the Moon in its own sign activates the highest kingly potential of this sign. This is the supreme positive outcome in the Kumbha Moon series. Best of kings
interpretation.summary: Moon in Kumbha receiving Saturn's aspect produces the best of kings.

source.original_text: Moon in Kumbha aspected by Sun — respected by men.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Kumbha and is aspected by the Sun, the native will be respected by men. The Sun's authoritative presence on the Moon in Kumbha confers social respect and public honour. Respected by men
interpretation.summary: Moon in Kumbha receiving the Sun's aspect produces a person respected by men.

source.original_text: Moon in Meena aspected by Mars — sinner.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Meena and is aspected by Mars, the native will be a sinner. Mars's transgressive, violent quality applied to the Moon in the spiritual, sensitive sign Meena corrupts the native's character toward sinful conduct. Sinner
interpretation.summary: Moon in Meena (Pisces) receiving Mars's aspect produces a sinner.

source.original_text: Moon in Meena aspected by Mercury — witty.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Meena and is aspected by Mercury, the native will be witty. Mercury's quick, clever quality on the imaginative, dreamy Moon in Meena produces creative wit and playful intelligence. Witty
interpretation.summary: Moon in Meena receiving Mercury's aspect produces a witty person.

source.original_text: Moon in Meena aspected by Jupiter — king.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Meena and is aspected by Jupiter, the native will be a king. Jupiter is the lord of Meena; its aspect on the Moon in its own sign (also Pisces, a highly benefic placement) activates the highest potential — kingship. King
interpretation.summary: Moon in Meena receiving Jupiter's aspect produces a king.

source.original_text: Moon in Meena aspected by Venus — learned man.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Meena and is aspected by Venus, the native will be a learned man. Venus's love of beauty and knowledge combined with the Moon in the spiritually attuned sign Meena produces scholarship and refinement. Learned man
interpretation.summary: Moon in Meena receiving Venus's aspect produces a learned man.

source.original_text: Moon in Meena aspected by Saturn — intent on sinful deeds.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Meena and is aspected by Saturn, the native will be intent on sinful deeds. Saturn's dark, karmic quality applied to the sensitive Moon in the spiritually vulnerable sign Meena corrupts spiritual aspirations toward sinful conduct. Intent on sinful deeds
interpretation.summary: Moon in Meena receiving Saturn's aspect produces a person intent on sinful deeds.

source.original_text: Moon in Meena aspected by Sun — sinner.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies Meena and is aspected by the Sun, the native will be a sinner. The Sun's depleting aspect on the Moon in the spiritually sensitive sign Meena strips away virtue, producing sinful conduct. Sinner
interpretation.summary: Moon in Meena receiving the Sun's aspect produces a sinner.

source.original_text: Moon in Mars Navamsa aspected by Sun — watchman of a city.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Mars Navamsa (Mesha or Vrischika Navamsa division) and is aspected by the Sun, the native will be a watchman of a city. The Sun governs authority and guarding; Mars governs vigilance and martial duty; their combination on the Moon in a Mars division produces civic guardianship. Watchman of a city
interpretation.summary: Moon occupying a Mars Navamsa (Mesha or Vrischika Navamsa) receiving the Sun's aspect produces a watchman or guardian of a city.

source.original_text: Moon in Mars Navamsa aspected by Mars — fond of killing.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Mars Navamsa and is aspected by Mars, the native will be fond of killing. Mars's double influence — through both the Navamsa and the aspect — on the Moon produces extreme violence and cruelty. Fond of killing
interpretation.summary: Moon in a Mars Navamsa receiving Mars's aspect produces a person fond of killing.

source.original_text: Moon in Mars Navamsa aspected by Mercury — skilled in close fighting.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Mars Navamsa and is aspected by Mercury, the native will be skilled in close fighting (hand-to-hand or short-range combat). Mercury's tactical, dexterous quality combined with Mars's warrior energy produces fighting craft and dexterity. Skilled in close fighting
interpretation.summary: Moon in a Mars Navamsa receiving Mercury's aspect produces skill in close fighting (hand-to-hand combat).

source.original_text: Moon in Mars Navamsa aspected by Jupiter — king.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Mars Navamsa and is aspected by Jupiter, the native will be a king. Jupiter's authority applied to the Moon in the martial Navamsa division elevates martial energy to sovereign power. King
interpretation.summary: Moon in a Mars Navamsa receiving Jupiter's aspect produces a king.

source.original_text: Moon in Mars Navamsa aspected by Venus — rich at the time of birth.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Mars Navamsa and is aspected by Venus, the native will be rich at the time of birth. Venus's material abundance applied to the Moon in the Mars division produces inherited or natal wealth — the native is born into prosperity. Rich at time of birth
interpretation.summary: Moon in a Mars Navamsa receiving Venus's aspect produces a person who is rich at the time of birth (born wealthy).

source.original_text: Moon in Mars Navamsa aspected by Saturn — promotes quarrels.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Mars Navamsa and is aspected by Saturn, the native will be a promoter of quarrels. Saturn's obstructive, resentful quality combined with Mars's combative energy and the Moon's emotional charge produces a person who instigates and sustains conflicts. Promotes quarrels
interpretation.summary: Moon in a Mars Navamsa receiving Saturn's aspect produces a person who promotes or instigates quarrels.

source.original_text: Moon in Venus Navamsa aspected by Sun — fool.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Venus Navamsa and is aspected by the Sun, the native will be a fool. The Sun's depleting, harsh aspect on the Moon in the pleasure-seeking, gentle Venus division removes intelligence and discernment, producing foolishness. Fool
interpretation.summary: Moon in a Venus Navamsa (Vrishabha or Tula Navamsa) receiving the Sun's aspect produces a fool.

source.original_text: Moon in Venus Navamsa aspected by Mars — addicted to other people's wives.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Venus Navamsa and is aspected by Mars, the native will be addicted to other people's wives. Mars's passionate, transgressive quality applied to the sensual Moon in a Venus division produces sexual transgression and moral corruption. Addicted to other people's wives
interpretation.summary: Moon in a Venus Navamsa receiving Mars's aspect produces addiction to other people's wives.

source.original_text: Moon in Venus Navamsa aspected by Mercury — good poet.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Venus Navamsa and is aspected by Mercury, the native will be a good poet. Mercury governs language and expression; Venus governs aesthetics and beauty; the Moon governs imagination. Their triple influence produces refined poetic talent. Good poet
interpretation.summary: Moon in a Venus Navamsa receiving Mercury's aspect produces a good poet.

source.original_text: Moon in Venus Navamsa aspected by Jupiter — author of good literary works.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Venus Navamsa and is aspected by Jupiter, the native will be an author of good literary works. Jupiter's wisdom and expansiveness combined with Venus's aesthetic refinement and the Moon's imagination produces distinguished literary authorship. Author of good literary works
interpretation.summary: Moon in a Venus Navamsa receiving Jupiter's aspect produces an author of good literary works.

source.original_text: Moon in Venus Navamsa aspected by Venus — intent on all comforts.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Venus Navamsa and is aspected by Venus, the native will be intent on all comforts. Venus's double influence (Navamsa + aspect) on the Moon produces extreme pursuit of luxury, sensory pleasure, and comfort. Intent on all comforts
interpretation.summary: Moon in a Venus Navamsa receiving Venus's aspect produces a person intent on securing all comforts and pleasures.

source.original_text: Moon in Venus Navamsa aspected by Saturn — unites with other people's wives.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Venus Navamsa and is aspected by Saturn, the native will unite with other people's wives. Saturn's transgressive, boundary-crossing quality applied to the sensual Moon in a Venus division produces adulterous conduct. Unites with other people's wives
interpretation.summary: Moon in a Venus Navamsa receiving Saturn's aspect produces a person who unites (has sexual union) with other people's wives.

source.original_text: Moon in Mercury Navamsa aspected by Sun — actor.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Mercury Navamsa and is aspected by the Sun, the native will be an actor. The Sun governs performance and display; Mercury governs mimicry and language; the Moon governs public appeal. Their combination produces dramatic performance talent. Actor
interpretation.summary: Moon in a Mercury Navamsa (Mithuna or Kanya Navamsa) receiving the Sun's aspect produces an actor.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Mercury Navamsa and is aspected by Mercury, the native will be a minister. Mercury's double influence (Navamsa + aspect) on the Moon produces intellectual, administrative, and advisory excellence — the hallmarks of ministerial service. Minister
interpretation.summary: Moon in a Mercury Navamsa receiving Mercury's aspect produces a minister (senior advisor or administrator).
