source.original_text: Moon in Mercury Navamsa aspected by Venus — skilled in music.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Mercury Navamsa and is aspected by Venus, the native will be skilled in music. Mercury governs precise, mathematical craft; Venus governs aesthetics and musical beauty; the Moon governs emotional expression. Their combination produces refined musical talent. Skilled in music
interpretation.summary: Moon in a Mercury Navamsa receiving Venus's aspect produces skill in music.

source.original_text: Moon in Mercury Navamsa aspected by Saturn — skilled in mechanical arts.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Mercury Navamsa and is aspected by Saturn, the native will be skilled in mechanical arts. Saturn governs construction, hard materials, and disciplined craft; Mercury governs technical precision; the Moon governs manual dexterity. Their combination produces engineering and mechanical skill. Skilled in mechanical arts
interpretation.summary: Moon in a Mercury Navamsa receiving Saturn's aspect produces skill in mechanical arts (craftsmanship, engineering, construction).

source.original_text: Moon in Moon Navamsa aspected by Sun — lean in person.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Moon Navamsa (Kataka Navamsa division) and is aspected by the Sun, the native will be lean in body. The Sun's drying, consuming quality applied to the Moon in its own Navamsa division depletes physical mass, producing a lean or slender physique. Lean in person
interpretation.summary: Moon in a Moon Navamsa (Kataka Navamsa) receiving the Sun's aspect produces a lean or thin-bodied person.

source.original_text: Moon in Moon Navamsa aspected by Mars — avaricious.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Moon Navamsa and is aspected by Mars, the native will be avaricious. Mars's acquisitive, aggressive quality applied to the Moon's emotional attachment to security in its own division produces compulsive greed. Avaricious
interpretation.summary: Moon in a Moon Navamsa receiving Mars's aspect produces an avaricious (excessively greedy) person.

source.original_text: Moon in Moon Navamsa aspected by Mercury — practising penance.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Moon Navamsa and is aspected by Mercury, the native will practise penance. Mercury's analytical, scrutinizing quality applied to the reflective Moon in its own Navamsa division deepens introspection and spiritual austerity practice. Practising penance
interpretation.summary: Moon in a Moon Navamsa receiving Mercury's aspect produces a person who practises penance (tapas, austerities).

source.original_text: Moon in Moon Navamsa aspected by Jupiter — important personage.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Moon Navamsa and is aspected by Jupiter, the native will be an important personage — a person of social or official consequence. Jupiter's authority and the Moon's public popularity in its own Navamsa division produces social prominence. Important personage
interpretation.summary: Moon in a Moon Navamsa receiving Jupiter's aspect produces an important personage (person of social consequence).

source.original_text: Moon in Moon Navamsa aspected by Venus — servant under a woman.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Moon Navamsa and is aspected by Venus, the native will be a servant under a woman. Both the Moon and Venus represent feminine energy; the double feminine influence produces subordination to female authority. Servant under a woman
interpretation.summary: Moon in a Moon Navamsa receiving Venus's aspect produces a person who serves under a woman.

source.original_text: Moon in Moon Navamsa aspected by Saturn — devoted to his duties.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Moon Navamsa and is aspected by Saturn, the native will be devoted to his duties. Saturn's disciplining, dutiful quality applied to the Moon in its own Navamsa division produces a reliable, duty-conscious, conscientious person. Devoted to his duties
interpretation.summary: Moon in a Moon Navamsa receiving Saturn's aspect produces a person devoted to his duties.

source.original_text: Moon in Sun (Simha) Navamsa aspected by Sun — person of angry temper.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Sun Navamsa (Simha Navamsa division) and is aspected by the Sun, the native will have an angry temper. The Sun's double influence — through both the Leo/Simha Navamsa and the direct aspect — on the Moon produces fierce, hot-tempered, easily enraged character. Angry temper
interpretation.summary: Moon in a Sun/Simha Navamsa (Simha Navamsa division) receiving the Sun's aspect produces a person of angry temper.

source.original_text: Moon in Sun Navamsa aspected by Mars — friend of the king.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Sun Navamsa and is aspected by Mars, the native will be a friend of the king. The Sun's regal Navamsa and Mars's martial, commanding quality produce a person in the inner circle of royal or sovereign power. Friend of the king
interpretation.summary: Moon in a Sun Navamsa receiving Mars's aspect produces a friend of the king.

source.original_text: Moon in Sun Navamsa aspected by Mercury — lord of hidden treasure.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Sun Navamsa and is aspected by Mercury, the native will be a lord of hidden treasure. Mercury's analytical, secretive quality combined with the Moon in the Sun's powerful Navamsa produces the ability to locate, hold, and control concealed wealth and secret resources. Lord of hidden treasure
interpretation.summary: Moon in a Sun Navamsa receiving Mercury's aspect produces a lord of hidden treasure.

source.original_text: Moon in Sun Navamsa aspected by Jupiter — great lord.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Sun Navamsa and is aspected by Jupiter, the native will be a great lord. Jupiter's expansive, benevolent authority applied to the Moon in the regal Sun Navamsa produces the highest form of sovereign or aristocratic power. Great lord
interpretation.summary: Moon in a Sun Navamsa receiving Jupiter's aspect produces a great lord (person of great power and authority).

source.original_text: Moon in Sun Navamsa aspected by Venus — childless.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Sun Navamsa and is aspected by Venus, the native will be childless. The Sun and Venus are natural enemies; Venus's aspect on the Moon in the Sun's Navamsa corrupts the fertility and progeny-signification of the Moon. Childless
interpretation.summary: Moon in a Sun Navamsa receiving Venus's aspect produces a childless person.

source.original_text: Moon in Sun Navamsa aspected by Saturn — indulges in cruel acts.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Sun Navamsa and is aspected by Saturn, the native will indulge in cruel acts. Saturn's harsh, austere quality combined with the Sun's authority in the Sun Navamsa produces cold, calculated cruelty. Cruel acts
interpretation.summary: Moon in a Sun Navamsa receiving Saturn's aspect produces a person who indulges in cruel acts.

source.original_text: Moon in Jupiter Navamsa aspected by Sun — man of reputed valour.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Jupiter Navamsa and is aspected by the Sun, the native will be a man of reputed valour — renowned for bravery and courageous deeds. The Sun's glory and Jupiter's nobility combine to produce celebrated heroism. Man of reputed valour
interpretation.summary: Moon in a Jupiter Navamsa (Dhanus or Meena Navamsa) receiving the Sun's aspect produces a man of reputed valour (renowned for bravery).

source.original_text: Moon in Jupiter Navamsa aspected by Mars — versed in fighting.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Jupiter Navamsa and is aspected by Mars, the native will be versed in fighting. Mars's martial quality applied to the Moon in the elevated Jupiter Navamsa produces disciplined, principled combat expertise. Versed in fighting
interpretation.summary: Moon in a Jupiter Navamsa receiving Mars's aspect produces a person well versed in the art of fighting.

source.original_text: Moon in Jupiter Navamsa aspected by Mercury — witty.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Jupiter Navamsa and is aspected by Mercury, the native will be witty. Mercury's quick, clever quality applied to the expansive, philosophical Moon in a Jupiter Navamsa produces wide-ranging, quick-minded wit. Witty
interpretation.summary: Moon in a Jupiter Navamsa receiving Mercury's aspect produces a witty person.

source.original_text: Moon in Jupiter Navamsa aspected by Jupiter — minister.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Jupiter Navamsa and is aspected by Jupiter, the native will be a minister. Jupiter's double influence (Navamsa + aspect) on the Moon produces the counselling, advisory, and administrative excellence of a high-ranking minister. Minister
interpretation.summary: Moon in a Jupiter Navamsa receiving Jupiter's aspect produces a minister.

source.original_text: Moon in Jupiter Navamsa aspected by Venus — without lust.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Jupiter Navamsa and is aspected by Venus, the native will be without lust. Venus's pleasures are transformed by the elevated, spiritual quality of the Jupiter Navamsa; the native transcends sensory desire and practises detachment or celibacy. Without lust
interpretation.summary: Moon in a Jupiter Navamsa receiving Venus's aspect produces a person who is without lust (celibate or dispassionate in sexual matters).

source.original_text: Moon in Jupiter Navamsa aspected by Saturn — virtuously disposed.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Jupiter Navamsa and is aspected by Saturn, the native will be virtuously disposed. Saturn's discipline and sense of moral duty applied to the Moon in the wise, principled Jupiter Navamsa produces steadfast virtue and righteous conduct. Virtuously disposed
interpretation.summary: Moon in a Jupiter Navamsa receiving Saturn's aspect produces a person virtuously disposed (of virtuous character).

source.original_text: Moon in Saturn Navamsa aspected by Sun — very limited children.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Saturn Navamsa and is aspected by the Sun, the native will have very limited children. Saturn restricts, the Sun depletes, and the Moon's progeny-signification under their combined influence in the difficult Saturn Navamsa produces extremely limited offspring. Very limited children
interpretation.summary: Moon in a Saturn Navamsa (Makara or Kumbha Navamsa) receiving the Sun's aspect produces very limited children (very few or no progeny).

source.original_text: Moon in Saturn Navamsa aspected by Mars — miserable life though wealthy.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Saturn Navamsa and is aspected by Mars, the native will lead a miserable life though wealthy. The Saturn Navamsa restricts emotional contentment; Mars's fierce, restless quality further destabilises happiness; the result is material abundance without peace or joy. Miserable life though wealthy
interpretation.summary: Moon in a Saturn Navamsa receiving Mars's aspect produces a person who is miserable despite being wealthy.

source.original_text: Moon in Saturn Navamsa aspected by Mercury — haughty.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Saturn Navamsa and is aspected by Mercury, the native will be haughty. Mercury's analytical, critical quality applied to the restrictive Moon in Saturn's Navamsa produces a superior, dismissive attitude toward others. Haughty
interpretation.summary: Moon in a Saturn Navamsa receiving Mercury's aspect produces a haughty (arrogant, condescending) person.

source.original_text: Moon in Saturn Navamsa aspected by Jupiter — devoted to duty.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Saturn Navamsa and is aspected by Jupiter, the native will be devoted to duty. Jupiter's ethical, dharmic quality applied to the disciplined Moon in Saturn's Navamsa produces steadfast devotion to obligations and responsibilities. Devoted to duty
interpretation.summary: Moon in a Saturn Navamsa receiving Jupiter's aspect produces a person devoted to duty.

source.original_text: Moon in Saturn Navamsa aspected by Venus — fond of wicked women.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Saturn Navamsa and is aspected by Venus, the native will be fond of wicked women. Venus's sensual quality combined with Saturn's dark, base instincts in the Saturn Navamsa and the Moon's emotional attachment produces attraction to disreputable female company. Fond of wicked women
interpretation.summary: Moon in a Saturn Navamsa receiving Venus's aspect produces fondness for wicked or loose-charactered women.

source.original_text: Moon in Saturn Navamsa aspected by Saturn — irascible.

interpretation.detailed: When the Moon occupies a Saturn Navamsa and is aspected by Saturn, the native will be irascible. Saturn's double influence (Navamsa + aspect) on the Moon produces extreme emotional irritability, quick temper, and chronic frustration. Irascible
interpretation.summary: Moon in a Saturn Navamsa receiving Saturn's aspect produces an irascible (quick-tempered, irritable) person.

source.original_text: The effects stated above in connection with the Moon (in a Navamsa aspected by planets) should also be declared in the case of the Sun when it occupies those Navamsas and is aspected by the Moon and the other planets.

interpretation.detailed: This extension rule states that all outcomes described for the Moon occupying a planetary Navamsa and receiving aspects (rules pd-ch18-095 to pd-ch18-136) apply symmetrically to the Sun when the Sun occupies those Navamsas and receives aspects from the Moon or other planets. The engine must therefore implement two lookup passes for Section 3 outcomes: one keyed on Moon-in-Navamsa + aspecting-planet, and a second keyed on Sun-in-Navamsa + aspecting-planet (using Moon as the first aspector in place of Sun in the original table). This doubles the applicability of the 42 Navamsa-aspect outcomes. Apply Moon-in-Navamsa-aspect outcomes to Sun-in-Navamsa-aspect cases
interpretation.summary: The Moon-in-Navamsa-aspected-by-planet outcomes (Slokas 12–15) also apply when the Sun occupies those same Navamsas aspected by the Moon or other planets.

condition.description: Extend Moon-in-Navamsa outcomes to Sun-in-Navamsa with Moon/other-planet aspect

source.original_text: The effects described above (Slokas 12–15) are Amsaphala — i.e. effects derived from the Navamsa (D9) divisional chart.

interpretation.detailed: This engine specification rule confirms that the outcome lookup in Slokas 12–15 (rules pd-ch18-095 to pd-ch18-137) operates on the Navamsa (D9) divisional chart, not the Rasi chart. The relevant Navamsa is determined by the Moon's (or Sun's) longitude divided into the 9-fold Navamsa scheme. The aspecting planet's position is also assessed in the Navamsa context. Implementation note: compute D9 chart first; then determine which planetary Navamsa the Moon occupies in D9 (i.e. which sign the Moon falls in in D9: if Mesha → Mars Navamsa, Vrishabha → Venus Navamsa, etc.); then check which planets aspect the Moon in D9. Slokas 12–15 outcomes are D9 (Navamsa) chart effects
interpretation.summary: Confirmation that the Moon/Sun-in-Navamsa-aspected-by-planet outcomes (Slokas 12–15) are specifically Amsaphala — effects of the Navamsa (D9) divisional chart.

condition.description: Navamsa-aspect effects use D9 chart; Moon/Sun Navamsa = sign occupied by Moon/Sun in D9

source.original_text: Similarly, the effects of the Moon in the Rasi signs aspected by planets (Slokas 6–11) should also be applied in the case of the Dwadasamsa (D12) divisions.

interpretation.detailed: This extension rule states that the 72 Moon-in-sign-aspected-by-planet outcomes (Slokas 6–11, rules pd-ch18-023 to pd-ch18-094) are not limited to the Rasi chart. They also apply when the Moon's position is evaluated in the Dwadasamsa (D12) divisional chart — the 12th-harmonic division. The engine should therefore run the Section 2 lookup twice: once using the Moon's Rasi sign (from D1), and once using the sign the Moon occupies in D12. When both lookups apply to the same native, both outcomes are active. D12 outcomes are typically lower in magnitude than Rasi outcomes per the magnitude scale in pd-ch18-140. Slokas 6–11 outcomes applicable to D12 Dwadasamsa as well as Rasi
interpretation.summary: The Moon-in-Rasi-sign-aspected-by-planet outcomes (Slokas 6–11) also apply when assessed via the Dwadasamsa (D12) divisional chart.

condition.description: Moon-in-sign-aspect effects (Slokas 6–11) also apply using Moon's Dwadasamsa (D12) sign

source.original_text: Good effects (of Moon in Navamsa aspected by planets) are full, middling, or little according as the Moon is in Vargottama Navamsa, in its own Navamsa, or in any other Navamsa. Bad effects are in the reverse order.

interpretation.detailed: This engine specification rule provides the magnitude scale for all Navamsa-based aspect outcomes (Slokas 12–15, rules pd-ch18-095 to pd-ch18-136, and their Sun extension in pd-ch18-137). For positive outcomes: Vargottama Moon (Moon's Rasi sign = Moon's D9 sign) → full/maximum effect; Moon in its own Navamsa (Moon in Kataka sign in D9) → middling effect; Moon in any other Navamsa → little/minimal effect. For negative outcomes: the order reverses — Vargottama → least bad effect; own Navamsa → middling bad; other Navamsa → most severe bad effect. Engine implementation: tag each Navamsa-aspect rule result with a magnitude_modifier field populated from this three-tier scale at chart evaluation time. Magnitude of Navamsa-aspect outcomes scales with Moon's Navamsa dignity (Vargottama/own/other)
interpretation.summary: The magnitude of Moon-in-Navamsa outcomes scales by Navamsa dignity: Vargottama = full good (or least bad); own Navamsa = middling; other Navamsa = little good (or full bad).

condition.description: Vargottama > own Navamsa > other Navamsa for good effects; reverse for bad effects

source.original_text: When the lord of the Navamsa occupied by the Moon is strong, the effects of the Navamsa (Slokas 12–15) alone should be declared and not the Rasi-aspect effects (Slokas 6–11).

interpretation.detailed: This override rule specifies that the two lookup sections of Chapter 18 (Section 2: Moon in Rasi sign aspected by planet; Section 3: Moon in Navamsa aspected by planet) are not always additive. When the lord of the Navamsa that the Moon occupies in D9 is strong (has high Shadbala or is in exaltation/own sign/Kendra/Trikona), the Navamsa-aspect effects (Slokas 12–15, pd-ch18-095 to pd-ch18-137) take exclusive precedence and the Rasi-aspect effects (Slokas 6–11, pd-ch18-023 to pd-ch18-094) are suppressed for that chart. Engine implementation: evaluate Navamsa lord strength; if strong (threshold: in exaltation, own sign, or high Shadbala rank), set a flag that activates Navamsa-only mode for Moon-aspect lookups. This is the highest-precedence rule in Ch18. Strong Navamsa lord overrides Rasi-aspect outcomes; Navamsa-aspect outcomes exclusive
interpretation.summary: When the lord of the Navamsa occupied by the Moon is strong, only the Navamsa-aspect outcomes (Slokas 12–15) apply; the Rasi-sign-aspect outcomes (Slokas 6–11) are nullified.

condition.description: If Moon's Navamsa lord is strong: use Navamsa-aspect outcomes only; suppress Rasi-aspect outcomes

interpretation.detailed: Count stars from Krittika in groups of nine. The Dasha lords in sequence are: Sun (6 years), Moon (10), Mars (7), Rahu (18), Jupiter (16), Saturn (19), Mercury (17), Ketu (7), Venus (20). Total cycle = 120 years.
interpretation.summary: Vimshottari Dasha order and years

condition.note: Vimshottari Dasha lookup table — applied to any natal chart

interpretation.detailed:
To find remaining Dasha period at birth: (1) Find Ghatikas still to be traversed by the Moon in its natal Nakshatra. (2) Multiply by the Dasha years of that Nakshatra's lord. (3) Divide by 60 — quotient = remaining years. (4) Remainder × 12 ÷ 60 = months. (5) Remaining × 30 ÷ 60 = days

Result: Remaining Dasha years/months/days at birth.
interpretation.summary: Remaining Dasha at birth: calculation from Moon's natal Nakshatra

condition.note: Calculation method for birth-time Dasha balance

interpretation.detailed:
One solar year = the period from birth until the Sun completes a full revolution and returns to the exact natal degree. This is the base time unit for the Udu Dasa system. Sub-divisions (months, days) are calculated from this

Result: Solar year duration for Udu Dasa calculations.
interpretation.summary: Solar year definition for Udu Dasa system

condition.note: Solar year = Sun's exact return to natal longitude

interpretation.detailed:
If at birth the Sun is badly placed, during his Dasa: quarrels promoted, sudden displeasure of sovereign, sickness among relatives, wandering with others, intolerable mental anguish, danger from fire to concealed wealth/grain/sons/wife

Result: Quarrels, sovereign's displeasure, relatives' sickness, wandering, mental anguish, danger from fire.
interpretation.summary: Sun Dasa (badly placed) — adverse effects

interpretation.detailed:
If at birth the Sun is posited in a good house, during his Dasa: acquisition of wealth through cruel deeds, journeys, kings and quarrels, roaming through forests and mountains, wide fame, success in business, severity, devotion to duty, happiness

Result: Wealth, fame, business success, happiness, devotion to duty.
interpretation.summary: Sun Dasa (well placed) — positive effects

interpretation.detailed:
During the Moon's Dasa: tranquillity of mind, success in all business, good food, acquisition of wife/children/ornaments/clothes/gems/cows/lands, honour for Brahmins

Result: Peace of mind, business success, material acquisitions, family happiness.
interpretation.summary: Moon Dasa — effects

interpretation.detailed:
The Moon's Dasa effects depend on the Moon's phase at birth: First 10 days of lunar month = moderate strength, moderate effects. Middle 10 days (around Full Moon) = full strength, very auspicious effects. Last 10 days (waning) = declining strength, effects gradually decrease

Result: Moon Dasa effects scale with Moon's birth phase strength.
interpretation.summary: Moon Dasa — effects modulated by lunar phase at birth

conditions.note: Birth Moon phase modifies strength of Moon Dasa effects

engine_notes: This rule modifies Rule 006. The engine must determine Moon's phase at birth (waxing strong, waxing weak, full, waning) to calibrate Moon Dasa outcome strength.

During Mars Dasa: wealth through fire/king/fighting; money through medicine/falsehood/cheating/cruel actions; troubled by bilious complaints/blood impurity/fever; intrigues with low females; quarrels with wife/children/relations/elders; misery; delight in others' fortune

Result: Mixed material gains through conflict, health troubles, family discord.
interpretation.summary: Mars Dasa — effects

interpretation.detailed:
During Mercury Dasa: meeting of friends, personal comforts, fame through scholars' applause, favour from elders, clever speech, doing good to others, happiness to wife/children/friends, exalted position

Result: Social success, intellectual recognition, family happiness, elevated status.
interpretation.summary: Mercury Dasa — effects (Set 1)

interpretation.detailed:
During Jupiter Dasa: virtuous deeds, acquisition of children, honour from sovereign, praise from great men, acquisition of elephants/horses/vehicles, meeting with wife/children/friends, fulfilment of desires

Result: Virtuous gains, honour, vehicles, children, fulfilment of desires.
interpretation.summary: Jupiter Dasa — effects (Set 1)

interpretation.detailed:
During Venus Dasa: materials for sport and happiness, good vehicles, cows, gems, ornaments, treasure, enjoyment with young women, intellectual pursuits, voyages, auspicious deeds, acceptance of presents from sovereign

Result: Luxuries, wealth, pleasure, voyages, sovereign's favour.
interpretation.summary: Venus Dasa — effects (Set 1)

interpretation.detailed:
During Saturn Dasa: wife and children troubled by gout/rheumatism/windy diseases, loss in agriculture, evil talk, intercourse with wicked women, desertion of servants, absence from residence, sudden destruction/loss of relations/lands/happiness/wealth

Result: Family illness, agricultural loss, social disgrace, displacement, material losses.
interpretation.summary: Saturn Dasa — effects (Set 1)

interpretation.detailed:
During Rahu Dasa: trouble from sovereign/thieves/poison/fire/weapons, sickness to children, ruffled mind, loss of relations, insult from base people, scandal from breach of decorum, ejection from office, wounding of leg, failure of business

Result: Adversity from multiple sources — sovereign, enemies, theft, fire; social disgrace; business failure.
interpretation.summary: Rahu Dasa — general adverse effects

interpretation.detailed:
If Rahu is associated with a benefic planet AND occupies a good house (not 6th/8th/12th), his Dasa period will be benefic and fully auspicious: elevation to king-like affluence, all desires fulfilled, happiness at home, steady wealth accumulation, wide renown

Result: King-like affluence, all desires fulfilled, steady wealth, renown.
interpretation.summary: Rahu Dasa (with benefic + good house) — fully auspicious

interpretation.detailed:
When Rahu is in Virgo (Kanya), Pisces (Meena), or Scorpio (Vrischika), during his Dasa: honour/happiness/lordship of lands/carriages/servants — but all these are lost at the conclusion of the Dasa

Result: Honour, lands, carriages, servants during Dasa — all lost at Dasa's end.
interpretation.summary: Rahu Dasa in Kanya/Meena/Vrischika — honour but transient

engine_notes: The loss at Dasa end is an explicit prediction. The engine should note both the gain during the Dasa and the expected reversal at its conclusion.

interpretation.detailed:
During Ketu Dasa: troubles from enemies/thieves/sovereign, wounds from weapons, disease from excessive heat, false calumny, stigma to family, danger from fire, absence from own country

Result: Adversity, wounds, disease from heat, family disgrace, exile.
interpretation.summary: Ketu Dasa — effects (Set 1)

interpretation.detailed:
During Sun Dasa (Set 2): money-making by cruel acts through kings and fighting, trouble from fire and beasts, eye inflammation, stomach and teeth illness, severe trouble to wife and children, separation from revered seniors and parents, destruction of servants, loss of property

Result: Wealth through conflict, health troubles (eyes/stomach/teeth), family hardship, property loss.
interpretation.summary: Sun Dasa — effects (Set 2)

engine_notes: This is a second description of Sun Dasa effects — complement to Rules 004 and 005. Engine combines both sets for complete Sun Dasa picture.

interpretation.detailed:
During Moon Dasa (Set 2): money through sacred prayers/Gods/Brahmins/royal favour; securing woman/wealth/lands; profusion of flowers/clothes/ornaments/perfumes/valuable objects; misunderstanding with wicked, loss of money, wind disease

Result: Spiritual wealth, material gains, but also social friction and wind disease.
interpretation.summary: Moon Dasa — effects (Set 2)

interpretation.detailed:

Result: Property gains through conflict, family discord, health problems, wealth loss.
interpretation.summary: Mars Dasa — effects (Set 2)

interpretation.detailed:

Result: Character deterioration or mysterious illness, family losses, enemy trouble, sensory diseases.
interpretation.summary: Rahu Dasa — effects (Set 2)

interpretation.detailed:
During Jupiter Dasa (Set 2): new clothes and valuable objects; attendants/retinue/grandeur; intense respect and dignity; acquisition of children/wealth/friends; adoration for wise speech; separation from elders, ear disease, phlegmatic troubles

Result: Dignity, wealth, children, recognition for speech — but separation from elders and health issues.
interpretation.summary: Jupiter Dasa — effects (Set 2)

interpretation.detailed:
During Saturn Dasa (Set 2): wealth from country troubles and fighting; servants and old women; acquisition of cows/buffaloes/bulls; trouble to children and wife; windy and phlegmatic diseases; piles; burning sensation in legs/hands/limbs

Result: Wealth from turmoil, agricultural gains, family trouble, chronic diseases.
interpretation.summary: Saturn Dasa — effects (Set 2)

interpretation.detailed:
During Mercury Dasa (Set 2): benefit of spiritual preceptors; money through Brahmins; acquisition of lands/cows/horses; worship of great men and Gods; immense wealth; diseases from wind/heat/phlegm

Result: Spiritual guidance, wealth, property — with tri-doshic health challenges.
interpretation.summary: Mercury Dasa — effects (Set 2)

interpretation.detailed:

interpretation.summary: Ketu Dasa — effects (Set 2)

interpretation.detailed:

interpretation.summary: Venus Dasa — effects (Set 2)

When the Lagna possesses maximum strength, during the Dasa of its lord: native rises to eminence in the world, happily placed in life, physically strong, brilliant appearance, prosperity increases like the Moon's digits in the bright half of a month

interpretation.summary: 3rd lord (strong) Dasa — brothers, valour, honour

interpretation.detailed:
During the Dasa of a strong 4th lord: help to relations, agricultural success, female friendship, acquisition of vehicles/new land/new house/wealth, higher status (promotion in position)

interpretation.summary: 4th lord (strong) Dasa — property, vehicles, family status

interpretation.detailed:

interpretation.summary: 5th lord (strong) Dasa — son, honour, royal service

interpretation.detailed:

interpretation.summary: 6th lord (strong) Dasa — enemy subjugation, health, power

interpretation.detailed:

interpretation.summary: 7th lord (strong) Dasa — marriage, pleasure, virility

interpretation.detailed:
During the Dasa of a strong 8th lord: complete discharge of debts, own elevation, cessation of quarrels, acquisition of buffaloes/cows/goats/servants

interpretation.detailed:

When the 2nd lord is badly placed, during its Dasa: stupid behaviour in public assemblies, breach of word and family duty, evil tidings, bad correspondence, eye trouble, foul tongue, heavy expenditure, fear of sovereign

Result: Dishonour, eye trouble, breach of faith, financial excess, sovereign's wrath.

interpretation.detailed:
When the 3rd lord is badly placed, during its Dasa: brother's death, evil counsel in undertakings, trouble from secret internal enemies, humiliation, discomfiture, loss of pride

interpretation.summary: 3rd lord (badly placed) Dasa — brother's death, humiliation

interpretation.detailed:
When the 4th lord is badly placed, during its Dasa: distress to mother, sickness to dear friends, danger to lands and house, trouble from planets, cattle destruction, danger from water

interpretation.summary: 4th lord (badly placed) Dasa — mother's distress, property danger

interpretation.detailed:
When the 5th lord is badly placed, during its Dasa: loss of son, mental aberration, deception, wearisome wandering, stomach trouble, sovereign's displeasure, bodily weakness

interpretation.detailed:
When the 6th lord is badly placed, during its Dasa: trouble from thieves, reverses, defeat, various diseases, wicked acts, servile duties, disgrace, wounds

interpretation.summary: 6th lord (badly placed) Dasa — theft, defeat, wounds

When the 7th lord is badly placed, during its Dasa: distress to son-in-law, separation from beloved, untoward events through the opposite sex, intrigues with wicked women, genital diseases, wandering

When the 8th lord is badly placed, during its Dasa: excessive sorrow, want of sense, carnal appetite, jealousy, unconsciousness, poverty, fruitless rambling, calumny, sickness, humiliation, and death

When the 9th lord is badly placed, during its Dasa: wrath of formerly worshipped deity, untoward events, trouble to wife and children, wicked acts, death of elders and father, penury

interpretation.detailed:
When the 10th lord is badly placed, during its Dasa: fruitless actions, loss of honour, wicked behaviour, absence in foreign places, inauspicious happenings, bad life, troubles

interpretation.detailed:
When the 11th lord is badly placed, during its Dasa: evil tidings, trouble to a brother, children's sickness, misery, deception, ear disease

When the 12th lord is badly placed, during its Dasa: various diseases, dishonour, bondage, all wealth disappears like the waning Moon

interpretation.detailed:
For a complete Dasa interpretation, combine effects from: Ch1 (Definitions), Ch2 (Planets/Karakas), Ch5 (Profession), Ch14 (Diseases), Ch18 (Conjunctions), Ch15/16/17 (House effects, Bhava lords, transits). All these must be assigned to the Dasa planets in their respective periods

Result: Complete Dasa prediction requires synthesis of multiple chapters.
interpretation.summary: Cross-chapter synthesis for complete Dasa interpretation

interpretation.detailed:
Vargottama planet's Dasa → favourable results. Eclipsed or depressed planet's Dasa → mixed results. When both Dasa AND Apahara (Bhukti) belong to lords of 6th/8th/12th houses → unfavourable

Result: Three outcome modifiers for Dasa quality determination.
interpretation.summary: Vargottama Dasa = favourable; eclipsed/depression = mixed; dual dusthana Dasa = bad

interpretation.detailed:
During a malefic planet's Dasa, when the Bhukti of the lord of the 3rd/5th/7th Nakshatra from natal Nakshatra is in progress, OR the Bhukti of the lord of the Janma Rasi, OR lord of 8th from Janma Rasi → troubles from thieves and enemies, much misery

Result: Troubles from thieves and enemies, much misery.
interpretation.summary: Malefic Dasa + adverse Bhukti → enemy trouble and misery

interpretation.detailed:
In the ordered sequence of Mahadasas from birth, dangerous periods arise when: (1) Saturn's Dasa is the 4th, (2) Jupiter's is the 6th, (3) Mars's or Rahu's is the 5th. Also dangerous: Dasa of a planet at the end of a sign, or owning a dusthana (6/8/12)

Result: Dangerous Dasa periods.
interpretation.summary: Dangerous Dasa sequences: Saturn 4th, Jupiter 6th, Mars/Rahu 5th; dusthana lord

interpretation.detailed:
If Mars is in an Urdhvamukha (upward-facing) sign or exaltation sign identical with the 10th or 11th house, during Mars Dasa: native secures a kingdom, subdues enemies, becomes renowned with many vehicles and a huge army, feeds many people

Result: Kingdom, military power, great renown, army command.
interpretation.summary: Mars in Urdhvamukha sign or exaltation + 10th/11th → kingdom during Mars Dasa

interpretation.detailed:
If Venus is uneclipsed, free from malefic association, in own or exaltation sign identical with the 12th, 10th, or 11th house, during Venus Dasa: many gems/precious stones, intellect expanded, immense affluence, praised by many

Result: Many gems, expanded intellect, immense wealth, widespread praise.
interpretation.summary: Venus uneclipsed + own/exaltation + 12th/10th/11th → gems, wealth, praise during Venus Dasa

interpretation.detailed:
All benefics placed in depression/inimical/6th/12th houses → only adverse results in their Dasa. Malefics similarly placed → incalculable (intense) miseries in their Dasa

Result: Benefics in bad placement → adverse Dasa. Malefics in bad placement → intense misery.
interpretation.summary: Benefics in bad positions → adverse Dasa; malefics in bad positions → intense misery

interpretation.detailed:
During a Dasa, when the Bhukti belongs to a planet inimical to the Dasanatha, or to a planet in the 6th/inimical house, or inimical to the Lagna lord → danger from enemies, loss/change of position, friends turn hostile

Result: Enemy danger, position loss, friends turn hostile.
interpretation.summary: Bhukti of planet inimical to Dasanatha → enemy danger, position loss

interpretation.detailed:
The Bhava effects during a Bhukti depend on which house the Bhuktinatha occupies counted from the Dasanatha. In 6th/8th/12th from Dasanatha = unhappy effects. In any other house = good effects

Result: 6th/8th/12th from Dasanatha = unhappy Bhukti. Other houses = good Bhukti.
interpretation.summary: Bhuktinatha's house from Dasanatha determines Bhukti effects

engine_notes: This is a key algorithmic rule for Bhukti prediction. The engine must compute which house the Bhuktinatha occupies relative to the Dasanatha and assign positive/negative accordingly.

interpretation.detailed: Strength proportions: Exaltation = full (6/6), Moolatrikona = 3/4, Swakshetra (own sign) = 1/2, Friendly sign = 1/4, Inimical sign = minimum, Depression = nil. These proportions apply for benefics or lords of benefic houses. For malefics or lords of malefic houses = reverse. Combust planet = treated as depressed.
interpretation.summary: Planet strength scale: Exaltation to depression; combust = depressed

engine_notes: This is the Phaladeepika-specific strength scale for Dasa prediction. Different from Shadbala. The reversal for malefics/malefic-house lords is notable.

interpretation.detailed:
From the set {Saturn, Mandi, Rahu, 22nd decanate lord, 8th lord, and Navamsa lords of all these}, find the weakest. That planet's Dasa is the fatal Dasa. Death occurs when Saturn in transit passes through a dusthana (6th/8th/12th) during that Dasa

Result: Fatal Dasa identified. Death when Saturn transits dusthana.
interpretation.summary: Weakest death-trigger planet set → fatal Dasa; Saturn transit to dusthana = death

interpretation.detailed:
Pair 1: lord of house of 8th lord vs lord of Navamsa of 8th lord — find stronger. Pair 2: lord of 22nd decanate vs lord of rising decanate — find stronger. When the Dasa of either stronger planet is in progress, AND Jupiter in transit passes through the Rasi and Navamsa of the 8th lord or its Trikona → death

Result: Death during this Dasa when Jupiter transits 8th lord position.
interpretation.summary: Stronger planet from two pairs → Dasa + Jupiter transit 8th lord position = death

interpretation.detailed:
The 2nd and 7th houses are the two Maraka (death-producing) houses. If the lords of these or planets posited therein are powerful, they cause death during their Dasas. If the lord of the 8th or 12th house is very weak, death may be expected during the Bhukti of either of the two Maraka lords

Result: Death during Dasa of strong 2nd or 7th lord. Weak 8th/12th lord → death in Bhukti of Maraka lord.
interpretation.summary: Maraka houses 2nd and 7th; strong lords cause death in Dasa

interpretation.detailed:
Five planets engender misery: (1) planet in 8th house, (2) planet aspecting 8th, (3) planet owning 8th, (4) planet owning 8th house decanate, (5) planet owning sign of Mandi. The weakest among these is the killer and the native's demise may happen in his Dasa or Apahara (Bhukti)

Result: Weakest of five = killer planet. Death in its Dasa or Bhukti.
interpretation.summary: Five misery-causers; weakest = killer planet in Dasa or Bhukti

interpretation.detailed:
Death (of the relative signified by a particular Bhava) will take place in the Dasa of the planet in the 12th house reckoned from that Bhava, or of the owner of that 12th house — whichever is weaker

Result: Death of relative in weaker planet's Dasa.
interpretation.summary: Death of relative = Dasa of weaker of 12th-from-that-Bhava planet or its lord

interpretation.detailed:
If Jupiter, the Moon's sign lord, and the Lagna lord are all in Kendras at birth → the middle portion of life is good. Additionally: Prishtodaya-sign planets give good results at end of Dasa; Ubhayodaya-sign planets in middle; Sirshodaya-sign planets at beginning of Dasa

Result: Middle life good. Dasa timing by sign type: Prishtodaya=end, Ubhayodaya=middle, Sirshodaya=beginning.
interpretation.summary: Jupiter+Moon lord+Lagna lord in Kendras → good middle life; sign type governs timing

interpretation.detailed:
During a Dasa, when the Dasanatha in transit passes through its own sign, exaltation, or friendly house, provided the planet was endowed with full strength at birth → promotes prosperity of the corresponding Bhava

Result: Bhava represented by Dasanatha flourishes.
interpretation.summary: Dasanatha's transit through own/exaltation/friendly + strong at birth → Bhava prosperity

interpretation.detailed:
During a Dasa, when the Dasanatha in transit is weak, eclipsed, depressed, or in inimical house at birth, and transits through any house → total destruction of that Bhava

Result: Total destruction of the Bhava the Dasanatha transits through.
interpretation.summary: Weak/eclipsed/depressed Dasanatha in transit → total Bhava destruction

interpretation.detailed:
Moon transit produces happy Dasa effects when in: exaltation/friendly sign of Dasanatha, or 3rd/6th/10th/11th/Trikona/7th house from Dasanatha. If Moon's transit position is otherwise → effects are unhappy

Result: Moon in favorable transit = happy effects. Unfavorable = unhappy effects.
interpretation.summary: Moon transit in favorable position from Dasanatha → happy Dasa; otherwise unhappy

interpretation.detailed:
During a Bhukti: if the Bhuktinatha in transit passes through its depression or inimical house, or becomes eclipsed → much misery. If it passes through own sign, exaltation, or is retrograde → good effects

Result: Transit dignity determines Bhukti quality during the period.
interpretation.summary: Bhuktinatha's transit in depression/inimical → misery; in own/exaltation/retrograde → good

interpretation.detailed:
For an auspicious Bhukti planet: good effects manifest when the Sun in transit enters that planet's exaltation sign (or when Jupiter transits that position). For an inauspicious Bhukti planet: evil effects manifest when the Sun transits the planet's depression or inimical sign

Result: Sun's transit to Bhukti planet's exaltation/depression sign triggers the Bhukti's effects.
interpretation.summary: Auspicious Bhukti: good effects when Sun enters planet's exaltation; evil when Sun enters planet's depression

interpretation.detailed:
During a Dasa, when the Dasanatha in transit comes to the natal Lagna, or to the 3rd/6th/10th/11th house from it, or to the Saptavarga (7 divisional chart) places of the Lagna, or when a friendly planet/benefic comes to the Lagna → the Dasa proves auspicious at that time

Result: Auspicious period within the Dasa.
interpretation.summary: Dasanatha transit to Lagna or 3rd/6th/10th/11th → auspicious Dasa period

interpretation.detailed:
During the various periods of a Dasa, good or evil is determined by which house from the natal Moon the Dasanatha occupies in transit at that time

Result: Dasanatha's transit house from Moon determines good/evil quality at each sub-period.
interpretation.summary: Good/evil within Dasa determined by which house Dasanatha occupies from Moon

interpretation.detailed:
The Moon produces beneficial effects when in transit she is: in the friend's house of the Dasanatha, in the exaltation house of the Dasanatha, in the 7th house from the Dasanatha, in a Trikona from the Dasanatha, or in an Upachaya house (3rd/6th/10th/11th) from the Dasanatha

Result: Beneficial Dasa effects.
interpretation.summary: Moon in favorable positions from Dasanatha → beneficial Dasa effects

interpretation.detailed:
In Moon's favorable positions from Dasanatha (Rule 049), the Rasi occupied by the Moon represents one of the 12 natal Bhavas — that Bhava prospers. In unfavorable Moon positions, the corresponding natal Bhava suffers damage

Result: Favorable Moon transit position → corresponding Bhava prospers. Unfavorable → Bhava suffers.
interpretation.summary: Moon's transit Rasi = natal Bhava determines which Bhava prospers or suffers

interpretation.detailed:
Rahu gives effects — good or bad — according to the nature of the planet he associates with. That planet, though good and auspicious by himself, will, on account of association with Rahu, specially cause evil at the concluding portion of his Dasa

Result: Rahu mimics associated planet's effects but adds evil at the Dasa's end.
interpretation.summary: Rahu gives associated planet's effects; causes evil at end of that planet's Dasa

interpretation.detailed:
Per Parasara: (1) Kendra lords who are natural benefics → inauspicious Dasa. (2) Natural malefics owning Kendra → auspicious Dasa. (3) Trikona lords (1st/5th/9th) → always auspicious Dasa. (4) 3rd/6th/11th lords → always evil Dasa (even if natural benefics). (5) 8th lord who is also Lagna lord → auspicious. (6) Sun or Moon as 8th lord → good effects only

Result: Dasa outcome based on functional house ownership (Parasara's framework).
interpretation.summary: Functional nature of house lords in Dasa (Parasara's doctrine)

condition.note: Functional beneficence based on house ownership

engine_notes: This is the famous Parasara Dasa beneficence doctrine. Key rules: (1) benefic Kendra lords=bad, (2) malefic Kendra lords=good, (3) Trikona lords always good, (4) 3/6/11 lords always bad.

interpretation.detailed:
The lord of a Trikona house (5th/9th) posited in a Kendra, or the lord of a Kendra in a Trikona house → auspicious. During each other's Bhuktis in each other's Dasas → cooperative and doubly auspicious

Result: Auspicious Yoga. Mutual Bhukti periods in each other's Dasas are especially good.
interpretation.summary: Kendra-Trikona lord combination → mutual auspiciousness and Yoga

condition.note: Trikona lord in Kendra or Kendra lord in Trikona

interpretation.detailed:
Not all planets produce results befitting their owned Bhavas during their Bhuktis within their own Dasas — the Bhava effects may manifest at other times (other Bhuktis) within the Dasa

Result: Bhava effects are not guaranteed to occur during the Dasa-lord's own Bhukti.
interpretation.summary: Planets do not always give own Bhava effects during their Bhuktis in own Dasas

interpretation.detailed:
Find all planets related to the Dasanatha through the five XV-30 connection types. Note also planets in similar positions (coordinate to the Dasanatha). It is in the Antardasas (Bhuktis) of these related/coordinate planets that the original Dasanatha will manifest its full effect

Result: Dasanatha's effects are strongest in Bhuktis of XV-30-related planets.
interpretation.summary: Related planets (XV-30 connections) manifest Dasanatha's effects in their Bhuktis

interpretation.detailed:
The lords of a Kendra and Trikona house, even if they own other bad houses, become powerful through their mere relationship (XV-30 connections) to produce Yoga and make the native prosperous

Result: Prosperous Yoga; bad house ownership overridden by Kendra-Trikona relationship.
interpretation.summary: Kendra-Trikona lord relationship → powerful Yoga even through bad house ownership

interpretation.detailed:
If one of the lords of the 5th or 9th houses is related (XV-30) to a strong Kendra lord → that planet becomes a Yogakaraka — powerful in promoting the prosperity of the native

Result: Planet becomes Yogakaraka — strong prosperity promoter.
interpretation.summary: 5th/9th lord related to strong Kendra lord → Yogakaraka

interpretation.detailed:
If the lord of a Kendra is associated with the lord of a Trikona, both become powerful for promoting the native's prosperity. If an additional Trikona lord is also related (XV-30), prosperity is further advanced beyond doubt

Result: Mutual prosperity amplification; further Trikona lord = even greater.
interpretation.summary: Kendra lord + Trikona lord associated → mutual prosperity amplifier

interpretation.detailed:
Planets that are themselves bad (dusthana lords, etc.), if related (XV-30) to a Yogakaraka planet, will produce good effects of affluence and happiness during their Bhuktis (within the Yogakaraka's Dasa)

Result: Bad planets' Bhuktis become good when related to Yogakaraka.
interpretation.summary: Bad planets related to Yogakaraka → good Bhuktis

interpretation.detailed:
The lord of a Trikona house during his Dasa, in a Bhukti of the lord of a Kendra house (and vice versa) → good effects. Even if the two planets are not connected (XV-30), they will not cause harm to each other

Result: Good period. Trikona Dasa + Kendra Bhukti is mutually beneficial.
interpretation.summary: Trikona lord Dasa + Kendra lord Bhukti = good; no harm even if not connected

interpretation.detailed:
Jupiter and Venus, if they happen to own Kendra houses, become powerful to cause evil. If they also own Maraka houses (2nd and 7th), they become powerful to cause death (during their Dasas)

Result: Jupiter/Venus as Kendra lords = powerful for evil. If also Maraka lords = death-causers.
interpretation.summary: Jupiter and Venus as Kendra lords → powerful for evil; also Maraka → powerful for death

engine_notes: This is the famous 'Kendra adhipati dosha' for Jupiter and Venus. Important for longevity assessment.

interpretation.detailed:
Mercury, if owning Kendra houses, is less powerful for evil than Jupiter and Venus. The Moon in such a condition comes next to Mercury. Malefic planets when they happen to own Kendras become progressively more auspicious in their effects

Result: Mercury/Moon as Kendra lords: mildly adverse. Malefics as Kendra lords: increasingly auspicious.
interpretation.summary: Mercury/Moon as Kendra lords = less evil; malefics as Kendra lords = auspicious

interpretation.detailed:
Whatever effects are described for a planet in its Mahadasa also apply in the same planet's Bhukti period and Antara (Pratyantardasa). Dasha effect descriptions are canonical for all three sub-period levels

Result: Dasha effects also manifest in Bhukti and Antara of the same planet.
interpretation.summary: Bhukti and Antara inherit Dasha planet's described effects

condition.note: Applies to all 81 Bhukti rules in this chapter

interpretation.detailed:
Antardasa years = (Mahadasa years × Bhukti planet years) ÷ 120. Remainder × 12 ÷ 120 = months. Remaining × 30 ÷ 120 = days. Same process for sub-periods of Antardasa. First Bhukti in any Dasha begins with the Dasha lord's own Bhukti

Result: Antardasa duration calculated from Dasha years × Bhukti planet years / 120.
interpretation.summary: Antardasa calculation formula

engine_notes: This formula is already implemented in vedic_calculator.py. This rule documents the source authority from Phaladeepika.

interpretation.detailed: 27 Nakshatras are divided into three groups of 9 (triads). Each Nakshatra has 4 Padas. TRIAD 1 (from Aswini — Apasavya/clockwise): Padas assigned to Rasis from Mesha to Meena in Apasavya (clockwise/Pradakshina) order. TRIAD 2 (from Rohini — Savya/anti-clockwise): 12 quarters assigned to Rasis from Vrischika to Dhanus in Savya (anti-clockwise/Apradakshina) order.

interpretation.detailed: In the Kalachakra system, the Dasa period for any Rasi = the number of years assigned to the planet that owns that Rasi. This is the distinctive feature: Dasa periods are Rasi-based (via Rasi lord's years), not planet-based directly.

interpretation.detailed: The Vakyakrama (mnemonic formula sequence) determines the Rasi Mahadasa order. Three special transitions occur at the junctions of Kataka, Vrischika and Meena: (1) End of Kataka sequence: Manduka Gati (frog jump) — abrupt forward leap in Dasa sequence. (2) End of Vrischika sequence: Ashwa/Turaga Gati (horse jump) — another abrupt jump. (3) End of Meena sequence: Simhavalokana (lion's backward glance) — sequence reverses direction. The Dasas at these junction intervals cause woeful effects.

source.original_text: When the lord of the 10th house conjointly occupies a Kendra or Trikona position with four other planets, the person born will attain emancipation.

interpretation.detailed: When the lord of the 10th Bhava occupies a Kendra (1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th house) or a Trikona (5th or 9th house) in conjunction with four other planets — making a group of five planets (including the 10th lord) in Kendra or Trikona positions — the person born will attain emancipation (moksha, final liberation). The 10th house governs karma and worldly action; its lord abandoning karmic engagement by joining four other planets in the most auspicious houses signals complete exhaustion of worldly karma and spiritual liberation. This is the supreme outcome in Ch27 and among the highest possible outcomes in Phaladeepika. Attains emancipation (moksha)
